starters.where: Route 5 – west-most house, just west of the Day Care (north of Crater Town)
Dehara City – house southeast of the Rift Cave entrance (open the inner doors)
Seaport City – house west of the KBT Expressway entrance (woman with the pink umbrella)

chunks.t: Part 2: Icicle Cave & Route 2 – Learning to Catch Pokemon
chunks.x: Learning to Catch Pokemon | The old man at the cave entrance wants to help. Your next errand is to go through Icicle Cave to get to Dresco Town – but before you do that, talk to the old man next to the cave entrance at the Bellin Town end of Route 2. | The old man shows us the ropes. The old man teaches you how to catch Pokémon, practicing on a Snorunt.

chunks.t: Part 2: Icicle Cave & Route 2 – Learning to Catch Pokemon
chunks.x: The Quick Ball is your reward. He gives you a Quick Ball and then sends you on your way once the lesson is finished., From there, head to the cave entrance nearby and go on in. | Icicle Cave entrance

chunks.t: Part 2: Icicle Cave & Route 2 – Icicle Cave – 4F
chunks.x: The Sandslash digs its way through to a new tunnel. As soon as you arrive in the icy cavern, you see the Sandslash make a tunnel in the wall to the west. | The new entrance. You’ll have to chase down the Sandslash to complete your mission., Head in and you’ll find yourself in a different type of cave entirely, passing a friendly ruin explorer on the way. | The hidden cavern. This bit of the cavern is considerably less cold, and you see the Sandslash head to an outside area on the north side., However, if you go to the east, you’ll see something interesting there.

chunks.t: Part 2: Icicle Cave & Route 2 – Icicle Cave – 4F
chunks.x: An ancient tablet. An enormous stone tablet stands in this part of the cavern. As soon as you go to touch it, the ruin explorer from earlier shows up and tells you about its history. | A mission to read all the tablets. He gives you a Braille Converter so you can read what’s written on it – it says ‘THE PLATE IS THE KEY’., There are nine more tablets in Borrius, and he gives you a mission to find and read them all. | After you’re finished talking, head on over to the northwest exit. | The Sandslash has a family. There’s a secluded outdoor valley here, the lair of the Sandslash and his family of Sandshrew., They’re not happy to see you, and the Sandslash attacks!

chunks.t: Part 2: Icicle Cave & Route 2 – Icicle Cave – 4F
chunks.x: Pokémon Encounter: Sandslash ((Alolan Form) non-catchable) Lv12 | Artist Terrie. After you defeat the Sandslash, the man whose food it stole appears behind you and asks for it back. However, when it sees that it’s only trying to feed its family, the man says it can have all the food it wants if it becomes his Pokémon., With that agreed, the man gives you TM56 Hone Claws as thanks. | In order to reach the other side of Icicle Cave, you’ll have to head back the way you came and go back to the first cavern. | The ladder to the lower level. There’s a ladder there that will take you to 3F.

As soon as you climb down the ladder, head north and then west. You’ll be challenged by Youngster Don, the first trainer to beat in the cave. | Youngster Don. Once he’s been defeated, continue west until you reach a large expanse of ice., There’s not much of a puzzle here – all you need to do is make it to the other side.

chunks.t: Part 2: Icicle Cave & Route 2 – Icicle Cave – 3F
chunks.x: Sliding along the ice. First slide west, then when you hit the middle rock, slide to the south. | Picknicker Kelly. Picknicker Kelly is waiting for you on the southern edge, and once you beat her, continue on south. | Chanseys can heal you in the field

chunks.t: Part 2: Icicle Cave & Route 2 – Icicle Cave – 3F
chunks.x: Note: In Pokémon Unbound, if you see a Chansey in the wild, they will be able to heal you. There’s one waiting here at the ladder down to the second floor. A trainer, Black Belt Ron, is to the east, but he’s entirely optional. | If your Pokémon are hurting, it’s a great chance to rest before continuing – and you’ll need to be healthy for the next part. | Icicle Cave – Lower Floors | Icicle Cave lower floors map. Skier George, Rival Battle, Youngster Joey. Ladder Up to 3F, Ladder Down to 1F, Ladder Up to 2F, Requires HM Surf

chunks.t: Part 2: Icicle Cave & Route 2 – Icicle Cave – Lower Floors
chunks.x: Trainer Youngster Joey: Rattata Lv10, Sentret Lv10. Prize ₽160 | Skier George, optional trainer to the left. On the second floor, the path to the right is the way forward, so head along there and you’ll soon get a bit of a surprise. | Rival Battle | Your Rival is back for round two. It’s your Rival, and he wants a rematch. No time to chat, just a battle – and he’s got one more Pokémon with him this time. | Trainer Rival Battle (Second Round): Swinub Lv12, Beldum Gible Larvitar Lv13

chunks.t: Part 2: Icicle Cave & Route 2 – Rival Battle
chunks.x: If you’ve been leveling up your Pokémon with the trainers and the wild encounters, he shouldn’t be too much trouble. | Your rival gives you a prize. For beating him, your Rival gives you a pair of Safety Goggles, which he says will come in handy later. You hand over the Pokedex from Professor Log. | Your next destination. Your Rival tells you to fight the Gym Leader in Dresco Town, coincidentally where you’re already headed., You might get your first badge soon, it seems. | The way to proceed is northwest. Continue along the passage, passing Youngster Joey, and you’ll come to the final ladder in Icicle Cave.

chunks.t: Part 2: Icicle Cave & Route 2 – Rival Battle
chunks.x: Not far now. Just one more icy floor to negotiate – which isn’t much trouble at all – and you’ll be at the exit of the cave. | Route 2 is just up ahead. Head out and you’ll find yourself in Route 2, not far from Dresco Town.

chunks.t: Part 2: Icicle Cave & Route 2 – Route 2
chunks.x: Trainer Youngster Dan: Electrike Lv11, Riolu Lv12. Prize ₽192 | Trainer Hiker Nob: Drilbur Lv12, Makuhita Lv12, Zubat Lv11, Roggenrola Lv11. Prize ₽352 | Trainer Picnicker Kelsey & Camper Chad: Minccino Lv10, Stufful Lv10, Electrike Lv12, Inkay Lv12 | Trainer Lass Haley: Azurill Lv12, Minccino Lv12, Pikipek Lv12. Prize ₽192 | There’s a rest stop just outside. When you emerge finally on Route 2, you might be a bit exhausted. Not to worry – a helpful lady approaches you and heals your Pokémon for you., There’s also a Porygon if you want to access Pokémon Storage, as well as a Psychic who will teleport you to town if you want to skip trainer battles.

chunks.t: Part 2: Icicle Cave & Route 2 – Route 2
chunks.x: Youngster Foggy and Hiker Wayne. The first trainer you see, Youngster Foggy, mentions a ‘challenge’. And once you beat him and Hiker Wayne, head south and talk to the man on the beach to find out why. | Challenge Road can be rewarding at this stage. If you defeat every single trainer on Route 2, he’ll reward you with a Pokémon that may fill a particular gap on your team., Head south and there’s four battles you need to win. | Youngster Dan. Youngster Dan is first, just as you cross the bridge off the beach. Head up the stairs once you’ve taken care of him.

chunks.t: Part 2: Icicle Cave & Route 2 – Route 2
chunks.x: Hiker Nob, Picknicker Kelsey and Camper Chad. Hiker Nob is next, and once he’s done, you’ll have a Double Battle on your hands with the Picknicker and Camper. They have two Pokémon each, so be prepared. | The final trainer in the challenge, Lass Haley. Lass Haley is your final obstacle to that prize. She’s located at the western end of the route, just near the entrance to Dresco Town., Once you’ve defeated her, head back to the man who gave you the challenge. | Litleo is your prize. If you have a spare space in your Pokémon team (if you don’t, just talk to the Porygon at the cave entrance), you’ll get a Litleo, whose Fire type may come in handy in the future. | Challenge Reward: Litleo Lv10

chunks.t: Part 2: Icicle Cave & Route 2 – Route 2
chunks.x: The entrance to Dresco Town. Head west back past Lass Haley and you’ll see a bridge leading to Dresco Town. | Items: Ring Target, TM112 Round, Shiny Stone, Rose Incense, Rock Gem, Trainer Tips sign #7, Trainer Tips sign #8, Zygarde Cell #7, Zygarde Cell #8, Portal #14, Tapu Fini

chunks.t: Part 3: Dresco Town & Route 3 – Dresco Town
chunks.x: Entering Dresco Town. Dresco Town is a series of islands connected by bridges, and it is also home to the first Gym you can challenge in Borrius., You may need to prepare for that, though, so there’s a few things in town you can do to make you stronger. | The entrance to Trainer House. The first thing is to visit Trainer House, which is the big building you see just as you enter town. | Items: Soothe Bell, Fresh Water, Grass Gem, TM86 Grass Knot, Bottle Cap, TM105 Brutal Swing, Lemonade, Dusk Ball x3, Notebook, Big Nugget x3, Salamencite, Trainer Tips sign #8, Zygarde Cell #9, Vivillon pattern Archipelago

chunks.t: Part 3: Dresco Town & Route 3 – Dresco Town
chunks.x: Special Encounters (Miraheze wiki): Ducklett (Quacker) (Trade) Lv15, Zygarde (Gift) Lv100, Vivillon (Archipelago form) Lv50 | The Trainer House | Trainer House is a place to grind. There are five trainers in Trainer House that can be battled again and again, but it appears one of them has taken up Pokémon Center and greeter duty at the door., For now, battle four of them at least once, since you’ll need that experience if you want to challenge the Gym. | Trainer House | Trainer Kindler Daniel: Litleo Lv15, Fennekin Lv15, Oricorio Lv15. Prize ₽256 | Trainer Tuber Renee: Panpour Lv15, Finneon Lv15, Froakie Lv15. Prize ₽320

chunks.t: Part 3: Dresco Town & Route 3 – The Trainer House
chunks.x: Trainer Collector Kobe (Double Battle): Whismur Lv15, Happiny Lv15, Lickitung Lv15, Audino Lv15 | Trainer Ace Trainer Bram (Double Battle): Poochyena Lv15, Pancham Lv15, Sandile Lv15, Carvanha Lv15, Inkay Lv15, Inkay Lv15 | After you’ve become as strong as you want to, head north to the town square. | Exploring Town | The Moltres statue square. A massive statue of Moltres dominates the central square of Dresco Town, just like the Articuno statue in Bellin Town.

chunks.t: Part 3: Dresco Town & Route 3 – Exploring Town
chunks.x: A mission to read all the tablets. Walk east across a bridge, and you’ll come to a house. There’s a kid inside who will give you a mission to complete. | Saving manually 100 times is all that is required. This mission, Don’t Turn off the Power, should be simple enough – you may do it naturally during the playthrough, especially if you have automatic save prompts on., Once you’ve saved 100 times, return to the kid and he’ll give you a Bottle Cap, which may come in handy later. | The Pokemon Center and Poke Mart. The island north of the plaza has the Pokémon Center and Poke Mart, if you’d like to heal or stock up on any supplies., After that, head west over the bridge.

chunks.t: Part 3: Dresco Town & Route 3 – Exploring Town
chunks.x: Dresco Gym. You’ll see Dresco Gym, as well as two workers blocking access to an exit. This is where the KBT Expressway starts, but apparently they can’t let us through yet., You’ll have to wait to go in to the Gym too, if you want the best chance of winning – you’ll need to pick up a Pokémon that may make things easier, so more on that later. | For now, head on south. | The woman wants to see a certain kind of Pokémon. Talk to the blonde woman, and she’ll mention that she’d like to see a Pokémon that only evolves if it levels up while having high Friendship with its trainer., There are two that can be caught on Route 2 – Riolu or Azurill. | If you’ve got one, she’ll give you a Soothe Bell., Head south to the house with a trainer in a green cap standing in front of it. | A mission to read all the tablets. This is the house where Professor Log’s friend lives, but this guy won’t let you in yet. He suggests you take on the Gym first, and then gives a hint., The Gym is Grass-type, and there’s a strange fog inside that can be harmful to our Pokémon and may make it harder to battle. To get rid of it, this mysterious person recommends we get a Pokémon with Defog, and we can see a man named Edmund for one.

chunks.t: Part 3: Dresco Town & Route 3 – Exploring Town
chunks.x: This guy needs help with his reading. Just south of here is another mission giver – this time, you’ll need to head to all 45 Trainer Tips signposts and read them., You’ll have passed eight so far, so it’s a good time to check if you missed any. | Edmund lives here | Ducklett Trade | The house north of the one with the strange trainer in front of it is Edmund’s house, and you’ll need to go here next for an important trade.

chunks.t: Part 3: Dresco Town & Route 3 – Exploring Town
chunks.x: Trading for a Pokemon with Defog. It turns out that Edmund has a Ducklett with Defog that he is willing to trade for. All he wants in return is an Alolan Form Sandshrew, and if you haven’t done so already, you can catch them in the lair within Icicle Cave. | Pokémon Trade | Edmund gives you:: Ducklett Lv13 | You give Edmund:: Sandshrew ((Alolan Form) found in Icicle Cave 4F) | A couple of scientists live in this house. After making the trade and becoming a Ducklett owner, walk west to the house next door.

chunks.t: Part 3: Dresco Town & Route 3 – Exploring Town
chunks.x: Finding the Cells | The Zygarde Cells are highly sought after. Zygfried and Zygardia are a couple of scientists who are looking for strange glowing green cells scattered all over Borrius. They can only be detected by a special Super Cube component, which they give to you in exchange for you promising to help finding all one hundred cells., Here are all the locations of the cells you can backtrack into areas you’ve already been in to collect: | Items: Dresco Town, Route 2, Icicle Cave 3F, Bellin Town, Route 1, Frozen Heights

chunks.t: Part 3: Dresco Town & Route 3 – Exploring Town
chunks.x: A brief training detour. You may need more training before facing your first gym – in which case, heading north out of Dresco Town is a very good idea at this point.

chunks.t: Part 3: Dresco Town & Route 3 – Route 3

This is the entrance to Flower Paradise, and it certainly lives up to its name. | Items: Carbos, Deep Sea Tooth, Deep Sea Scale, TM45 Attract, Leftovers, Zygarde Cell #10, Trainer Tips sign #09, Max Raid Den #01 | Flower Paradise | Flower Paradise

chunks.t: Part 3: Dresco Town & Route 3 – Flower Paradise
chunks.x: Northeast along the path through the flowers. There’s a woman in here who offers you a mission – catch three Combee and take the Honey they’re guaranteed to hold., In exchange, she’ll give you TM62 Silver Wind. | Then up on the hill in the middle of the field is someone who will give you a random Berry every day, so make sure to stop by occasionally if you want to stock up. | The Berry Giver. After you’ve explored a bit and maybe leveled up a few levels, it’s time to head back to Dresco Town and challenge your first Pokémon Gym! | Items: Cheri Berry, Chesto Berry, Pecha Berry, Rawst Berry, Aspear Berry, Oran Berry, Leppa Berry, Sitrus Berry, Lum Berry, TM62 Silver Wind, Gracidea, Zygarde Cell #11

chunks.t: Part 3: Dresco Town & Route 3 – Flower Paradise
chunks.x: Special Encounters (Miraheze wiki): Vivillon (Meadow form) Lv50, Shaymin (Special encounter) Lv30

chunks.t: Part 4: Dresco Gym & Grim Woods – Dresco Gym – Leaf Badge
chunks.x: Dresco Gym – Leaf Badge | As soon as you enter the Gym, you’re hit by an awful fog. The Dresco Gym is in the northeast corner of Dresco Town, and it’s a Grass-type Gym. | Grass-type moves are super effective against Ground-, Rock-, and Water-type Pokémon, Grass-type Pokémon are weak against Bug-, Fire-, Flying-, Ice-, and Poison-type moves | The Litleo that you completed the Route 2 trainer challenge for will come in handy here.

chunks.t: Part 4: Dresco Gym & Grim Woods – Dresco Gym – Leaf Badge
chunks.x: The Ducklett is a must-bring for this Gym. You’ll notice that the Gym is full of a strange fog, and if you battle in it, things might get more difficult for you than they need to be., Bring your Ducklett and use its move Defog. That’ll get rid of the nasty substance, and you’re free to continue north into the gym proper. | Gym Trainers | Trainer Youngster Doobie: Cherubi Lv14, Oddish Lv15. chunks.t: Gym 1: Dresco Town Gym (Mirskle) – Leaf Badge, Fairy / Grass
chunks.x: The Dresco Town Gym is the first Borrius gym you encounter in Pokémon Unbound. The gym leader, Mirskle, uses a mix of Fairy and Grass-type Pokémon., Flying and Fire-type Pokémon would work best against Mirskle as a counter to his Gloom. In contrast, Steel and Poison-types are effective against Fairy types like his Flabebe. Dresco Town Gym Puzzle: Dresco Town has no puzzle associated with its gym. It follows an unobstructed path guarded by 2 trainers leading up to Mirskle. But the gym is shrouded in fog which causes a 40% decrease in accuracy for all Pokemon. This fog can be disabled with Defog, though., Here’s a step-by-step guide on how you can quickly reach Mirskle., Step 1: From the entrance of the gym, follow the open path guarded by the first trainer ‘Youngster Doobie’., Step 2: Continue on the open path heading towards the eastern side of the gym. You’ll find the second trainer ‘Camper Liam’ guarding the area., Step 3: Walk towards the end of this path to find and challenge Mirskle. Tips on Defeating Mirskle: Use Type Effectiveness: Mirskle and his trainers use Pokemon that are generally weak against Fire, Flying, and Steel-types. Be sure to feature these within your squad. Regardless, Mirskle has relatively weak Pokemon which shouldn’t cause problems unless you plan on using Ground-types., Sniff Mirskle’s Rose Incense: Before the battle begins, Mirskle offers you Rose Incense which your Pokemon can sniff. Accepting this increases the Sp. Def stat of your Pokemon., Disable the Fog: If you’re having a hard time landing hits due to the reduced accuracy of the fog, you can disable this by performing a weather-altering move. Examples of these include Sandstorm and Hail. Outside battle, Defog can also be used to get rid of the foggy environment., Target Gloom: Considering his 2 Pokemon, Gloom is relatively more threatening than Flabebe as it can restore HP and cause Poison status effects. It’s a good idea to target Gloom first with both your Pokemon, moving on to Flabebe afterward. Rewards: Defeating Mirskle rewards you with the following:, ₽ 5,120 • TM86 Grass Knot • Leaf Badge – Makes all Pokemon up till level 26 obey your commands

Route 4 is broken in half by Cinder Volcano, and the west side of the caverns naturally leads to the west side of Route 4., There’s a Porygon near the cave entrance that will act as Pokémon Storage if you need it. | Fisherman Barney and a Lapras. This side of Route 4 is fairly quiet, with a few optional trainers for you to beat and items to collect. One thing you won’t fail to notice is a Lapras, docked on the south side of a bridge. | The Lapras will take us to Route 5. This Lapras is the only way for us to get to Route 5, since we don’t have the HM Waterfall yet., So once you’ve gotten everything in order, hop on the Lapras’ back and it will take you where you need to go.

chunks.t: Part 6: Route 5 to Crater Town – Route 5
chunks.x: Route 5 starts here. You’ve just ridden on the back of a Lapras down a waterfall and now you’re in Route 5, a pleasant but damp valley., Head west through a patch of long grass and talk to the first person you meet. | This guy will take care of you. Luckily for you, the first person you meet offers to heal your Pokémon for free, and acts as another waypoint in your long journey., Once you finish healing up, walk east and you’ll get challenged by Lass Sally. | The beginning of the third floor. After you get past Sally, there’ll be a man jogging up and down the path in front of you., He offers a mission: walk 150000 steps and he’ll give you something interesting. | This is something you can just do naturally in a playthrough, so when you eventually reach that number, head back here and he’ll give you Carbos – not just one though. FIFTY doses of the stuff.

chunks.t: Part 6: Route 5 to Crater Town – Route 5
chunks.x: Youngster Ben and the crossroads. Once you have the walking mission under way, make a start on it by walking west and you’ll run into Youngster Ben., There’s a bit of a junction here – go to the north and follow the corridor through the trees. | The Pokemon Day Care is a useful place. You’ve arrived at the Pokémon Day Care, and there’s lots of things you can do here before ending up in Crater Town. | Pokémon Day Care | This Day Care worker gives you one of the longest and most painful missions in the game. You’ll see someone on the left that needs your help with some research. You’ll need to show them various Baby Pokémon, and some of them can’t be caught – they must be bred at the Day Care holding certain rare incense items:

chunks.t: Part 6: Route 5 to Crater Town – Route 5
chunks.x: Baby Pokémon Locations

chunks.t: Part 6: Route 5 to Crater Town – Route 5
chunks.x: Baby Pokémon Locations | If you’re lucky and patient enough to do all that, your prize is an Oval Charm, which will increase the chances of an Egg being found at the Pokémon Day Care. | This trainer is repeatable. Just to the right of the entrance to the Day Care is a breeder who needs your help., Every day, you can battle their Pokémon to help make them stronger, and this will make you stronger in the process.

chunks.t: Part 6: Route 5 to Crater Town – Route 5
chunks.x: The Pokemon Day Care will raise your Pokemon. As with most other Pokémon games, leaving a Pokémon at the Day Care will raise its level as you walk around and go about your business. Come back periodically and you’ll have a stronger Pokémon. | South of Youngster Ben | Unova Starter House | Once you’re finished at the Day Care, head back to the intersection and take the south path. You’ll see another fork in the road, and when you do, immediately follow it west.

chunks.t: Part 6: Route 5 to Crater Town – Route 5
chunks.x: The Unovan trainer’s house. You’ll see a house in the middle of the woods. Go inside, because the person living here has a present for you. | Your choice of the Unovan starters. A trainer from Unova lives here, and she has three Unovan starter Pokémon that she can’t raise anymore., You can pick one now, and come back when you have 4 and 7 badges respectively to collect the other two. | Unova Starters: Snivy (Grass), Tepig (Fire), Oshawott (Water)

chunks.t: Part 6: Route 5 to Crater Town – Route 5
chunks.x: The last trainer on Route 5 | Back onto Route 5 | When you’ve got your brand new Unovan Pokémon, head south and you’ll be challenged by Youngster Calvin. | Crater Town awaits. Now that you’ve seen all that there is to see on Route 5, go south and you’ll see a town in the middle of a massive crater – Crater Town.

chunks.t: Part 6: Route 5 to Crater Town – Crater Town
chunks.x: Items: Stardust, Stardust, Stardust, Star Piece, Zygarde Cell | Crater Town. There are a couple of things for us to do here – first, go to the Pokémon Center. | A secret. Investigate the bookshelf next to the counter and you’ll see a hidden path leading to a small room with a Clefairy in it – this is one of many secret areas where you have the opportunity to battle or catch one rare Pokémon.

chunks.t: Part 6: Route 5 to Crater Town – Crater Town
chunks.x: The southeast house. After you’ve caught or defeated the Clefairy, walk south until you find the house that is tucked into the southeast corner of the crater. | The Move Maniac. This is the house of the Move Maniac – he will make your Pokémon remember a move that they have forgotten in exchange for Heart Scales., Since we don’t have any of those yet, leave and continue west around the crater’s edge. | Two shady characters. There are two Shadow grunts having a whispered conversation with each other at this end of town, and you can’t get past them., Walk north, down into the crater a little, and you’ll see a Poke Mart.

chunks.t: Part 6: Route 5 to Crater Town – Crater Town
chunks.x: Crater Town Poke Mart. The Poke Mart is a great place to get supplies, but there’s another thing worth getting in this particular location, and it’s totally free. | Flash will come in handy. The blonde-haired woman inside will give you TM70 Flash, which can light up dark places. You will need it later on. | The gym. West of the Poke Mart is the Crater Town Gym, but you may need a little bit more practice first before making an attempt., Walk south from here and you’ll see a house just south of the center of the crater.

chunks.t: Part 6: Route 5 to Crater Town – Crater Town
chunks.x: The Swarm Report house. Inside this house is a family that are somehow able to detect when random Swarm events happen, and can tell you about them., Talk to the girl in here and she’ll tell you where and what the Swarm is. Her father will give you a Berry at random if you show him a Pokémon caught from that particular swarm. | One last house to visit. There’s one more thing for us to pick up in Crater Town, and that’s a mission from the southwest house. | The KBT Expressway | Mission accepted. The man who lives here has a brother who has been kidnapped by a ruthless gang called the Black Emboar, and they’ve gone to the KBT Expressway., Sounds like the perfect place to train up a bit before taking on the Crater Gym.

chunks.t: Part 6: Route 5 to Crater Town – Crater Town
chunks.x: The entrance to the KBT Expressway. The KBT Expressway – which is short for the “King Borrius the Third Expressway”, according to the Hiker nearby – can be accessed from the northern exit of Crater Town. | Items: Motorbike, Fresh Water, Dark Gem, TM46 Thief, TM70 Flash, TM98 Work Up, Yellow Shard, Reaper Cloth, Diancite, Red Orb, Blue Orb, Zygarde Cell #19, Portal #20, Celesteela | Special Encounters (Miraheze wiki): Clefairy (Special) Lv20, Jirachi (Special) Lv70

chunks.t: Part 7: KBT Expressway & Crater Gym – The KBT Expressway
chunks.x: The entrance to the KTB Expressway is to the north of Crater Town, and you’ll need to go in there to look for a man’s missing brother., The Expressway is a massive tunnel system that connects most towns in Borrius, though only a few parts are open to you at the moment. | The Black Emboar don’t like us being in here. This section is crawling with biker thugs that call themselves the Black Emboar, and you’ll have to fight through a bunch of them one by one to proceed. | The first Gem Family member you can encounter. Along the way you’ll see a man in a juggler costume that calls himself a Gem Family member. These are move trainers that teach your Pokémon powerful moves in exchange for a number of specific type Gems., More on that later, after the Black Emboar problem is taken care of. | Mining Minigame | Just a little further ahead you’ll see a worker who will offer to lend you his tools to mine for items. He’ll need P1000 every time.

chunks.t: Part 7: KBT Expressway & Crater Gym – The KBT Expressway
chunks.x: You can pay to mine in this section. The key here is to break as much of the rock using the hammer and pick tools before the wall collapses., The crack in the top of the interface will grow with every hit, so be careful. | The mining minigame. If you’re lucky, you can uncover Hard Stones, Heart Scales, Everstones, Revives, any of the evolution Stones, and a few more assorted goodies., Once you’re finished with the mining minigame, continue north until you see an intersection. | Black Emboar Boss – James | James is big, brawny, and the Boss. Speak to the big man here and he’ll reveal himself as James, the boss of the Black Emboar., He’ll immediately challenge you to a battle to test your worth.

chunks.t: Part 7: KBT Expressway & Crater Gym – The KBT Expressway
chunks.x: Trainer Black Emboar Boss James: Koffing (Poison) Lv20, Salandit (Poison/Fire) Lv21, Alolan Grimer (Poison/Dark) Lv22, Pignite (Fire/Fighting) Lv22. Prize ₽2,160 | When you beat him, he’ll be so impressed that he’ll name the gang after you., When you ask him about your mission, he’ll tell you that he’s actually the brother the man is looking for! | James is actually the missing brother. You go back to Crater Town together to confront his brother, who was just worried he was getting himself into too much trouble., James says that his gang is off to Antisis City to take up residence there, and has a parting gift for you. | The Motorcycle is the same as the Bicycle from other games. You’ll get your very own Motorcycle, which you can assign to the Select button from the Cube menu., Not only will it be much faster than the Running Shoes, but wild Pokémon encounters are reduced while riding it. Very handy.

chunks.t: Part 7: KBT Expressway & Crater Gym – The KBT Expressway
chunks.x: Moving Forward | Now that the Black Emboar are gone, the KTB Expressway opens up as a bit of a shortcut for you to use. At the moment though, the only towns you can access through it are Dresco Town and Frozen Heights., There are also four Gem Family members in the tunnel you can get to if you’d like to: | Gem Family Move Shops | With that out of the way, it’s time to head to Crater Gym to get your next badge. | Items: HM01 Cut, Max Raid Den #24

chunks.t: Part 7: KBT Expressway & Crater Gym – The KBT Expressway
chunks.x: Special Encounters (Miraheze wiki): Carbink (Static) Lv75, Diancie (Static) Lv80(25onNewGamePlus,beforePostGame) | Crater Gym – Vision Badge | Crater Gym. The Crater Gym is in the northeast quadrant of Crater Town, in the lower ring. | It is very dark in the Gym. The Crater Gym is focused on Dark-types, and it shows – the interior is completely pitch black., The Guide inside tells us that defeating trainers here will increase your visibility, so that’s your first task. | Tip: Dark-type moves are super-effective against Psychic- and Ghost-type Pokémon, so avoid using those. However, Dark-type Pokemon are weak against Fighting-, Bug-, and Fairy-type moves., One more thing – your Pokémon will be taking damage every turn by the Dark energy in this place, unless they’re Dark-type, Ghost-type, or have an ability such as Magic Guard, Unaware or Oblivious.

chunks.t: Part 7: KBT Expressway & Crater Gym – Crater Gym – Vision Badge
chunks.x: Gym Trainers | Trainer Youngster Dixon: Nuzleaf (Grass/Dark) Lv21. Prize ₽336 | Trainer Scientist Dilweed: Poochyena (Dark) Lv21. Prize ₽1,008 | Trainer Medium Lyssa: Murkrow (Dark/Flying) Lv21. Prize ₽1,008 | Trainer Gentleman Clemonce: Houndour (Dark/Fire) Lv21. Prize ₽1,512

chunks.t: Part 7: KBT Expressway & Crater Gym – Crater Gym – Vision Badge
chunks.x: The area to the east of the Guide has the trainers you need to beat. From the entrance, follow the right corridor until you encounter some trainers. Youngster Dixon and Scientist Dilweed are on their own, but if you step in the middle between Medium Lyssa and Gentleman Clemonce, they’ll fight you together in a Double Battle., If you don’t want that, talk to them separately. | Once those four trainers are defeated, your circle of visibility will be much larger than before., Then go back to the Guide at the start of the gym and head into the passage behind him. | Crater Gym Sneaking Puzzle | The next section can be tricky. Do you like stealth puzzles?, Well, like it or not, this section is one. | Follow the corridor left until you see a female trainer run past and then go back – when her back is turned, follow her. Then hide in an alcove to the south while she passes by., The same goes for a boy trainer doing the same thing further down the path. If you’re caught at any point, you’ll be sent back to the beginning.

chunks.t: Part 7: KBT Expressway & Crater Gym – Crater Gym – Vision Badge
chunks.x: Caught and sent back to the beginning. After you get past those two NPCs, there’s a bit of a checkpoint before you have to sneak past two more trainers., None of these paths should be challenging if you study their movements. | Then there’s two more trainers after that, including a sneaky cameraman, but you will eventually make it to the Gym Leader’s room. | Crater Gym Leader – Vega | Vega takes himself a little too seriously. The Crater Gym Leader is a very edgy type of person, and you’ll have to beat him to get that Vision Badge., No real tricks here, although the moves of his Pokémon will probably make yours flinch often. | Tip: The table below is only for Vega on Vanilla mode. If you want to see his team comp at a higher difficulty level then visit our Crater Town Gym page here. | Trainer Gym Leader Vega: Liepard (Dark) Lv22, Sneasel (Dark/Ice) Lv21, Absol (Dark) Lv23. Prize ₽4,160

chunks.t: Part 7: KBT Expressway & Crater Gym – Crater Gym – Vision Badge
chunks.x: Your prize for beating Vega | After You Win | If you manage to defeat him, Vega will give you the Vision Badge as well as TM46 Thief. | Tip: Several missions in Pokémon Unbound – including the one you picked up in Flower Paradise – require you to take items from Pokémon. You can do this by catching them, or you can steal them using moves like Thief. | With Vega defeated, you will notice that the Shadow Grunts have moved away from the southern exit of Crater Town. | Oops, it’s a trap. Unfortunately, it’s too good to be true – as soon as you try to leave town from that exit you’re ambushed by a bunch of Grunts and taken to Cinder Volcano.

chunks.t: Part 7: KBT Expressway & Crater Gym – Shadow Battles
chunks.x: Shadow Battles | Your chance to meet the Shadow’s leader. The leader of the Shadow, a man named Zeph, is here – along with Ivory who was the one who captured Moltres., Ivory challenges you to a battle straight away. | Trainer Shadow Admin Ivory: Misdreavus (Ghost) Lv22, Kadabra (Psychic) Lv21 | Ivory isn’t too tough if you’ve been training your Pokémon evenly., After she’s been defeated, Zeph will declare that he will take care of you once and for all. | Zeph wants to take care of you himself. Zeph has only one Pokémon, and Ivory warns him against trying to beat you with it. However, he ignores her.

chunks.t: Part 7: KBT Expressway & Crater Gym – Shadow Battles
chunks.x: Trainer Shadow Boss Zeph: Houndoom (Dark/Fire) Lv24. Prize ₽5,600 | He’s shocked when you beat his Houndoom, but doesn’t have too much time to react., An earthquake hits the volcano, and a Shadow Grunt reports that a massive monster has appeared from below., The Shadow quickly leave, and you’re left on our own – but a strange Pokémon appears, and shoves us through a portal to safety. | Shoved into a portal again. You arrive in the southern KBT tunnel south of Crater Town, where you were trying to go in the first place!

Apparently the way forward to Thundercap Mountain and Zapdos is blocked by a rockfall, and we need HM06 Rock Smash to clear it., The Hiker knows someone who can give it to you, but they live in Blizzard City. The only way to get to Blizzard City from here is through the cave in the very center of Crater Town.

chunks.t: Part 7: KBT Expressway & Crater Gym – Getting HM01 Cut
chunks.x: And that cave is blocked by a small tree…, But luckily for you, the Hiker gives you HM01 Cut! | Tip: HMs in Pokémon Unbound work differently than other Pokémon games. If you have a Pokémon capable of learning the move in your party, you don’t actually have to teach them the move for them to use it. This frees up a lot of space in your team’s moveset for more useful and powerful moves in teams. | Optional: Backtracking for Extra Items | Having Cut opens up a few areas in routes you’ve already been to as well. So if you’d like to backtrack for some extra goodies, here’s a list of where to go: | Items: Raid Den (hidden grotto), Moon Stone (hidden), Zygarde Cell, TM09 Bullet Seed, TM66 Payback, TM112 Round

chunks.t: Part 7: KBT Expressway & Crater Gym – Entering Valley Cave
chunks.x: Entering Valley Cave | The entrance to Valley Cave. Valley Cave is your next destination, and cutting the small tree at the bottom of the crater will get you there.

chunks.t: Gym 2: Crater Town Gym (Véga) – Vision Badge, Dark
chunks.x: The Crater Town Gym is the second gym you encounter in Pokémon Unbound. Véga, the gym leader, uses Dark-type Pokémon. Each of his Pokémon along with their details are showcased below:, It is ideal to use Fighting, Bug, or Fairy-type Pokémon as a counter to Véga’s Dark-types. Crater Town Gym Puzzle: When entering the gym, the surroundings will be shrouded in darkness, reducing your vision. Each time you defeat a Trainer, some of your vision will be restored. Additionally, the Gym has several Trainers patrolling the area, teleporting you back to the entrance (or a checkpoint) if you’re caught., Upon entering the gym, head towards the right and go straight up. This room contains 4 Trainers you can battle. Each battle will restore a part of your vision., Step 1: Battle each of these trainers ahead., Going further up will lead you to the second Trainer., Finally, head even further up for the final battle consisting of 2 Trainers., Step 2: With your vision restored, head back to the gym’s entrance., Then from there, follow the path leading straight up and towards the left., Step 3: Towards the end of this corridor, dodge the Trainer patrolling the area by hiding in the small space on the bottom side of the wall., Step 4: Go further along the path left, hiding from the Trainer in the red headband, just as done in the previous step., Keep walking till you reach the end of the wall., Step 5: This is a checkpoint. Being caught by subsequent Trainers will teleport you back here., Make your way along the straight path, dodging the three Trainers in between., The hiding area for the 2nd Trainer here is quite small so be sure to time your run appropriately., The third Trainer’s run overlaps with the second, making this dodge slightly complicated. You can hide at the very end of the corridor to avoid him, as done in the image below. However, you have to run out of here immediately, as the Trainer will catch you on his way back., Step 6: Make your way down & over through the narrow corridor, avoiding the final Trainer with the video camera., Step 7: Enter the open room at the end of this path to reach Véga. Tips for Defeating Véga: Here are some tips that’ll help you battle Vég

Walk under it, and you’ll come to a small fork in the path. | North leads to the bridge. South leads to an item, and north leads to the elevated platform that you need to be on to proceed through the cavern.

chunks.t: Part 8: Valley Cave – Valley Cave
chunks.x: Pokemon Ranger Nicolas and the button. When you reach the northern platform and the west side of the bridge, you’ll see a small rock up against the western wall., When you interact with it, it will reveal itself to be a button – but nothing will happen. | For now, go ahead and challenge Pokémon Ranger Nicolas and walk past him over the bridge. | The bridge leads to another bridge. Once you’re over that bridge, there’s another, skinnier bridge leading south that you need to cross. Keep going south. | The Gentleman gives you a clue. You’ll see Gentleman Thomas and a monolith like the one you found in Icicle Cave. However, you can’t get to it just yet without Rock Climb., The Gentleman tells you about the inscription, which gives you a clue about what to do with the button rock – make sure the first Pokémon in your party is Bug-type, then hit the button. | But it won’t make any difference if you don’t have Rock Climb. So that’s something you’ll have to try later., Walk west, and you’ll see a ladder.

chunks.t: Part 8: Valley Cave – Route 6

As you cross the west bridge, you’ll notice a small gully with some trainers in it. | The other side of the bridge. Painter Picaso waits to challenge you with his lone Smeargle, and after you’ve defeated them, continue on to the south.

chunks.t: Part 8: Valley Cave – Route 6
chunks.x: Youngster Josh. Youngster Josh is the last trainer on the route, and once you challenge him you’re free to proceed to the south. | The south route leads to Auburn Waterway, and the west is where you want to go. You don’t need to go to Auburn Waterway just yet, so take the west path. | Ivory is still up to no good. When you take that west path, you’ll see a cutscene where Ivory is talking about preventing access to Thundercap Mountain through nefarious means., After that, head west on to Route 7.

chunks.t: Part 8: Valley Cave – Route 7
chunks.x: The south gate leads to Shadow Grunts. After defeating them in the manner that you choose, you’ll see a gate to another route to the south., It’s being blocked by Shadow Grunts though, so you’ll have to go the other way. | Hiker Marcos. Hiker Marcos will challenge you once you start climbing the hill, and after that is Juggler Kayden. | Juggler Kayden and the bridge north. Crossing the bridge to the north of here will get you to a small island and another bridge.

chunks.t: Part 8: Valley Cave – Route 7
chunks.x: Black Belt Koichi walks up and down this bridge. Walk across the other bridge and it’ll be hard to avoid Black Belt Koichi. Once he’s been taken care of, you’ll reach the mainland again. | The last fork in Route 7. The way forward to Frost Mountain and Blizzard City is to the north of here, but it’s important to take the east path first. | Bird Keeper Keith and the Fisherman’s house. Bird Keeper Keith will challenge you, but after that, you’ll see a small house down to the south. This is where the Fisherman and his wife live.

chunks.t: Part 8: Valley Cave – Route 7
chunks.x: The Fisherman’s wife will heal your Pokemon. After going through two routes full of trainers, a good healing is probably what your Pokémon party needs the most – and the Fisherman’s wife offers it to you. | The Fisherman gives you the Old Rod. Speaking to the Fisherman inside this house will get you the Old Rod, which is the first chance you’ll have to start fishing up Pokémon. It will also let you get any upgrades. | Frost Mountain awaits. After you’ve healed up and got the Old Rod, go back to the entrance of Frost Mountain and head inside., Route 8 and Blizzard City are just ahead.

chunks.t: Part 9: Frost Mountain & Blizzard City – Route 8
chunks.x: Nurse Patty will heal you if you beat her. Like the other Nurses, she will heal you only if you manage to beat her., Once that’s taken care of, heal up and head further north into the icy wilderness. | Youngster Eddie. You’ll find Youngster Eddie, and once you beat him head north up the stairs., Then walk east until you see a blond female trainer. | Battle Girl Jessica. That’s Battle Girl Jessica, and after beating her take note of her location – you’ll have to come back here a bit later., Go north until you find another set of stairs.

chunks.t: Part 9: Frost Mountain & Blizzard City – Route 8
chunks.x: The fork at the top of the stairs. At the fork, turn east and keep going that direction until you see a Black Belt with a mission for you. | The Black Belt gives you a mission to jump off cliffs. He tells you to jump over cliffs 555 times, which might be a tall order. He does take into account any jumps you have made up until this point, however., If you ever manage to complete his mission, your reward is 60 Carbos, which is quite the prize. | After you’ve dealt with that, continue east until you find another staircase leading south. The path will curve around to go west along that lower level. | Stairs leading south. Continue south and you’ll run into Black Belt Mike; once he’s been beaten, walk east from here until you see a frozen pond.

chunks.t: Part 9: Frost Mountain & Blizzard City – Route 8
chunks.x: The frozen pond. The pond is pretty easy to get across, no real puzzle solution required., After you’re on the other side, continue north. | Climb a couple of staircases and continue north. The path will keep going north until you see a series of wooden bridges. | Pass under the bridges. Picnicker Isabelle is on the right side of this little gully, so you can battle or avoid her if you wish., Keep going under the bridges until you see an opportunity to get on the same level as them.

chunks.t: Part 9: Frost Mountain & Blizzard City – Route 8
chunks.x: Cross the bridges. You’ll run into Camper Shane on the way, but eventually after crossing the three wooden bridge spans you’ll come to the western ledge. | Keep heading west. Once you’re on solid rock and snow, keep going west through a couple of patches of long grass until you see an opportunity to go north. | Not far now – Hiker Brice is an optional fight for you towards the west. Head through the narrow passage north and you’ll run into Camper Evans., Once he’s been defeated, continue along the path and it’ll lead you west.

chunks.t: Part 9: Frost Mountain & Blizzard City – Route 8
chunks.x: The final stretch. Keep going west until you run into a fairly large patch of long grass. | This large patch signifies the end of Route 8. Once on the other side of that, the entrance to Blizzard City awaits to the north. | This Skier has a gift for us. Note: On the way in, a Skier doesn’t battle us but gives us a Casteliacone instead.

chunks.t: Part 9: Frost Mountain & Blizzard City – Route 8
chunks.x: Blizzard City at last. After all that trekking across a landscape full of hail, you will have finally made it to Blizzard City. | Items: Moon Stone, Blue Shard, X Defense, Max Repel, Nugget, Icy Rock, Great Ball, Revive, Ether, Lax Incense, Super Potion, Big Pearl, Mago Berry, Protein x60, Trainer Tips sign #18, Zygarde Cell #27, Zygarde Cell #28, Max Raid Den #6, Vivillon pattern Tundra | Special Encounters (Miraheze wiki): Vivillon (Tundra form) Lv50

chunks.t: Part 9: Frost Mountain & Blizzard City – Blizzard City
chunks.x: Blizzard City | Blizzard City map. Lost Kid Mission House, Berry and VS Seeker House, Pokemon Center/Crater Town Taxi, Gym Leader’s House, Thief Mission and Pokedex Upgrade House, Sharp Beak, Poke Mart, Worker Alan, Rock Smash and Pie House, Blizzard Gym. Route 8, KBT Expressway | Items: Revive, Zygarde Cell | Finding the Missing Boy | As soon as you arrive, go to the first house you see.

chunks.t: Part 9: Frost Mountain & Blizzard City – Blizzard City
chunks.x: This first house leads us to a mission. You’ll eventually notice that all the Blizzard City houses are fairly large and full of people to talk to. | Another gift. The Juggler on the ground floor here will give you TM118 Aurora Veil for free, which is nice., There’s also a Black Belt on this floor that will teach you Ice Punch for 2 Blue Shards. | Climb up the stairs to the north and you’ll see a woman who wants to give you a job. | Her brother is missing. The woman’s brother is missing and you’ll need to head back out onto Route 8 to find him., Remember where the blonde-haired trainer was earlier? The kid will now be there, behind a small bush you can cut down.

chunks.t: Part 9: Frost Mountain & Blizzard City – Blizzard City
chunks.x: The kid in the Pikachu costume isn’t camouflaged very well. After you talk to him, he’ll follow you all the way back to Blizzard City. | The sister is grateful. After you’ve returned her brother, the woman gives you TM27 Return, which is kind of appropriate., Once you’ve done all you can in this house, continue west until you find the next one with a door. | The second useful house. This house has a couple of useful things inside, so go on in.

chunks.t: Part 9: Frost Mountain & Blizzard City – Blizzard City
chunks.x: The Vs. Seeker | The Berry woman. There’s a woman on the ground floor who will exchange the Berry she asks for every day for another type of Berry., Head upstairs, and you’ll get a useful item. | The VS Seeker helps you find rematches. The man upstairs gives you the VS Seeker, which will help you find trainers that want to battle you again, useful for training. | Finding the Pokécenter | There’s a Staraptor here that acts like a taxi. West of here is the Pokémon Center, and a free ride to Crater Town from a Staraptor if that’s what you want.

chunks.t: Part 9: Frost Mountain & Blizzard City – Blizzard City
chunks.x: You can get an Eviolite inside the Pokémon Center. If you show a Pokémon that can still evolve to the Breeder in the Pokémon Center, he’ll give you an Eviolite. This will boost the Defense and Special Defense of a Pokémon that holds it – if it’s not fully evolved. | Ivory makes trouble for us again. Going north to the next ring of houses will show you that Ivory is here and her mission has apparently been a success. She freezes the entrance to the KBT Expressway before leaving. | Visiting More Houses | The third useful house. The next house you’ll need to visit is the Gym Leader’s house, which is on the northwest side of the middle ring of houses.

chunks.t: Part 9: Frost Mountain & Blizzard City – Blizzard City
chunks.x: Alicia will offer to trade. Alicia, the daughter of Gym Leader Alice, will offer to trade us an Electrode holding an Amulet Coin for an Onix. You can catch Onix in Frost Mountain if you’d like to. | Pokémon Trade: Electrode (Electric (holding an Amulet Coin)), Onix (Rock/Ground found in Frost Mountain) | Another house, another mission. Once that’s done, head inside the door on the right side of the middle row of houses and you’ll get another mission. | A stolen Pokémon. On the ground floor you’ll find a woman who has had her Pokémon stolen. Accept her mission for now, and you can complete it in a little while., Then head upstairs and speak to the woman on the couch for a bit of a challenge.

chunks.t: Part 9: Frost Mountain & Blizzard City – Blizzard City
chunks.x: Candice is a foreign Gym Leader on holiday. Candice is a visiting Gym leader from Sinnoh, and she puts up a bit of a fight. | Trainer Visiting Sinnoh Leader Candice: Sneasel (Dark/Ice) Lv28, Piloswine (Ice/Ground) Lv33, Glaceon (Ice) Lv30, Froslass (Ice/Ghost) Lv29. Prize ₽4,640 | Having multiple Pokémon that can take care of Ice-types is essential here, because Candice will switch out Pokémon at will and try and make the battle a lot harder than it needs to be., After beating her, she’ll give you an Ice Gem. You can repeat this every day. | This is where Professor Log’s sister lives. This floor also has Professor Log’s sister on it – Nat Log., She’s the one who upgraded your Rival’s Pokedex, and if you have caught at least 15 Pokémon, she’ll do it for you too.

chunks.t: Part 9: Frost Mountain & Blizzard City – Blizzard City
chunks.x: The DexNav upgrades your Pokedex. Her assistant will handle any questions you may have about its new functions., The other young lady here is Ayla, the Bill of Borrius. She’s the one in charge of Pokémon Storage. | Finding the Mart | The man near the Mart has a present for you. Talk to the man wandering around the Poke Mart and he’ll give you a Sharp Beak, which will come in handy if you have any Flying-type Pokémon., Then, head inside the Mart. | A man inside is a little self-conscious. If you have an Eevee, the blonde woman inside the Mart will give you an Ice Stone if you show it to her.

chunks.t: Part 9: Frost Mountain & Blizzard City – Blizzard City
chunks.x: The Gym is in the northwest part of the city. If you walk to the northwest, you’ll eventually see the Blizzard City Gym and its unique design., Before going inside to beat it though, it’s best you take care of some other things first. | Getting Rock Smash (And Other Tasks) | Northeast is the KBT Expressway entrance. East of the Gym, in the northeast part of town, is where the cutscene showed Ivory earlier. Worker Alan will challenge us to battle his Pokémon, and you can do this as many times as you like. | Trainer Worker Alan: Carbink (Rock/Fairy) Lv26, Nosepass (Rock) Lv26. Prize ₽1,080 | After beating him to your satisfaction, head inside the house here.

chunks.t: Part 9: Frost Mountain & Blizzard City – Blizzard City
chunks.x: The Hiker here gives you your second HM. This is the house of the man you’re supposed to talk to about Rock Smash, and the whole point of trekking up to Blizzard City in the first place., He gives you HM06 Rock Smash as soon as you ask for it. | The last trainer on Route 5. The old lady inside this house gives you a recipe for a pie., After you give her the ingredients she will give you two more sets of ingredients to fetch before giving you a final reward – 3 Gold Bottle Caps. | The burglar heads east of the city entrance. That’s it for Blizzard City for now – you’ve got a missing Pokémon to find., Walking south towards the town entrance will reveal a shady man in a black hat leaving to go east to a deep forest.

chunks.t: Part 9: Frost Mountain & Blizzard City – Blizzard City
chunks.x: The entrance to Frozen Forest. Follow him, and you’ll find the way to Frozen Forest. | Items: Casteliacone, Fresh Water, Flying Gem, TM40 Aerial Ace, TM27 Return, TM118 Aurora Veil, HM06 Rock Smash, Eviolite, Sharp Beak, Revive, Aspear Berry, Ice Stone, Hyper Potion x5, Gold Bottle Cap x3, Ice Gem, VS Seeker, Power Anklet, Eevium Z, Zygarde Cell #29 | Special Encounters (Miraheze wiki): Vulpix (Egg) Lv1

chunks.t: Part 10: Frozen Forest & Blizzard City Gym – Frozen Forest
chunks.x: Frozen Forest map. Crabominable Nest, Burglar Clearing. Blizzard City | Items: Zygarde Cell, Snowball, Aguav Berry (hidden), Ice Stone

chunks.t: Part 10: Frozen Forest & Blizzard City Gym – Frozen Forest
chunks.x: Wild Pokémon [Long Grass]: Snover (Grass/Ice Day and Night) Lv22–25 Day 55% / Night 40%, Cubchoo (Ice Day and Night) Lv22–25 45%, Sneasel (Dark/Ice Night) Lv22–25 Day 0% / Night 15% | The overcast and foreboding Frozen Forest. You’re in Frozen Forest to look for a woman’s stolen Pokémon. There’s not much to do here except follow the path, with a couple of exceptions. | The lair of a fierce Pokemon. Just to the north of the entrance is a strange sight – the lair of a giant scary Crabominable, which you can get into by using Cut on the small trees. It’s asleep though, for now.

chunks.t: Part 10: Frozen Forest & Blizzard City Gym – Frozen Forest
chunks.x: Following the path around. The only thing to do here to progress is take the west path and circle it around., There aren’t any trainers waiting to challenge you, just the occasional patch of long grass. | Frozen Forest Ice Puzzle | The Frozen Forest Ice Puzzle. Continue until you see a large patch of ice – this is an ice sliding puzzle., Follow the instructions below to get to the other side:

chunks.t: Part 10: Frozen Forest & Blizzard City Gym – Frozen Forest
chunks.x: From the southernmost land tile, slide east onto the ice, Slide down, Slide right, Slide up off the ice, Obtain the Ice Stone, Slide down back onto the ice, Slide left, Slide up, Slide left, Slide down, Slide left, Slide down, Slide right, Slide down and off the ice | The destination of the ice puzzle. You will land near the entrance to a clearing – this is where the missing Pokémon is.

chunks.t: Part 10: Frozen Forest & Blizzard City Gym – Frozen Forest
chunks.x: The Missing Pokémon | Confronting the Burglar. As soon as you arrive in the clearing, the Burglar confronts you with the woman’s missing Alolan Ninetales, as well as his other Pokémon. | Trainer Burglar Jett: Alolan Ninetales (Ice/Fairy) Lv27, Mightyena (Dark) Lv28 | The Crabominable appears. After you beat him though, there’s a problem – the Crabominable has woken up and has decided to attack you! | Pokémon Encounter: Crabominable (Fighting/Ice) Lv32 | Note: The Crabominable can be caught, and this is the only opportunity in this game for you to get one.

chunks.t: Part 10: Frozen Forest & Blizzard City Gym – Frozen Forest
chunks.x: The woman is grateful. When you return to Blizzard City with the woman’s Alolan Ninetales, she gives you one of its Eggs as a reward. It will eventually hatch into an Alolan Vulpix. | Egg Pokémon: Alolan Vulpix (Ice) Lv1 | The Blizzard City gym is in the northwest part of the city. Now that you’re back in town, it’s time to finally challenge the Gym and earn the right to use HM Rock Smash! | Items: Snowball, PP Up, Aguav Berry, Ice Stone, Abomasite, Zygarde Cell #30

chunks.t: Part 10: Frozen Forest & Blizzard City Gym – Blizzard Gym – Wings Badge
chunks.x: Blizzard Gym – Wings Badge | The Guide tells you all about the Blizzard Gym. Blizzard City’s Gym is actually a Flying-type Gym, because it’s so high up., Flying-type moves are super effective against Bug-, Fighting-, and Grass-type Pokémon, and Flying-type Pokémon are weak against Electric-, Ice-, and Rock-type moves. | Gym Trainers | Trainer Bird Keeper Wilton: Honchkrow (Dark/Flying) Lv27, Pelipper (Water/Flying) Lv28. Prize ₽1,680 | Trainer Bird Keeper Edwin: Trumbeak (Normal/Flying) Lv27. Prize ₽1,620 | Trainer Bird Keeper Sebastian: Oricorio ((Pa’u) Psychic/Flying) Lv27, Staravia (Normal/Flying) Lv28. Prize ₽1,680

chunks.t: Part 10: Frozen Forest & Blizzard City Gym – Blizzard Gym – Wings Badge
chunks.x: Trainer Bird Keeper Chester: Doduo (Normal/Flying) Lv27, Murkrow (Normal/Flying) Lv27, Oricorio (Pom-Pom) (Electric/Flying) Lv27. Prize ₽1,620 | Trainer Bird Keeper Perry: Swellow (Normal/Flying) Lv28, Swablu (Normal/Flying) Lv27. Prize ₽1,620 | Trainer Bird Keeper Robert: Starly (Normal/Flying) Lv28, Pikipek (Normal/Flying) Lv28, Spearow (Normal/Flying) Lv28. Prize ₽1,680 | The upper floor of the Gym. The Gym is a series of lower corridors with fans that lead up to platforms on an upper floor. It’s a bit of a maze, and if you take a wrong turn at any point, you’ll have to fight an optional trainer., From the Guide at the entrance, step on the fan directly behind him and you’ll be pushed up to a platform that goes in two directions. | Take the west one, and follow it around until you see a hole you can drop down to.

chunks.t: Part 10: Frozen Forest & Blizzard City Gym – Blizzard Gym – Wings Badge
chunks.x: You arrive at the south fan and need to make your way to the east fan. You’ll drop down in a room with another fan to the east and Bird Keeper Edwin blocking your way., Once you beat him, walk on the east fan and you’ll be on the upper level again. | The correct path is to the north, past Sebastian. Ignore the hole next to the one you came from and walk north to challenge Bird Keeper Sebastian., The path he is on leads to another lower chamber and another fan, which you should follow. | Once you use that next fan, follow the long upper path along until Bird Keeper Perry sees you. | More upper corridors. After him, drop down the next hole you see, cross the lower chamber to another fan, and you’ll be in one final upper level corridor.

chunks.t: Part 10: Frozen Forest & Blizzard City Gym – Blizzard Gym – Wings Badge
chunks.x: Bird Keeper Robert. Bird Keeper Robert is the last trainer you’ll have to beat to get to the Gym Leader. So once you’ve done that just follow the path and head north and drop down to find yourself in her room. | Blizzard City Gym Leader – Alice | Alice is the Flying-type Gym Leader. Alice is a graceful figure, but she doesn’t waste much time before challenging us. | Tip: The table below is only for Alice on Vanilla mode. If you want to see her team comp at a higher difficulty level then visit our Blizzard City Gym page here. | Trainer Gym Leader Alice (Vanilla): Doduo (Normal/Flying) Lv29, Gliscor (Ground/Flying) Lv28, Minior (Fire/Flying) Lv30. Prize ₽5,120

chunks.t: Part 10: Frozen Forest & Blizzard City Gym – Blizzard Gym – Wings Badge
chunks.x: Her team is formidable – if you’ve been relying on Electric-type moves to take down all the Pokémon in this Gym, her Gliscor will give you a rude shock. It’s best to use an Ice move on it. | Your TM prize is Aerial Ace. The Wings Badge is your reward after winning, as is TM40 Aerial Ace. | After You Win | After you beat her, head outside and Alice says she still needs to speak to you about something. | Alice gives you a bit of a Rock Smash tutorial. With her Gliscor using Rock Smash, Alice breaks through the barrier Ivory put up on the KBT Expressway Entrance and tells you that you can use Rock Smash now with her permission.

chunks.t: Part 10: Frozen Forest & Blizzard City Gym – Blizzard Gym – Wings Badge
chunks.x: The new objective. Your new objective is to travel to Fallshore City through the KBT Expressway, but there may be a couple things to take care of first. | Alice gives you a mission. Tip: Go back to Alice and she’ll ask you to collect 20 Pretty Wings from Wingull or Pelipper – it’s an item they all hold, but unless you capture each one, you’ll need to use a move such as Knock Off or Thief to get them. If you manage to do this, you’ll get a Power Anklet. | Optional: Rock Smash Backtracking | Time to use Rock Smash. Now that you’re allowed to use it, Rock Smash will be very useful to you., Before heading into the KBT Expressway, you may want to backtrack to previous routes to get a few optional items:

chunks.t: Part 10: Frozen Forest & Blizzard City Gym – Optional: Rock Smash Backtracking
chunks.x: Items: PP Up, Shiny Stone (hidden), Heart Scale, Razor Fang, Nevermeltice, Rare Candy | Items: Dawn Stone, Quick Ball, Full Heal, Fire Stone, Burn Heal, Nugget

chunks.t: Part 10: Frozen Forest & Blizzard City Gym – Optional: Rock Smash Backtracking
chunks.x: Items: Fire Gem (defeat Ace Trainer Alexa) | Trainer Ace Trainer Alexa: Breloom (Grass/Fighting) Lv30, Gardevoir (Psychic/Fairy) Lv31, Magmar (Fire) Lv30, Sealeo (Ice/Water) Lv31, Florges (Fairy) Lv31 | Return to KBT Expressway | The Blizzard City entrance of the KBT Expressway. When you’re ready, head into the KBT Expressway., You’ll see a man in this section of the tunnel – he’s another Gem Family member with a trade for you. There are two more that are accessible to you right now, as well:

chunks.t: Part 10: Frozen Forest & Blizzard City Gym – Return to KBT Expressway
chunks.x: Gem Family Move Shops – Part 2 | Break these rocks to be free. To access the rest of the Expressway, smash your way through the rocks to the east. | Return to Crater Town. Make your way through the Expressway to Crater Town, and head to the south exit., This time, you won’t be jumped by Shadow Grunts.

chunks.t: Part 10: Frozen Forest & Blizzard City Gym – Return to KBT Expressway
chunks.x: More rocks to smash. You can now clear the barrier to the south of this tunnel. Head for the Fallshore City exit. | The route we want to take. Once you find it, head outside and you’ll find yourself in Fallshore City. | Jax tries to battle Ivory again. The first thing you’ll see as you exit is Jax, who is trying to beat Ivory in a battle again. It doesn’t work out well for him.

chunks.t: Part 10: Frozen Forest & Blizzard City Gym – Return to KBT Expressway
chunks.x: Time to explore another town. Once that’s over with, it’s time to explore Fallshore City.

chunks.t: Gym 3: Blizzard City Gym (Alice) – Wings Badge, Flying
chunks.x: The Blizzard City Gym is the third gym you’ll encounter in Pokemon Unbound. The gym leader, Alice, specializes in Flying-type Pokemon., For ideal moves to counter this gym you’d want Ice, Rock, and Electric-type Pokemon. Blizzard City Gym Puzzle: This gym’s puzzle contains several fans and holes in the ground, both of which help you teleport to different sections of the building. The goal here is to find the correct combination of paths that lead to Alice., Here’s a step-by-step tutorial on how to complete the gym puzzle successfully., Step 1: From the entrance, walk straight up and head onto the first fan at the top of the room., Step 2: On this new floor, head to the left and walk into the hole in the ground there., Step 3: Now back on the ground floor, walk into the fan located at the far-right end of this room., There is a Trainer guarding the path here. If you time your run correctly, this Trainer can be skipped, making the battle optional., Step 4: After using that fan, use the hole in the floor next to you to warp to the next location., Step 5: From here, head to the end of this room and use the fan located on the upper side., Step 6: There are now two paths on this upper floor area. Go straight up where there’s a Trainer guarding the path – this battle is not optional., After defeating the Bird Keeper trainer, stay on the same path until you reach the next hole in the floor at the end of the room. Go down it., Step 7: In this new area, follow the corridor down and walk onto the fan at the other side of the room., Step 8: You’ll be teleported up to a long corridor., Make your way through the narrow path until you reach the end. An unavoidable Trainer guards the area here., After this battle, head towards the end of the pathway and walk into the hole in the center of that small room., Step 9: Back down on the lower level, follow the path left to the end of this room where you’ll find another fan. Use this fan to head back up to the upper floor., Step 10: Now walk down and fall through the hole on the floor opposite to you., Step 11: You’ll find yourself on the ground floor again. Use the fan to your left to go back up., Step 12: Now follow the path straigh

chunks.t: Part 11: Fallshore City & Route 11 – Fallshore City
chunks.x: Fallshore City | Fallshore City map. Meeting Jax, Poke Mart, Togepi Egg House, Hidden Power House, Mission HQ, Inverse Battle House, Pokemon Center, Fallshore Market, Fallshore Gym, Evolution House. KPT Expressway, Route 10, (north) Route 11, (south) Fallshore Beach

chunks.t: Part 11: Fallshore City & Route 11 – Fallshore City
chunks.x: Items: Zygarde Cell, Heart Scale, Lemonade, Full Heal (hidden), Zygarde Cell (Fallshore Beach) | Wild Pokémon [Surfing]: Tentacool (Water) Lv35–40 60%, Tentacruel (Water/Poison) Lv38–40 5%, Pelipper (Water/Flying) Lv35–40 30%, Pyukumuku (Water) Lv37–40 5%

chunks.t: Part 11: Fallshore City & Route 11 – Fallshore City
chunks.x: Wild Pokémon [Fishing]: Magikarp (Water (Old Rod)) Lv10–15 100%, Remoraid (Water (Good Rod)) Lv20–25 60%, Carvanha (Water (Good Rod)), Luvdisc (Water (Good Rod)) Lv20–50 20%, Luvdisc (Water (Super Rod)) Lv20–50 20%, Octillery (Water (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 40%, Sharpedo (Water/Dark (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 40% | Jax is a little embarrassed. You just emerged from the KBT Expressway to see Jax thrown into the water by Ivory of the Shadow., When you head south a little into town, Jax talks to you and is keen to put the whole thing behind him. | Your new objective is set. He has a job to do on Route 9, but can’t get there because of the barrier., He asks you to help him out before you head to Thundercap Mountain. | There’s apparently a secret way to get to Route 9 from Tehl Town, and Tehl Town is west of Fallshore City along Route 10.

chunks.t: Part 11: Fallshore City & Route 11 – Fallshore City
chunks.x: Exploring the City | The Pokémon Center and Poke Mart. For now though, you can explore town and do a few things. Heading down that south street will bring you right in the middle of everything., Take the opportunity to heal your Pokémon, and do some shopping at the Poke Mart. | Then walk east and you’ll find a couple of houses. | The two house entrances side by side. Go inside the house on the left, and you’ll see an old lady who wants to give you something special. | Another Egg to hatch. She gives you a Pokémon Egg for free – remember to make sure you have an open Pokémon slot on your team to receive it. It will eventually hatch into a Togepi.

chunks.t: Part 11: Fallshore City & Route 11 – Fallshore City
chunks.x: Egg Pokémon: Togepi (Fairy) Lv1 | After you’ve gotten the Egg, go next door and speak to the man inside to get TM10 Hidden Power. | The house on the right also has a gift for you. Then walk outside and go back west along that road until you pass the Pokémon Center. | There are two important buildings here, and the marketplace is to the south. There is an entrance to a marketplace to the south, but just above it are two buildings that can be useful to you., Go inside the west building first – this is Mission HQ.

chunks.t: Part 11: Fallshore City & Route 11 – Fallshore City
chunks.x: The Ranger in charge of Mission HQ. The man just inside the door is the Ranger in charge of missions in Borrius. If you’ve completed 5 or more missions at this point, he’ll give you a Trainer Catalogue. | The Trainer Catalogue. This item is quite useful for keeping track of trainers you may have missed, and will come in handy for the additional mission he gives you, which is to defeat all of the trainers in Borrius., If you manage this feat, you’ll get a Latiosite or a Latiasite depending if your character is male or female. | Completing more missions and handing them in to the Ranger will give you an opportunity to catch Latios and Latias. | This building is full of missions as well. Inside the room behind the Ranger is a man who would like to see a particular Flying-type Pokémon – it’s random., If you show him the one he wants to see four days in a row, he’ll give you 50 Swift Wings. | Then just east of the Ranger, sitting on a bench, is a policeman who wants you to help kick the Terror Granbull gang out of Route 10. You’ll be able to do this mission in due course.

chunks.t: Part 11: Fallshore City & Route 11 – Fallshore City
chunks.x: The policeman wants the Terror Granbull gone. There’s one more mission in this building, and if you go upstairs and talk to the lady there, she’ll give it to you — it’s called Abandonment Issues. | Upstairs you get given a very bizarre mission. Be warned, this one is quite strange., You need to go and find her missing daughter, but every time you try and bring her back she gets blown away by the wind. After the first time she blows away you’ll have to go back to her mother empty-handed, and she says she can’t have gone far. | Here’s a complete list of the daughter’s locations and how to find her for this mission:

chunks.t: Part 11: Fallshore City & Route 11 – Fallshore City
chunks.x: Items: First Spot In the middle section of the beach, Second Spot Top left of Fallshore Market, Third Spot In front of Evolution House, Fourth Spot Northeast corner of Fallshore City, Final Spot In front of Mission HQ | After finding the girl for the fifth and final time, her mother will be so grateful she will give you a Power Belt. Then, something strange will happen, but that is best kept as a surprise. | Your reward. The house to the right of the Mission HQ is the Inverse Battle House, so go there next.

chunks.t: Part 11: Fallshore City & Route 11 – Fallshore City
chunks.x: Inverse Battle House | The Inverse Battle House is a bit of a challenge. Inverse Battles are special – in these, type matchups are reversed. What would be super effective to a type of Pokémon is now not very effective, and vice versa., The four trainers inside can be battled as many times as you wish, so it’s great for training. | Inverse Battles | Trainer Beauty Bridget: Cinccino (Normal) Lv30, Furret (Normal) Lv30, Sunflora (Grass) Lv30, Florges (Fairy) Lv30. Prize ₽960 | Trainer Roughneck Koji: Herdier (Normal) Lv30, Machamp (Fighting) Lv30, Shiftry (Grass/Dark) Lv30. Prize ₽840 | Trainer Scientist Connor: Manectric (Electric) Lv30, Ampharos (Electric) Lv30, Probopass (Rock/Steel) Lv30, Electabuzz (Electric) Lv30. Prize ₽1,440

chunks.t: Part 11: Fallshore City & Route 11 – Fallshore City
chunks.x: Trainer Ace Trainer Mary: Gyarados (Water/Flying) Lv30, Roserade (Grass/Poison) Lv30, Nidoqueen (Poison/Ground) Lv30, Steelix (Steel/Ground) Lv30, Simipour (Water) Lv30. Prize ₽2,040 | The Marketplace | Once you’ve had enough of that, you can go south to the Marketplace. | There are many different shops here. At the Marketplace there is a: | TM Shop, Rare Berry shop, Stat Item shop, And a Galarian Evolution Item shop | There is also a stall to the southeast that sells Moomoo Milk per bottle or per dozen – it is highly recommended to buy at least a dozen, because it’s a useful healing item and you may need to do a lot of on-the-spot healing in future.

chunks.t: Part 11: Fallshore City & Route 11 – Fallshore City
chunks.x: The Gym is closed right now. The Fallshore Gym is east of the Marketplace, but when you go there you’ll find the door blocked., Apparently the Gym Leader is off doing something, so you’ll need to come back later. | The Evolution House | Evolution House. If you keep going east, you’ll eventually hit a building called Evolution House. | Speaking to the Evolution Master. The woman in the kitchen downstairs is the Evolution Master, and if you show a Pokémon to her she can tell you if it can evolve, and if so, at what level or what kind of method is needed., The man near the stairs will give you a Link Stone, which will evolve any Pokémon who in normal Pokémon games only evolved when traded.

chunks.t: Part 11: Fallshore City & Route 11 – Fallshore City
chunks.x: The Everstone NPC upstairs. Upstairs, showing the girl here a Happiny will get you an Oval Stone., There’s also a man here who apparently hates Evolution, and he gives you an Everstone if you show him a Pokémon that does not evolve. | Fallshore Beach | Fisherman Elliot. There’s only one more place to go in Fallshore Town, and that’s the beach., The beach extends to the east, where you’ll find an item and a trainer to battle. | Trainer Fisherman Elliot: Mareanie (Poison/Water) Lv29, Whiscash (Water/Ground) Lv30, Sharpedo (Water/Dark) Lv30, Lanturn (Water/Electric) Lv30

chunks.t: Part 11: Fallshore City & Route 11 – Fallshore City
chunks.x: East of Fallshore Town is Route 11. Your instructions were to go to Route 10 to the west, but in order to simplify things for the future and to get a bit more training in, it’s best you head east to Route 11 for now. | Items: Link Stone, Everstone, Fresh Water, Normal Gem, TM42 Facade, TM106 Smart Strike, TM29 Psychic, TM10 Hidden Power, Heart Scale, Oval Stone, Lemonade, Silk Scarf, Shed Shell, Nugget, Fast Ball, Swift Wing x50, Power Belt, Lucky Egg x2, Premier Ball x200, PP Max x10, Latiasite, Latiosite, Steelixite, Shiny Charm, Big Nugget x20, Zygarde Cell #39, Vivillon pattern Fancy

chunks.t: Part 11: Fallshore City & Route 11 – Fallshore City

Pokemon Rangers Jackson & Beth, Fisherman Ned, Fisherman Chip, Fisherman Hank. Fallshore City, Cliff Cave, Requires HM Rock Climb, Epidimy Town

chunks.t: Part 11: Fallshore City & Route 11 – Route 11
chunks.x: A Double Battle in the long grass, and a Fisherman on the pier. Route 11 is very linear, and mostly consists of a long wooden bridge. There are a few Pokémon you can catch here, and the trainers are worth battling. | Fisherman Chip. When you walk past Fisherman Chip, you’ll soon see that the pier branches off to a cave entrance to the north. | Cliff Cave entrance. This is the entrance to Cliff Cave, but it’s not worth going in there yet until we can use HM Strength., Continue on to the east.

chunks.t: Part 11: Fallshore City & Route 11 – Route 11
chunks.x: Epidimy Town awaits. At the end of the route is Epidimy Town, and there’s a few things that you will need to pick up here before continuing on your journey. | Items: Iapapa Berry, Max Elixir, Calcium, Rare Bone, Yellow Shard, Roseli Berry, Ultra Ball, Rare Candy, TM65 Shadow Claw, Dusk Stone, Nugget, Electric Seed, Zygarde Cell #40, Zygarde Cell #41, Zygarde Cell #42, Trainer Tips sign #22, Portal #11, Tapu Koko, Max Raid Den #01

chunks.t: Part 12: Epidimy Town & Route 10 – Epidimy Town
chunks.x: Wild Pokémon [Fishing]: Magikarp (Water (Old Rod)) Lv10–15 100%, Barboach (Water/Ground (Good Rod)) Lv20–25 80%, Luvdisc (Water (Good Rod)) Lv20–50, Luvdisc (Water (Super Rod)) Lv20–50, Whiscash (Water/Ground (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 40% | Wild Pokémon [Rock Smash]: Geodude (Rock/Ground), Graveler (Rock/Ground) | The gate to Epidimy Town. After crossing Route 11, you’ll find yourself in Epidimy Town., You’ll also come here after helping Jax, but it’s better if you accomplish a few things here first in order to save time.

chunks.t: Part 12: Epidimy Town & Route 10 – Epidimy Town
chunks.x: Exploring for Items | The first house has something important in it. As soon as you enter town, go to the first house you see., There are two people inside, and they both have something useful for you. | The Battle Girl wants to trade. The woman in here would like to trade a Hitmontop for a Lickitung, which can be caught on Route 5 relatively easily. | Pokémon Trade: Hitmontop ((holding Protect Pads)), Lickitung (found on Route 5)

chunks.t: Part 12: Epidimy Town & Route 10 – Epidimy Town
chunks.x: The Black Belt gives you another HM. The other person inside this house is another HM move keeper, and with no prompting at all he gives you HM04 Strength., However, you can’t use it yet because you haven’t beaten the Fallshore Gym Leader. | Getting it now saves time because it means when you do finally beat him you can use Strength immediately., Once you leave the house, go north and a woman wandering around will give you 3 Ultra Balls to help with Pokémon catching. | A gift for us, north of the Strength house. The Poke Mart is on the north side of town, right near an entrance to the KBT Expressway. | The north side of Epidimy. Head into the house in between them.

chunks.t: Part 12: Epidimy Town & Route 10 – Epidimy Town
chunks.x: Route 5 starts here. The female trainer in the house gives you the Rocky Helmet, which can be very useful if held by the right Pokémon. | This section is still blocked off. You can’t go very far into the KBT Expressway because the way is blocked by a bunch of Strength boulders. However, there is a Gem Family vendor here for now. | Gem Family Move Shops | Taking a break on the bench. Just east of the north cliff area is a Gentleman on a park bench; sitting down on the bench next to him will give you a random status healing item, such as an Awakening or a Parlyz Heal., In the northeast part of town is the Pokémon Center, but the house in this area is where the Move Deleter lives.

chunks.t: Part 12: Epidimy Town & Route 10 – Epidimy Town
chunks.x: The Move Deleter’s house. Very useful NPC to know about if you’d like a Pokémon to forget a particular move., Head south a little and you’ll see a couple of houses next to each other. | There are two houses side by side in the middle of town. First, go ahead and enter in the one on the left. | This old couple has something very valuable. There’s a couple of old people living here, and they have one very important item – the Master Ball., However, they will not give it to you unless you show them the Pokémon Hoopa. | Tip: Hoopa is not available to you until much later, but it is the Pokémon that has been throwing you through portals all this time., A fisherman lives in the house next to them, and if you’ve got the Old Rod then he gives you the Good Rod!

chunks.t: Part 12: Epidimy Town & Route 10 – Epidimy Town
chunks.x: This fisherman has an upgrade. Now you can catch far more than just Magikarp., Speaking to the old man wandering nearby will give you a mission to find an empty house for him. | The old man in front of the Pokemon Center needs help. You can’t complete this just now, but you will be able to in due course. | The house in the southeast corner. Just south of him is the final house with something interesting inside it – head on in.

chunks.t: Part 12: Epidimy Town & Route 10 – Epidimy Town
chunks.x: You can come back every day. The woman in the house gives you 3 Max Repels, and if you come back every day she’ll give you three more., Very useful for all the travel you’ve been doing. | The entrance to Thundercap Mountain, at last. At the very southeast corner of town is the entrance to Thundercap Mountain and the lair of Zapdos., Remember this for later, because you will need to come back here after helping Jax. | Leaving Town | Now that you’ve gotten everything useful from Epidimy Town, head back west along Route 11, through Fallshore City and out of the west entrance to Route 10.
