chunks.t: Part 12: Epidimy Town & Route 10 – Route 10
chunks.x: Route 10 begins here. When you exit Fallshore City to the west, the rain continues but the season has changed., There is a large group of Terror Granbull goons to the south, so go ahead and confront them. | The policeman intervenes. Just when it looks like you’ve bitten off more than you can chew, the policeman who gave you the mission steps in and tries to arrest the group of goons., However, they take the opportunity to run away. | You’ll have to track them down in order to finish the mission., Once they’re gone, go west along the bridge and you’ll find yourself in Route 10 proper. | Head west. Keep going along the path.

chunks.t: Part 12: Epidimy Town & Route 10 – Route 10
chunks.x: Camper Chris. Camper Chris is waiting to challenge you; after you beat him you can continue along the path., You’ll eventually come to a river with some stones in it. | Cross the stones. You can jump across the stones to the other side no problem., Once you’re there, walk north, and you’ll transition into a small part of the neighboring route, Auburn Waterway. | The first Goon is here. On the very tip of this little peninsula is the first Terror Granbull Goon you have to defeat., As soon as you do, the policeman shows up to take him away to jail. | Trainer Terror Granbull Goon #1: Snubbull (Fairy) Lv30

chunks.t: Part 12: Epidimy Town & Route 10 – Route 10
chunks.x: When he’s been caught, head south back into Route 10 proper and cross the bridge. | Crossing the bridge. You’ll run into Hiker Dudley along the way., You’ll be turned around to the west, to cross another bridge. | School Kid Herman and Painter Leonardo. After defeating the two trainers in this corner of the route, you’ve got two choices: north or south., South leads to Tehl Town and Route 9 to help Jax. | North, however, leads to the other Terror Granbull Goons you need to capture. So it’s important you head in that direction first. | The entrance to a small side section of two routes. Walking north will again put you in Auburn Waterway, with a slightly different set of Pokémon to catch., Follow the tree line until you see a path through them to the west.

chunks.t: Part 12: Epidimy Town & Route 10 – Route 10
chunks.x: Items: Macho Brace, Quick Ball, Green Shard, Muscle Band, TM54 False Swipe, Damp Rock, Blue Shard, Dawn Stone, Max Elixir, Trainer Tips sign #20, Trainer Tips sign #21, Zygarde Cell #34, Zygarde Cell #35, Max Raid Den #8 | Special Encounters (Miraheze wiki): Smeargle (Special encounter) Lv29 | Granbull Goon Search | This area may look confusing but it’s actually just one long path. The following area is part of Auburn Waterway and Route 9, but doesn’t actually connect to the major part of either of them. So it is its own little self-contained section.

chunks.t: Part 12: Epidimy Town & Route 10 – Granbull Goon Search
chunks.x: Items: Max Repel, Fire Stone, Yellow Shard | Trainer Granbull Goon #2: Snubbull (Fairy) Lv30 | Trainer Granbull Goon #3: Snubbull (Fairy) Lv30 | Trainer Granbull Goon #4: Snubbull (Fairy) Lv30

chunks.t: Part 12: Epidimy Town & Route 10 – Granbull Goon Search

chunks.t: Part 12: Epidimy Town & Route 10 – Granbull Goon Search
chunks.x: Wild Pokémon (Route 9) [Long Grass]: Spearow (Normal/Flying Day and Night), Grubbin (Bug Day and Night), Marill (Water/Fairy Day and Night), Deerling (Normal/Grass Day and Night), Shroomish (Grass Day and Night), Skorupi (Poison/Bug Day and Night), Audino (Normal Day and Night) | Wild Pokémon (Route 9) [Surfing]: Marill (Water/Fairy), Azumarill (Water/Fairy), Surskit (Bug/Water), Masquerain (Bug/Flying) | Wild Pokémon (Route 9) [Fishing]: Magikarp (Water (Old Rod)), Wishiwashi (Water (Good Rod)), Goldeen (Water (Good Rod)), Wishiwashi (Water (Super Rod)), Bruxish (Water/Psychic (Super Rod)), Seaking (Water (Super Rod)), Gyarados (Water/Flying (Super Rod))

chunks.t: Part 12: Epidimy Town & Route 10 – Granbull Goon Search
chunks.x: Continue west and then south. Follow the only route you can, west and then south, until you see two small trees that need to be cut down. | The trees mark the transition into Route 9. When you move past them, you’ll be notified that you’re in Route 9., Keep going west and then north until you see the opportunity to jump off a ledge to the east. | Jump off one ledge to get to the second Goon. When you do, you’ll see the next Goon you need to capture just to the north., The policeman will show up just like last time to take him to jail. | After that’s done, jump one ledge to the east and head through the long grass to the north.

chunks.t: Part 12: Epidimy Town & Route 10 – Granbull Goon Search
chunks.x: The curvy fork in the road. Follow the long grass until you see a curvy fork in the road., Take the left path. | The third goon. This fork leads straight to the next Goon to defeat, and the policeman will come and collect him as well., Just one more to find in this area. | Go back south, ignoring the other forks (unless you want a couple of extra items), until you get to the west-east corridor with the ledges you came from. | More ledge jumping. Jump two ledges to the east until you see a north-south corridor through the trees., Follow the long grass north and then east and you’ll see the final Goon.

chunks.t: Part 12: Epidimy Town & Route 10 – Granbull Goon Search
chunks.x: The final Goon is caught. The policeman will show up one last time after you’ve beaten the Goon to tell you to meet him back on Route 10, where you first broke up the gang. | Granbull Boss Battle | The boss is pretty mad. When you arrive, the boss of the gang shows up to teach you a lesson. | Trainer Terror Granbull Boss Gruff: Probopass (Rock/Steel) Lv32, Ariados (Bug/Poison) Lv33, Crawdaunt (Water/Dark) Lv33, Granbull (Fairy) Lv34 | When you beat Gruff, he’ll make a run for it and head to Seaport City, with the policeman promising to follow him., Your reward for cleaning up this whole mess is TM106 Smart Strike.

chunks.t: Part 12: Epidimy Town & Route 10 – Granbull Goon Search
chunks.x: Your reward | Onwards to Tehl Town | After that mission is completed, you’re free to head back west and take the southern fork to Tehl Town. | Tehl Town awaits. There’s a hidden entrance to Route 9 in Tehl Town, and it’s your job to find it.

chunks.x: Tehl Town map. Poke Mart, Name Rater, Dowsing Machine House, Quick Ball Lady, Pokémon Center, Underground Pass, (after Shadow Battle) Fallshore Gym Leader. Route 10, KPT Expressway, Route 9 | Items: Big Mushroom, Zygarde Cell

chunks.t: Part 13: Tehl Town & Route 9 – Tehl Town
chunks.x: Wild Pokémon [Surfing]: Marill (Water/Fairy) Lv35–40 60%, Azumarill (Water/Fairy) Lv37–40 5%, Psyduck (Water) Lv35–40 30%, Golduck (Water) Lv38–40 5% | Wild Pokémon [Fishing]: Magikarp (Water (Old Rod)) Lv10–15 100%, Wishiwashi (Water (Good Rod)) Lv20–50, Goldeen (Water (Good Rod)) Lv20–25 20%, Wishiwashi (Water (Super Rod)) Lv20–50, Seaking (Water (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 30%, Gyarados (Water (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 19%, Bruxish (Water/Psychic (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 1% | The entrance to Tehl Town. chunks.t: Part 13: Tehl Town & Route 9 – Tehl Town
chunks.x: The Tehl Town Poke Mart, with the Name Rater’s house to the southwest. Speaking to the man with blonde hair inside here will get you a Water Stone, useful for evolving Water Pokémon. | Route 5 starts here. Southwest of the Mart is the house of the Name Rater. | The Name Rater. The Name Rater is useful if you want to change the nickname of any Pokémon you have.

chunks.t: Part 13: Tehl Town & Route 9 – Tehl Town
chunks.x: The researcher’s house. This is where one of Professor Log’s researchers lives, and if you go visit her you’ll get a very useful item to use on your travels. | The Dowsing Machine. However, she’ll need to see that you’ve caught 30 Pokémon before giving you the Dowsing Machine., This key item will lead you to find hidden items and will be extremely useful in an upcoming area. | The other scientist in this house gives you a mission to show him all four seasonal forms of Sawsbuck. | Route 5 starts here

chunks.t: Part 13: Tehl Town & Route 9 – Tehl Town
chunks.x: Tip: The only way to get a Sawsbuck is to train a Deerling up to Lv.34. | You’ve encountered three forms of Deerling in the wild so far – Spring in Route 6, Winter in Route 8, and Autumn in Route 9., When you reach Route 12 in a little while you’ll see a Summer Deerling, and then you can complete the collection., As a reward, the scientist will offer to change the Nature of any Pokémon on your team for free, but then charge you P50000 for any additional change., Speaking to the woman to the north (outside near the Pokecenter) will get us 5 Quick Balls. | The woman to the north has items for us. North of the Pokémon Center is a set of stairs that lead down into an open grassy courtyard. | Another KBT Expressway entrance. The entrance to the KBT Expressway is here, but if you go inside you’ll get a little bit of a nasty surprise.

chunks.t: Part 13: Tehl Town & Route 9 – Tehl Town
chunks.x: Advancing the Story | Blocked by the Shadow. Just like the route west to Route 9, the path is blocked by a whole bunch of Shadow Grunts., However, in this section there is a Gem Family member you can visit. | Gem Family Move Shops | The only way to get out of town is to go to the northeast house in Tehl Town and head inside. | The Underground Pass house. You’ll see a staircase leading down to the Underground Pass.

chunks.t: Part 13: Tehl Town & Route 9 – Tehl Town

Def, X Speed, Dire Hit, Guard Spec., Antidote, Paralyze Heal, Burn Heal, Ice Heal, Awakening, Ether, Hyper Potion, Zygarde Cell #33 | Underground Pass | The Pass entrance. The Underground Pass is just one long path, and there’s no wild Pokémon here to battle.

chunks.t: Part 13: Tehl Town & Route 9 – Underground Pass
chunks.x: Route 5 starts here. Speaking to the man just inside the entrance will let you participate in a bit of a speed challenge – he’ll give you a prize if you can make it to the other side of the Pass in under 15 seconds, with another prize on offer for under 10 seconds., Both are impossible without the Motorcycle, and pretty tricky even with it. | This man gives you a hidden item mission. About halfway through the tunnel is a man who will give you a mission to find at least 150 hidden items., If you succeed, you’ll get a Gold Bottle Cap. | There are a ton of hidden items in this tunnel. The Underground Pass is littered with hidden items, and they’re best found using the Dowsing Machine., Activate it, follow the arrows in the top left of the screen and then search when you see a star pop up. | Underground Pass Hidden Items

chunks.t: Part 13: Tehl Town & Route 9 – Underground Pass
chunks.x: Route 5 starts here. If you were fast enough through the tunnel, the man gives you a prize., The challenge resets every day – they’re a random stat-boosting Vitamins item (HP Up, Protein, Iron, Calcium, Zinc, Carbos). | The end of the Underground Pass. Heading up the stairs at the far end of the tunnel will get you to a small clearing in the middle of an autumnal forest.

chunks.x: This second clearing leads to Route 9 proper. The first person you see as you emerge from the trees is a Grunt, who challenges you straight away. | You’ll get into a fight almost immediately. After you beat him, Jax shows up, wanting to join our party. | Jax arrives to offer his services. If we accept, we’ll only be able to use our first three Pokémon and every battle will be a Double Battle. Jax’s Pokémon are a Staraptor, a Magneton and a Gastrodon., If you want more flexibility though, it’s best to decline his offer. He’ll show up later when you need him.

chunks.t: Part 13: Tehl Town & Route 9 – Route 9
chunks.x: Head south at first. Route 9 mainly consists of a looping path around a central lake, and all around here are Shadow Grunts waiting to fight. Heading south first is your best option. | There’s a branch off the loop to the south. When you see the opportunity to follow a break in the path south, do so., You’ll have to beat a Grunt to get past, but it is worth it if you want to beat all the trainers here. | The Chansey offers much-needed healing | Tip: There’s a Chansey here that will heal your team for free, and you’ll probably have to come back to it every so often.

chunks.t: Part 13: Tehl Town & Route 9 – Route 9
chunks.x: To proceed, it’s best to defeat every single Shadow Grunt on this route before heading in for the confrontation with Ivory. Follow the looping path around beating them as you go, extending even to the northern exit to Route 7., Once you’ve done that, go into the long stretch of grass to the west of the lake. | The final trainers are here in this grassy part. There are three Grunts in the long grass – after you make short work of them, look for an entrance into the trees to the east. | The entrance to where Ivory is. This path will take you to the final confrontation with the Shadow in this route. | One more clearing to go. There’s a clearing here with an item blocked by Strength boulders – move past it into another clearing and you’ll see a cozy-looking house.

chunks.t: Part 14: Fallshore Gym – Fallshore Gym – Fall Badge
chunks.x: Fallshore Gym – Fall Badge | The Guide informs you about this Gym’s gimmick. Fallshore Gym is a Normal-type Gym, which means under normal circumstances, Fighting-type moves would work really well here., However, as the Gym Guide tells you, these are not normal circumstances. | All the trainers in the Gym including the leader will challenge you under Inverse Battle rules., This means that what normally would be super-effective is now not very effective, and vice versa., For Normal-types this is a problem because Normal-type moves are not super-effective against any type, so using a Normal-type move against a Normal-type Pokémon would just result in normal move damage even under reverse rules., It’s advisable to just have a team of non-Fighting-type Pokémon with strong moves of any type except Fighting.

The optimal route can be confusing, so please take note of the map above., If you’re having trouble understanding the instructions below, then look at the map above and here’s what to do: follow the red line until it turns into the blue line, then follow the blue line. | Gym Puzzle (Step-by-Step) | Cross the middle line of lily pads. chunks.t: Gym 4: Fallshore City Gym (Mel) – Fall Badge, Normal (Inverse)
chunks.x: The Fallshore City Gym is the 4th Gym you encounter in Pokémon Unbound. The Gym Leader Mel specializes in Normal-type Pokémon, but the gym’s mechanic works with inverse battle rules., Fallshore City Gym is an Inverse Battle area, which means that all Pokémon weaknesses/strengths are reversed., Typically, Normal-type Pokémon are weak against Fighting-types. However under inverse conditions, Normal-type Pokémon will be hit for 2x damage by Ghost-types instead, and fighting will only do 0.5x damage. Fallshore City Gym Puzzle: This Gym contains several islands separated by water. You have to hop on rocks and lily pads to reach different areas of the Gym. A handful of Lapras are also positioned next to waterfalls, facilitating movement through them., Here’s a step-by-step tutorial on how to solve the gym puzzle to reach Mel., Step 1: Fall through the hole in the ground right in front of the Gym’s entrance., Step 2: Skipping the first set of lily pads, walk a few steps towards the west leading to the second set of lily pads., Hop through each of these until you reach the small piece of land with a Trainer guarding the path. This battle cannot be skipped., Step 3: From the 2 paths here, hop on the lily pads heading towards the east. There is a Lapras at the end here which you can ride to traverse through the first waterfall., Step 4: Once you reach the other side, follow the lily pads leading to the left, leading onto a small island with a Trainer on it. This Trainer can be skipped if you time your run correctly, but it’s recommended to battle them to make the path easier to follow., Step 5: From this island, hop on the lily pad to the north with the Lapras in front of it., Riding this Lapras will lead you to another plot of land with a bridge. And to cross the bridge you’ll have to fight an unskippable Trainer battle., Step 6: After the fight, head east across the bridge and use the lily pad at the end to reach the island opposite to you (south)., Step 7: Follow this island along and then at the end of this island, use the lily pads to ride the Lapras facing south towards the waterfall., Step 8: Now follow the lily pads leading towards the eastern side of the room. chunks.x: Trainers (Main Chamber) | Trainer Shadow Grunt: Cacnea (Grass) Lv31, Honchkrow (Dark/Flying) Lv33, Alolan Raticate (Dark/Normal) Lv33. Prize ₽1,280 | Trainer Juggler Randall: Voltorb (Electric) Lv32, Hypno (Psychic) Lv31. Prize ₽1,720 | 3F (Main Chamber) | The third floor entrance. This floor is full of boulders that need to be pushed onto buttons to form stone bridges., Push one across to the east and head across the gap.

chunks.t: Part 15: Thundercap Mountain – Thundercap Mountain – 3F
chunks.x: The nurse will heal you for free. You’ll see a nurse on this island area. And unlike the others, she’ll heal you without needing to beat her first, which is very convenient., After you’re all healed up, walk north and push the boulder there to the west button. | A Shadow Grunt waits on the western side. When you cross the stone here, a Shadow Grunt will challenge you on the other side., Once taken care of, push another stone to the north button. | Head to the passage in the north wall. You’ll see a cavern opening here – go inside it.

chunks.t: Part 15: Thundercap Mountain – Thundercap Mountain – 3F
chunks.x: A short passage through the wall. There’s just a small path through here, with an optional trainer and item to the north., Just head to the other exit and you’ll be on the other side of the main area. | More boulders to push. Once you’re on the other side, just head south – you’ll see a boulder that can be pushed onto either a west or east button., Make sure it gets pushed to the east. | More island-hopping. Continue along the route – it’s straightforward enough at this point that you just need to push one boulder forward at a time, with very few branching paths.

chunks.t: Part 15: Thundercap Mountain – Thundercap Mountain – 3F
chunks.x: The ladder to 4F. The ladder to the fourth floor is in the southeast corner of the chamber., Once you push enough boulders to get there, head on up the ladder. | Thundercap Mountain – 4F | Thundercap Mountain fourth floor map. Main Chamber, Shadow Grunt E, Shadow Grunt F, Healing Chansey, Electivire Chamber, Super Nerd Miguel, Cyclist Issac, Switch Boulder, Electivire Nerd, Electivire Battle. Main Chamber, Ladder Down to 3F (Main Chamber), Ladder Up to 5F, Electivire Chamber, Ladder Down to 3F (Tablet Chamber)

You’re almost at the top, with just one more floor to go before the summit., Luckily, this floor is just one long linear path.

chunks.t: Part 15: Thundercap Mountain – Thundercap Mountain – 4F
chunks.x: Proceed behind the waterfall. Go north and the path will turn west under a waterfall, and beyond it is another Shadow Grunt to fight. | Another Shadow Grunt. After defeating her, continue along to the south and you’ll soon run into another one. | The last trainer blocking the summit. As soon as you beat that one, you’ll see a Chansey which will probably be welcome healing at this point.

chunks.t: Part 15: Thundercap Mountain – Thundercap Mountain – 4F
chunks.x: The ladder to the summit. Climb the ladder and you’ll find yourself at the very top of Thundercap Mountain. | Thundercap Mountain – 5F | Thundercap Mountain summit map. Main Chamber, Shadow Grunt G, Shadow Grunt H, Shadow Grunt I, Shadow Grunt J, Shadow Grunt K, Summit Battle

chunks.t: Part 15: Thundercap Mountain – Thundercap Mountain – 5F
chunks.x: Main Chamber | Items: Thunder Stone, Escape Rope | Trainer Shadow Grunt G: Poochyena (Dark) Lv32, Shiftry (Grass/Dark) Lv33 | Trainer Shadow Grunt H: Swoobat (Psychic/Flying) Lv33, Murkrow (Dark/Flying) Lv32, Golbat (Poison/Flying) Lv33 | Trainer Shadow Grunt I: Phantump (Ghost/Grass) Lv32, Alolan Rattata (Dark/Normal) Lv31, Sneasel (Dark/Ice) Lv33, Sharpedo (Water/Dark) Lv33

chunks.t: Part 15: Thundercap Mountain – Thundercap Mountain – 5F
chunks.x: Trainer Shadow Grunt J: Misdreavus (Ghost) Lv33, Houndour (Dark/Fire) Lv32 | Trainer Shadow Grunt K: Gengar (Ghost/Poison) Lv34, Weavile (Dark/Ice) Lv33 | You’re suddenly in the open, and true to its name, Thundercap Mountain is capped by lightning and thunder., There are no wild Pokémon here, however. | Out in the rain and thunder. Walk north and you’ll be challenged by a Shadow Grunt. After him, there are three paths you can take: | Left, Up the stairs, Right | Head right for now.

chunks.t: Part 15: Thundercap Mountain – Thundercap Mountain – 5F
chunks.x: The right path winds around a bit. Keep going along this path – you’ll go down some stairs, then up some longer stairs, and finally get to where another Shadow Grunt waits for you. | Another Shadow Grunt to fight. After you beat this Grunt, head up the stairs behind her. | Freeing the Captured Pokémon | The captured Pokémon. You’ll see an electric fence with captured Pokémon behind it – you’ll need a special key to disable it., Beat the Grunt here, but don’t continue onward – the path ahead is blocked until you can free those Pokémon.

chunks.t: Part 15: Thundercap Mountain – Thundercap Mountain – 5F
chunks.x: Go back to the beginning and head upstairs. Walk all the way back to the entrance ladder and the first intersection. This time, head up the stairs and keep following the path. | The penultimate Shadow Grunt. You’ll see yet another Shadow Grunt, but luckily for you after him there’s only one more left. | More captured Pokemon. The final Shadow Grunt at the end of the path has the Barrier Key, which you can use to disable the electric fences.

chunks.t: Part 15: Thundercap Mountain – Thundercap Mountain – 5F
chunks.x: Unlock the barrier to release the Pokemon. Free this group of Pokémon here, and you’ll also free the Pokémon on the other side when you do so., Walk all the way back to the other electric fence, and you’ll find that they’ve already started repairing the way forward. | Getting a helping hand. The Pokémon fix the way up to the summit, and you’re now free to climb it and face Marlon. | Zapdos is captured. Zapdos is a little harder to wrangle than Articuno and Moltres, but Marlon eventually manages it. After he does, he sees us and isn’t happy we followed him.

chunks.t: Part 15: Thundercap Mountain – Battle for Zapdos
chunks.x: Battle for Zapdos | Marlon fights you for control of Zapdos. Marlon challenges you to a fight, this time on his own – but he’s got Zapdos. | Shadow Battle | Trainer Shadow Admin Marlon: Zapdos (Electric/Flying) Lv35, Cacturne (Grass/Dark) Lv36, Krookodile (Ground/Dark) Lv37 | He’s got a formidable team, but if you’ve been training on the trainers in Thundercap so far you will have an easier time., Marlon releases Zapdos when he is defeated, which is certainly unexpected. | Marlon is unusually gracious in defeat. With that, you’re instructed to go back to Epidimy Town – but there are a couple of important things to take care of in Thundercap before you leave., Go back to 2F, and head to the elevated platforms with bridges in the middle of the chamber. | There’s another ladder there, and it used to be blocked by a sleeping Shadow Grunt.

chunks.t: Part 15: Thundercap Mountain – Battle for Zapdos
chunks.x: The ladder you need – but there will be no Grunt there this time. The Grunt will be gone, and you are free to climb it to the Tablet Chamber on 3F. | 3F (Tablet Chamber) | This chamber holds one of the ancient tablets | Items: Parlyz Heal (Rock Smash)

chunks.t: Part 15: Thundercap Mountain – 3F (Tablet Chamber)
chunks.x: Trainer Hiker Earl: Cubone (Ground) Lv32, Alolan Geodude (Rock/Electric) Lv33. Prize ₽1,280 | Trainer Ruin Maniac Stanley: Golem (Rock/Ground) Lv34, Lileep (Rock/Grass) Lv32, Anorith (Rock/Bug) Lv32. Prize ₽1,824 | Trainer Shocker Picard: Stunfisk (Ground/Electric) Lv33, Charjabug (Bug/Electric) Lv33. Prize ₽1,280 | You’ll arrive on a raised platform in between an electric fence and an ancient tablet., Walk south across the bridge and then east across another one. | Hiker Earl roams around here, and Ruin Maniac Stanley is below. Hiker Earl will be waiting for you., Once he’s been defeated, cross the north bridge and you’ll see a ladder up to 4F.

chunks.t: Part 15: Thundercap Mountain – 3F (Tablet Chamber)
chunks.x: You won’t be able to make much progress up there yet however, as you need Surf., So instead, walk down the stairs, go under the bridge to the west and you’ll fight Ruin Maniac Stanley. | The ancient tablet gives you a clue. The ancient tablet is north of Stanley, and it gives you the clue “PRESSURE ELSEWHERE IS THE KEY”., You’ll be able to solve half of this puzzle at the moment, when you get to the Electivire Chamber in 4F. | Go back up to the elevated platforms and retrace your steps past Hiker Earl until you get to a bridge leading south. Cross that and head east. | Shocker Picard. You will run into Shocker Picard, and after he challenges you, you’re free to walk on the final bridge to head north. | The ladder to the Electivire Chamber. There is a ladder here that leads to an area of 4F called the Electivire Chamber, and you’ll find out why it’s called that very shortly.

chunks.t: Part 15: Thundercap Mountain – 4F (Electivire Chamber)
chunks.x: 4F (Electivire Chamber) | The Electivire Chamber on 4F | Items: PP Up | Trainer Super Nerd Miguel: Klink (Steel) Lv32, Magneton (Electric/Steel) Lv34, Alolan Geodude (Rock/Electric) Lv32. Prize ₽1,720 | Trainer Cyclist Issac: Hoothoot (Normal/Flying) Lv33, Elekid (Electric) Lv32, Shinx (Electric) Lv32

chunks.t: Part 15: Thundercap Mountain – 4F (Electivire Chamber)
chunks.x: After you climb the ladder, walk south until you see a tiny step up to a raised platform., Head west along it until you see a bridge. | The bridge and Cyclist Issac. As you cross the bridge you’ll be confronted by Cyclist Issac, but he’s not too much trouble., Go past him and you’ll see another bridge to the north. | The strength puzzle – ball in hole. Once you cross that one you’ll see a small area with a Strength boulder and a hole that it needs to be pushed into., To do that, you’ll need to Rock Smash until the path is clear. | Time to push. Pushing the Strength boulder in this hole solves one half of a puzzle we need for the tablet later – you’ll be coming back to this mountain again later to solve the other half.

chunks.t: Part 15: Thundercap Mountain – 4F (Electivire Chamber)
chunks.x: Head back to the east side of the chamber. After you’ve put the boulder in the hole, walk back to the ladder and then take the east passage., You’ll see two tunnels on that side of the chamber blocked by breakable rocks. Head to the north one first. | This Nerd’s in trouble. You’ll see that a trainer’s Electivire is out of control and needs to be wrangled., When you approach, the Electivire runs away, and you’ll have to chase it. | Break this rock and the encounter will start. Go back and break the rock to the south, then head down that passage., Eventually, you’ll come face to face with the unruly Electivire. | Pokémon Encounter: Electivire (Electric non-catchable) Lv44

chunks.t: Part 15: Thundercap Mountain – 4F (Electivire Chamber)
chunks.x: The Nerd is grateful – though someone else is watching. After you defeat it, it goes back in its Poke Ball. Wanting to thank you, the trainer says he will meet you at the Epidimy Pokémon Center to give you a reward. | Leaving | You’ve done all you can in Thundercap Mountain for now., To get outside quickly, use an Escape Rope. If you don’t have one, you’ve got a long walk ahead of you., But either way, the next step is to exit the mountain and head towards Epidimy Town. | Return to Epidimy Town | Jax shows up to tell us where to go next. Now that you’re outside, Jax appears and you tell him all about Zapdos., He says he’s headed to Dehara City next, but that you should go to Tarmigan Mansion first to get the ability to Mega Evolve Pokémon. | But before that, head to the Epidimy Town Pokémon Center to check in on the trainer of the Electivire.

chunks.t: Part 15: Thundercap Mountain – Return to Epidimy Town
chunks.x: The Electivire was stolen. Unfortunately, by the time you get there, the Electivire has been stolen and the trainer can’t give you a reward just yet. You’ll have to find the thief in Seaport City whenever you end up there., So for now, head west on to Route 11 for the next part of your journey. | Onward Through Cliff Cave | The entrance to Cliff Cave. In order to get to Tarmigan Mansion, you’ll have to go through Cliff Cave (pictured above)., This can be accessed through Route 11. | Now that you can use Strength, your way through the cave will be free and clear.

Prize ₽1,248 | Trainer Hiker Lenny: Sudowoodo (Rock) Lv32, Magcargo (Fire/Rock) Lv33, Alolan Graveler (Rock/Electric) Lv32, Steelix (Steel/Ground) Lv32. Prize ₽1,280 | Trainer Bird Keeper Donald: Fearow (Normal/Flying) Lv32, Swablu (Normal/Flying) Lv31. Prize ₽2,580 | Trainer Bird Keeper Benny: Talonflame (Fire/Flying) Lv33. Prize ₽2,580 | Cliff Cave first chamber. To get to Tarmigan Town and its mansion – and the Mega Evolution challenge – you’ll have to go through Cliff Cave, which leads to an upper section of Route 11., The cave chambers are straightforward, with very few twists and turns. Go north and then west up the stairs.

chunks.t: Part 16: Tarmigan Town & Tarmigan Mansion – Cliff Cave and Upper Route 11
chunks.x: The way to the upper part of Route 11. You’ll see a cave exit here – go through it and you’ll be on a cliff ledge. | These boulders are easy to move now. A few Strength boulders block the path, but they’re easily moved., Kindler Cole will challenge us on the way through. | Another cave entrance. Once you get past him, you’ll see stairs to another cliff ledge and an entrance to another Cliff Cave chamber.

chunks.t: Part 16: Tarmigan Town & Tarmigan Mansion – Cliff Cave and Upper Route 11
chunks.x: Head up the ladder. As soon as you enter, go north and you’ll see a ladder to an upper level. Climb it. | The final exit of Cliff Cave. Once you’re up here, go out of the cave and you’ll be on Upper Route 11 proper. | Upper Route 11. There’s a Hiker here, waiting in the long grass to ambush us., After you beat him, walk north.

chunks.t: Part 16: Tarmigan Town & Tarmigan Mansion – Cliff Cave and Upper Route 11
chunks.x: Continue north into a little fenced area. There are two Bird Keepers in the next area – you can fight or evade them if you wish, though the experience may be helpful for the challenges ahead. | Tarmigan Town is ahead. North of them is the end of Route 11 and the entrance to Tarmigan Town.

This is a relatively small and sleepy town, with only a few things to pick up before you head into the mansion. | Two houses north of the entrance are our first stop. Walk north and you’ll see two houses side-by-side – head into the left house first.

chunks.t: Part 16: Tarmigan Town & Tarmigan Mansion – Tarmigan Town
chunks.x: Tim wants to trade. The man in this house will offer you a Pachirisu if you trade him a Manectric. | Pokémon Trade: Pachirisu (Fighting (holding Old Gateau)), Manectric (Electric evolved from Electrike, found on Route 2) | This house will basically teach you Fire Punch for free. In the house on the right, there’s a Kindler who will teach you Fire Punch for 2 Red Shards. However, the old man in this house hates him, so he’ll give you those 2 Red Shards you need if you talk to him., Once you’re done in those two houses, go north. | The Dream Scientist. You’ll see a weird building here – this is the Dream Research Lab., Speak to the Scientist waiting outside and he’ll give you a Dream Mist.

chunks.t: Part 16: Tarmigan Town & Tarmigan Mansion – Tarmigan Town
chunks.x: You can then head inside the Dream Lab, and speak to one of the scientists inside and she’ll give you TM85 Dream Eater. | The Dream Research Lab. The Pokémon Center and Poke Mart are in the middle of town – head there next. | The central part of town. There’s an old man with an Abra inside the Pokémon Center who will offer to teleport you to the bridge on Route 11 outside the south entrance of Cliff Cave., Helpful if you ever need it. | The man and his Abra. Northeast of the Pokémon Center is a house with a boy inside suffering from nightmares – there’s nothing to do here for now but you will need to come back here in the endgame., Go east, and the next building you will see is Tarmigan Inn.

chunks.t: Part 16: Tarmigan Town & Tarmigan Mansion – Tarmigan Town
chunks.x: Tarmigan Inn is closed. However, it’s been closed for a while., Head north from there and you’ll see Tarmigan Mansion. | Tarmigan Mansion. You’ve finally made it to the mansion, which is the next part of your Pokémon journey., Once you’ve healed up and have your team ready, head on inside.

As soon as you enter you’ll see the Guide, who gives you some advice – there’s a secret button on a statue somewhere that will open the way to Maxima and Mega Evolution., In fact, there are three of them!

chunks.t: Part 16: Tarmigan Town & Tarmigan Mansion – Tarmigan Mansion
chunks.x: You’re in the lobby area of 1F at the moment. Head northeast and you’ll see a trainer blocking the way forward. | Expert Andy. Defeat Expert Andy, and you’ll find yourself in a dining room., There are two Chanseys in the mansion and one of them is here, right next to the stairs you need to take to the next floor. | The stairs to 2F, and a Chansey. Depending on how the battles go in the mansion, you may need to run back and forth to heal. | The long hallway on 2F. Up the stairs you’ll find a long hallway that stretches along the north wall of the mansion. There are three trainers for you to defeat here.

chunks.t: Part 16: Tarmigan Town & Tarmigan Mansion – Tarmigan Mansion
chunks.x: The stairs to 3F. Once you make your way past the trainers, climb up the stairs and you’ll get to the top floor of the mansion. | The second Chansey. Ace Trainer Samuel roams this room looking for a fight, so if you need healing, you might need to time it and slip past him to get to the Chansey. | The gate and the second staircase. In the south part of the room you’ll see a giant metal grate blocking the way forward., However, there’s another staircase you can take.

chunks.t: Part 16: Tarmigan Town & Tarmigan Mansion – Tarmigan Mansion
chunks.x: Expert Clancy and the landing. Taking those stairs will put you on a landing of sorts on 2F, and Expert Clancy challenges you before you can go any further., Once you beat him, take the stairs down to 1F. | Scientist Ted is in this room, and once you beat him you’ll see a statue in the corner. | Scientist Ted and the secret switch. This is one of the secret switches – press it, and the gate on 3F will open. | A Double Battle. When you go through the open gate, however, there are two trainers waiting to ambush you with a Double Battle., After they’re taken care of, continue east along the hallway and you’ll find a giant room filled with statues.

chunks.t: Part 16: Tarmigan Town & Tarmigan Mansion – Tarmigan Mansion
chunks.x: The left path in the Statue Maze. There are quite a few paths to take, but first go left when you enter the maze and go through that passage north. | The second secret switch. When the path forks, go east and wind around until you see a Pokémon statue – this is the statue with the second switch you need to press., Once that’s done, go back to the entrance of the maze. | Take the east path this time. Go east and take that path north., There’s an optional trainer you can fight on this side of the room if you wish. | When the path forks, go left and follow it all the way to the staircase down to 2F, and the final hallway in the mansion.

chunks.t: Part 16: Tarmigan Town & Tarmigan Mansion – Tarmigan Mansion
chunks.x: The route to the staircase. This is the last area before you get to challenge Successor Maxima. | The final hallway. Head south and you’ll need to beat two Experts, Ken and Sheri., The south end of the hallway is a one-way drop into the basement of the mansion – the only thing left to do is to fall into it! | The gap in the floor leads to Maxima. Once you fall down, just head up until you find the Successor waiting for you.

chunks.t: Part 16: Tarmigan Town & Tarmigan Mansion – Tarmigan Mansion
chunks.x: Items: Fresh Water, Mega Bracelet, Mega Cuff, Mega Ring, Mega Charm, Altarianite, Fairy Gem, Escape Rope, Carbos, Protein, Zinc, Iron, Calcium, HP Up, Hyper Potion, Revive | Battle for Mega Evolution | Maxima is your obstacle to obtaining Mega Evolution. In order to gain the power of Mega Evolution, you’ll have to defeat Successor Maxima. | Note: The team below is for Vanilla difficulty mode. If you’re playing on Difficult, Expert, or Insane mode then Maxima’s team composition may differ.

chunks.t: Part 16: Tarmigan Town & Tarmigan Mansion – Battle for Mega Evolution
chunks.x: Trainer Successor Maxima: Wigglytuff (Normal/Fairy) Lv36, Altaria ((Mega) Dragon/Fairy) Lv38, Delphox (Fire/Psychic) Lv37, Empoleon (Water/Steel) Lv37 | She has a well-rounded team, and she shows off Mega Evolution on her Altaria. She’s also got two Hyper Potions, which can make the battle a little tougher than expected. | After You Win | Defeating Successor Maxima. Once she is defeated, she will give you the Mega Keystone – and she gives you the choice of accessories to put it in: a ring, a bracelet, a cuff or a charm., Which one doesn’t matter, it’s just a bit of flavor. | She also gives you an Altarianite, so you can use Mega Evolution on an Altaria of your own. | The ladder you need – but there will be no Grunt there this time. North of her is a statue that has one final secret button you can press, which will reveal the exit., The stairs here lead to the northwest section of the 1F lobby.

chunks.t: Part 16: Tarmigan Town & Tarmigan Mansion – Battle for Mega Evolution
chunks.x: The mansion garden has opened up. Now that the mansion has essentially been beaten, you’re given access to the mansion garden, which is through a door behind the gentleman in the dining room on 1F., There’s a Zygarde Cell there as well as a Raid Den entrance. | Leaving Tarmigan Town | Once you’re well and truly done with the mansion, head outside and go to the north gate of Tarmigan Town, where you’ll find the way clear for you to proceed. | The way to Route 12 is clear. Your next destination is Dehara City, which is on the other side of Route 12., Go through the gate and you’ll be on your way there.

chunks.t: Part 17: Route 12 & Dehara City – Route 12
chunks.x: Route 12 | Route 12 map. Rival Battle, Collector Steve, Raid Den, Hiker Oliver, Worker Braxton, Cosmog Bag, Fisherman Claude, Fisherman Ronald, Psychic Johan, Kindler Fry, Beauty Sheila. Cliff Cave, Tarmigan Town, Requires HM Surf, Requires HM Rock Climb, Dehara City

Prize ₽1,480

chunks.t: Part 17: Route 12 & Dehara City – Route 12
chunks.x: You’ve just earned the power of Mega Evolution by completing Tarmigan Mansion, and you’ve headed north out of Tarmigan Town on to Route 12. At the other end of Route 12 is Dehara City. | First steps on Route 12. Take a few steps north on the route, though, and you’ll run into a familiar face. | Rival Battle | Fourth round with your Rival. Your Rival shows up, fresh after beating the Mansion himself and keen to show off how much he’s grown as a trainer since last you saw him. | Trainer Rival Battle (4th Round): Toucannon (Normal/Flying) Lv37, Vaporeon (Water) Lv38, Piloswine (Ice/Ground) Lv38, Metang Steel/Psychic Gabite Ground/Dragon Pupitar Rock/Ground Lv26 | He still can’t believe it when we beat him yet again, but doesn’t have much time to process it before Professor Log arrives.

chunks.t: Part 17: Route 12 & Dehara City – Route 12
chunks.x: Professor Log has a gift for you. Your Rival is not that happy to see him, and is keen to leave to keep searching for his parents., Luckily for both him and you, Professor Log has something that will make that easier. | Getting HM03 Surf | HM03 Surf. It’s HM03 Surf!, However, you’ll have to beat the Dehara City Gym to use it. | Professor Log tells you to head to Dehara City to find Jax, and then after you earn the Gym Badge you can travel with Surf together to the Ruins of Void., After your Rival and the Professor leave, you’re free to continue on through the route.

chunks.t: Part 17: Route 12 & Dehara City – Route 12
chunks.x: Collector Steve | Getting Through Route 12 | Walk west down a couple of sets of stairs, passing Collector Steve on the way., You’ll see a cutscene of Marlon on a beach, still unsure of what to do after you beat him at Thundercap Mountain. Before he can decide, a strange Grunt appears behind him and teleports Marlon away. | Worker Braxton. Once the cutscene is over, continue until you see Worker Braxton to the northwest., Challenge him, and after you beat him and head north you’ll see another cutscene.

chunks.t: Part 17: Route 12 & Dehara City – Route 12
chunks.x: Zapdos is captured after all. Hoopa, the portal Pokémon, has brought the strange Grunt a Pokémon in a bag, but the Grunt doesn’t want it., He wants Zapdos, so Hoopa summons it and the Grunt captures it. | Looks like the Shadow have all the Legendary Pokémon they need after all. | Move a couple of boulders to get past. Walk northwest and you’ll see an entrance to the beach you’ve been seeing in the cutscenes., Go west onto the sand and you will quickly spot the bag that Hoopa left. | The bag has a Cosmog in it. Make sure you have an empty slot in your team, and then examine the bag., There’s a Cosmog inside! | Note: If you are playing on Difficult, Expert, or Insane mode, then Cosmog cannot be obtained here until the post-game. Only vanilla/base difficulty can obtain Cosmog here before beating the Elite Four.

chunks.t: Part 17: Route 12 & Dehara City – Route 12
chunks.x: Once you’ve got this super rare Pokémon, it’s time to continue on to Dehara City. | Psychic Johan. Go back the way you came and go past Psychic Johan until you see a set of stairs leading east up the cliff face. | Go past the blonde trainer. Keep going up the cliff, fighting Kindler Fry on the way., Once you’ve beaten him, walk north along the ledge. | The entrance to Dehara City. You’ve made it to Dehara City, which is a big place full of things to do and explore., Head inside the gate to progress.

chunks.t: Part 17: Route 12 & Dehara City – Route 12

chunks.t: Part 17: Route 12 & Dehara City – Dehara City
chunks.x: Wild Pokémon [Surfing]: Tentacool (Water/Poison) Lv35–40 60%, Tentacruel (Water/Poiso) Lv38–40 5%, Pelipper (Water/Flying) Lv35–40 30%, Pyukumuku (Water) Lv37–40 5% | Wild Pokémon [Fishing]: Magikarp (Water (Old Rod)) Lv10–15 100%, Staryu (Water (Good Rod)) Lv10–50, Poliwag (Water (Good Rod)) Lv20–25 40%, Poliwhirl (Water (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 40%, Staryu (Water (Super Rod)) Lv10–50, Starmie (Water/Psychic (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 20%, Sandygast (Ghost/Ground (Super Rod)) | Dehara City. Keep going along the road from the gate until you see the Pokémon Center – this marks the beginning of Dehara City proper., Dehara City is massive, so it’s best to start in one area and then move clockwise around town, to make sure you don’t miss anything.

chunks.t: Part 17: Route 12 & Dehara City – Dehara City
chunks.x: The Pokemon Center. The first area you should visit is the road leading east., There are two big buildings here – go in the first one, which is the Pokémon Center. | The Luxury Ball girl. Inside is a girl who will give you 5 Luxury Balls, and will offer to change the Ball of any Pokémon in your team to a Luxury Ball., The next building along is the massive Dehara Department Store – head on inside. | The Dehara Department Store

chunks.t: Part 17: Route 12 & Dehara City – Dehara City
chunks.x: Dehara Department Store | This Department Store is slightly dangerous. One thing to be aware of here is that it’s not all about shopping – there are trainers on 3F and above that will want to challenge you if they see you, so bear that in mind., The Department Store has: | A regular Poke Mart on 2F, An Evolution Stone shop on 3F, A TM shop on 4F, A Stat Items shop on 5F, And a Mail shop on 6F | As for the trainers: | Trainer Sailor Edmund: Machoke (Fighting) Lv37, Vaporeon (Water) Lv38. Prize ₽2,280 | Trainer Hiker Oliver: Hawlucha (Fighting/Flying) Lv38, Umbreon (Dark) Lv37

chunks.t: Part 17: Route 12 & Dehara City – Dehara City
chunks.x: Trainer Twins Mayo and May: Glameow (Normal) Lv37, Gastrodon (Water) Lv37 | Trainer Guitarist Dalton: Boldore (Rock) Lv37, Jolteon (Electric) Lv38. Prize ₽1,216 | Trainer Psychic Jeckle: Espeon (Psychic) Lv38, Spoink (Psychic) Lv37. Prize ₽1,776 | And On 2F, there’s a maid who offers to purchase anything in your inventory that resembles an ingredient or food item – usually organic healing items. | The Maid will buy ingredients. On 6F there is a very strange woman who acts like a vending machine.

chunks.t: Part 17: Route 12 & Dehara City – Dehara City
chunks.x: This woman is a vending machine?. Weird vibes aside, it’s best to purchase a Soda Pop from her because you’ll need it in a moment., After you’re finished shopping, leave the building and head west. | Back to Dehara City | The Gym is out of business for now. Unfortunately, there’s no way for you to get the badge from the Gym at the moment, because there is no way across the water to reach the island it sits on., Remember its location for later. | Keep following the road west and then turn north, ignoring any forks you may come across. | The KBT Expressway entrance. You will quickly find this city’s entrance to the Expressway, and there’s a few new Gem Shops open., Tip: The path to Dresco Town and the rest of the tunnel network is also open if you want to backtrack that way.

chunks.t: Part 17: Route 12 & Dehara City – Dehara City
chunks.x: Gem Family Move Shops | Just east of the Expressway entrance is a large park. | Someone keeps misplacing healing items in parks. Like Epidimy Town, if you sit on one of the benches here, you’ll get a random healing item., After that, keep going north and you’ll come to a large beach. | The north beach. There’s a Battle Girl here who is very thirsty – if you give her the Soda Pop we bought in the Department Store, she’ll give you an Expert Belt., From there you can head back to the park, and take the south exit. You’ll come to a street and a row of houses – head east until you see a house with a sign next to it.

chunks.t: Part 17: Route 12 & Dehara City – Dehara City
chunks.x: The Double Battle House, and the Developer House next to it. You’ve arrived at Double Battle House, which is very similar to the one in Dresco Town., Head inside for a bit of training. | Double Battle House | Inside the Double Battle House. This place works exactly the same as Dresco’s version – the trainers in here are able to be fought over and over again, so if you ever feel like you’re underleveled, make sure you put in some time here. | Double Battles | Trainer Battle Girl Ginger: Mienfoo (Fighting) Lv38, Gurdurr (Fighting) Lv38, Breloom (Grass/Fighting) Lv38. Prize ₽2,544

chunks.t: Part 17: Route 12 & Dehara City – Dehara City
chunks.x: Trainer Gambler Artred: Alolan Golem (Rock/Electric) Lv38, Lycanroc (Midday Form) (Rock) Lv38, Lycanroc ((Midnight Form) Rock) Lv38. Prize ₽4,240 | Trainer Poke Maniac Garth: Togedemaru (Electric/Steel) Lv38, Pachirisu (Electric) Lv38, Eelektrik (Electric) Lv38. Prize ₽5,280 | Trainer Bird Keeper Featred: Fearow (Normal/Flying) Lv38, Talonflame (Fire/Flying) Lv38, Trumbeak (Normal/Flying) Lv38. Prize ₽6,360 | Trainer Psychic Wyatt: Malamar (Dark/Psychic) Lv38, Gardevoir (Psychic/Fairy) Lv38, Grumpig (Psychic) Lv38. Prize ₽5,280 | The house next to the Double Battle House is a bit of an easter egg from the developers of this game – everyone who had a hand in contributing has their own avatar and witty line to say, just like the Game Freak rooms in the official Pokémon games.

chunks.t: Part 17: Route 12 & Dehara City – Dehara City
chunks.x: Other Notable Areas | Rift Cave entrance. Just northeast of those two houses is a cave entrance. This is Rift Cave, and it’s best to leave the exploration of this place for later., For now, head south until you see a block of four houses. | The block of four. There are things to do and collect in every single one of these houses, so it is best to start with the northwest house and continue clockwise. | Top-Left House | The family on the lower floor of the northwest house is concerned with the happiness of Pokémon. | This boy just wants to play with Pokemon. The girl will tell you how happy your lead Pokémon is, and the boy will offer to play with one of them to raise happiness.

chunks.t: Part 17: Route 12 & Dehara City – Dehara City
chunks.x: Upstairs has a couple of useful things too. The man upstairs in the hallway wants to see a Pokémon like a balloon, which could be any of Jigglypuff’s evolutionary line or Drifloon and Drifblim., He’ll reward you with an Air Balloon, which will save the holder from a Ground-type move once before bursting. | There are pesky Pokemon showing up on the beach. The fisherman inside the unit here on the second floor gives you a mission to throw any Pyukumuku you might find on the beach back in the ocean, because they’re a hazard to beachgoers., You just go to the northern beach and remove all the Pyukumuku you can find until it tells you to return. | A pesky Pyukumuku. No need to battle them, you’ll just need to examine them and they’ll leave.

chunks.t: Part 17: Route 12 & Dehara City – Dehara City
chunks.x: Your reward for the beach cleanup. For cleaning up the beach, you’ll be given a Power Band., With that house complete, move to the northeast one. | Top-Right House | A free Passho Berry. Talking to the Monferno here will get you a free Passho Berry, but it’s her owner that is more important. | Getting a free Turtwig. Just like the trainer from Unova in Route 5, this trainer is from Sinnoh and will offer you one of the three Sinnoh starter Pokemon – Turtwig, Chimchar, or Piplup., You can come back for the other two when you have 6 and 8 badges respectively.

chunks.t: Part 17: Route 12 & Dehara City – Dehara City
chunks.x: Sinnoh Starters: Turtwig (Grass) Lv30, Chimchar (Fire) Lv30, Piplup (Water) Lv30 | Upstairs is a Yellow Shard trainer. Go up to the second floor and you’ll find a woman who will give you 2 Yellow Shards., The old lady who lives with her can teach Thunder Punch if you give those shards to her – if not, you can keep them for later. | Bottom-Right House | The Hiker here will give you an important item later. A Hiker lives in the southeast house, and he says that the Great Desert to the east of Dehara is dangerous if you don’t have the right equipment., He offers to lend you his pair of Go-Goggles, but won’t do so until you beat the Dehara Gym. Remember his location for later. | Time for the southwest house now.

chunks.t: Part 17: Route 12 & Dehara City – Dehara City
chunks.x: Bottom-Left House | The southwest house has ore and bone buyers. There’s a gentleman inside that will buy any ore items that you have, similar to the Maid and food items., But more importantly, the man in the hallway next to him will purchase Rare Bones for twice the price Poke Marts will offer – P10000 each. | This old man wants to see if we’ve encountered 250 or more Pokemon. Head upstairs, and if you’ve been adventurous enough, you will have seen (not caught) at least 250 Pokémon by now. If that’s the case, the old man up here will give you a Binding Band. | Cloud Game Corner | The Cloud Game Corner. The Cloud Game Corner is one more destination to check out in Dehara City, and it’s just above the Department Store., Speak to the man outside and he’ll give you a Coin Case, which is essential if you want to play any minigames.

chunks.t: Part 17: Route 12 & Dehara City – Dehara City
chunks.x: The gaming floor. As soon as you enter, you’ll see Jax at one of the machines., For now, speak to the other patrons in here and they’ll give you various amounts of Coins to start you off with. | A tall order, but worth it. The man in the northwest corner gives you a mission to earn 3000 Coins in a single day by playing the game Cloud Burst. | How Games Work | Cloud Burst. Cloud Burst is a minigame where you control an Altaria, flying around popping balloons. It will take quite a few runs for you to rack up 3000 points, but it is doable., Your reward is something special – a Balloon Pikachu with Levitate and the moves Fly, Agility, Slam, and Discharge. Could come in handy perhaps?

chunks.t: Part 17: Route 12 & Dehara City – Dehara City
chunks.x: Reward Pokémon: Balloon Pikachu (Electric) Lv35 | If you’re willing to spend more time earning Coins, there are a number of other rare Pokémon that can only be purchased in the Game Corner Shop. | Game Corner Shop: Emolga (Electric/Flying 500 Coins), Hawlucha (Fighting/Flying 1000 Coins), Eevee (Normal 1500 Coins), Klefki (Steel/Fairy 3000 Coins), Axew (Dragon 5000 Coins), Porygon (Normal 9999 Coins) | Speak to Jax to continue the story

chunks.t: Part 17: Route 12 & Dehara City – Dehara City
chunks.x: Items: Go-Goggles, Expert Belt, Fresh Water, Electric Gem, Steel Gem, TM92 Volt Switch, Luxury Balls x5, Coin Case, Ultra Ball, Protective Pads, Yellow Shards x2, Binding Band, Air Balloon, Rare Candy, Magnet, Power Band, Lustrous Orb, Master Ball, Trainer Tips sign #26, Zygarde Cell #48 | Special Encounters (Miraheze wiki): Pikachu (Gift) Lv30 | Continuing The Story | After you’re done in the Game Corner, speak to Jax to get things moving again., Before you do, make sure you have everything in order – you won’t be returning to town for quite a while.

chunks.t: Part 18: Ruins of Void – Getting to the Ruins of Void
chunks.x: Getting to the Ruins of Void | Jax will talk to you outside. At this point in the walkthrough you’re in the Dehara City Game Corner and you’ve just found Jax., He wants to go outside to talk to you about your next move and how to get to the Ruins of Void. | Hoopa arrives and causes chaos. He mentions needing to get the Dehara Gym Badge so you can use Surf – but before you can discuss it further, Hoopa appears and summons a portal that whisks you both away!
