chunks.t: Part 18: Ruins of Void – Ruins of Void (Exterior)
chunks.x: It looks like Hoopa has taken you to the Ruins of Void prematurely. | An unexpected arrival. The Shadow Grunts immediately spot you, and in a desperate attempt to stop you, blow up the side of the mountain. That destroys the staircase and hurts Jax’ Staraptor. | The whole layout of the Ruins changes. Jax decides to wait outside while you go and find his Staraptor and put an end to the Shadow while you’re at it – he can heal you whenever your team is low on health., Go inside the cave opening and you’ll find yourself in some catacombs.

chunks.t: Part 18: Ruins of Void – Ruins of Void (Exterior)
chunks.x: Items: TM48 Skill Swap, Dusk Ball, Max Repel, TM31 Brick Break, Ghost Gem, Marshadium Z, Full Heal, Sacred Ash, Red Card, Odd Incense, Spell Tag, Zinc, Dire Hit, Psychic Gem, Nugget, Zygarde Cell #50, Zygarde Cell #51, Stone Tablet #6, Max Raid Den #29, Portal #01, Raikou, Portal #02, Entei, Portal #03, Suicune, Portal #04, Ho-Oh, Portal #05, Lugia | Special Encounters (Miraheze wiki): Raikou (Special encounter) Lv40, Entei (Special encounter) Lv40

chunks.t: Part 18: Ruins of Void – Ruins of Void – B3F
chunks.x: Ruins of Void – B3F | Ruins of Void B3F map. Abra to Dehara Town, Ancient Tablet, Blocked Dead End A, Blocked Dead End B. Cliff Cave, Ruins Exterior, First Switch and Gate, Second Switch and Gate, Third Switch and Gate, Ruins B2F First Chamber

chunks.t: Part 18: Ruins of Void – Ruins of Void – B3F
chunks.x: Items: Zygarde Cell, Dusk Ball (hidden), Max Repel, TM31 Brick Break | The entrance to the catacombs. At the beginning of this floor is an Abra who will take you back to Dehara City if you’re missing anything. | Maze Solution | There are three passages ahead of you – first, take the one on the right.

chunks.t: Part 18: Ruins of Void – Ruins of Void – B3F
chunks.x: The Ancient Tablet. There’s an Ancient Tablet at the end of this passage that gives you a hint – “SWITCH BELOW THEN AVOIDING THE DUSCLOPS IS THE KEY”., There are a bunch of Dusclops in the central passage, so it’s best not to go that way. | Go back, pass the Abra, and head down the left passage. | The first switch. Follow the left passage all the way around until you find an ancient lever., Pull it, and there’ll be no more Dusclops problem. | The Dusclops are blocked off, but the second gate is closed. Now walk down the central passage and you’ll see that the Dusclops have been blocked in, but the way forward is also protected by another gate., Go east and follow that passage, ignoring any forks.

chunks.t: Part 18: Ruins of Void – Ruins of Void – B3F
chunks.x: The second switch. You’ll eventually find the second switch – pull it and the gate will open. | Looking for the third switch. Continue north past the gates and follow the only remaining passage to the third and final switch. | The third switch. Once you pull it, you’ll be free to go through the left passage.

chunks.t: Part 18: Ruins of Void – Ruins of Void – B3F
chunks.x: The way forward is clear. Walk through the left passage and you’ll eventually see a ladder to the next floor. | Prepare before heading up the ladder. When you arrive on the next floor you’ll immediately be thrown into a tough fight, so make sure your Pokémon are all healed up first.

chunks.t: Part 18: Ruins of Void – Ruins of Void – Higher Interior
chunks.x: Ruins of Void – Higher Interior | Ruins of Void higher interior map. Slide Puzzle, Portal Challenge, Go-Goggles House. Ruins B3F, Ruins B2F Exterior, Ruins B2F Exterior, Ladder to Ruins B1F First Chamber, Ruins B1F Exterior, Ruins B1F Exterior, Ruins B1F Exterior Elevator, Ruins 1F Exterior, Ladder to Ruins B1F Final Chamber, Ladder to Ruins 1F Main Chamber

chunks.t: Part 18: Ruins of Void – Ruins of Void – Higher Interior
chunks.x: Items: Full Heal (hidden), Dusk Stone | Ruins of Void – B2F | The Claydol is the Guardian of the Ruins. You are confronted by a Claydol and challenged to prove yourself in battle., This boss battle, like the others in the Ruins of Void, is level scaled even on Vanilla difficulty. | This means Claydol will be around a couple levels below you no matter how overleveled you may be. | The Claydol will burrow through the west wall. Once it’s been defeated, it will smash its way through the west wall of the chamber, revealing an exit.

chunks.t: Part 18: Ruins of Void – Ruins of Void – B2F
chunks.x: A return to the exterior. Going through it will put you on the outside of the ruins., Walk around the path until you see another opening. | The south opening leads back inside. Head inside and you’ll be in the second B2F chamber. | Puzzle time. There is a set of double doors leading north, but they’re currently sealed. | Hoopa Puzzle | You will have to interact with the tile puzzle in the middle of the room to open them., You can drag and drop the pieces wherever you like., The final image should resemble Hoopa.

chunks.t: Part 18: Ruins of Void – Ruins of Void – B2F
chunks.x: The Hoopa must be assembled properly. Once you’ve reassembled the Hoopa picture, the double doors will open. | The door in the north opens. There’s a ladder in the chamber beyond that will take you to the next floor. | The ladder to B1F

chunks.t: Part 18: Ruins of Void – Ruins of Void – B1F
chunks.x: Ruins of Void – B1F | Ruins of Void B1F. Once you emerge, go west. | Items: Odd Incense, Spell Tag | Immediately head outside. You’ll see another opening leading to the outside.

chunks.t: Part 18: Ruins of Void – Ruins of Void – B1F
chunks.x: Another level up. You’re nearly at the top of the pyramid-shaped ruins, it seems., Continue along the ledge and you’ll pass another entrance. | The way to another chamber. However, your attention is drawn by something important – Jax’ injured Staraptor. | Give the Staraptor a helping hand. When you see it, Jax will follow you up the ruin and nurse it back to health. He will also reposition himself to be on this level, so you don’t have to go all the way back down to the bottom to heal., This is important, because you will need to be healed for the next battle.

chunks.t: Part 18: Ruins of Void – Portal Challenge
chunks.x: Portal Challenge | A three-phase boss rush. Head inside the next chamber, and Claydol is waiting for you., To test you further, it opens a portal, and you’re challenged to defeat the three legendary Johto beasts one after another – with no break in between. | Since they’re level scaled, this is likely going to be a tough fight. | Trainer Portal Challenge: Raikou (Electric) Lvscales, Entei (Fire) Lvscales, Suicune (Water) Lvscales | An elevator is revealed. The tile on which the Claydol sits is actually an elevator to the upper floor – once it leaves, you can use it.

chunks.t: Part 18: Ruins of Void – Ruins of Void – 1F
chunks.x: Ruins of Void – 1F | The top of the ruins. Finally, you’re at the peak of the ruins., The Grunts are shocked to see you, but they don’t actually confront you until you pass them. | Items: Nugget (hidden) | One last obstacle. One of the Grunts battles you, and thankfully it isn’t level scaled., After you beat him, the other one wants to fight, but Jax appears to distract them and you’re able to escape back into the ruins. Jax will also heal you here if you talk to him again.

chunks.t: Part 18: Ruins of Void – Ruins of Void – 1F
chunks.x: Trainer Grunt: Cofagrigus (Ghost) Lv39, Sableye (Dark/Ghost) Lv38 | Head inside and climb down the ladder into one more chamber. | The interior floors | Ruins of Void – Final Chamber | One last chamber. There’s not much here except a long hallway – walk through it and you’ll see another ladder to the level below.

chunks.t: Part 18: Ruins of Void – Ruins of Void – Final Chamber
chunks.x: Items: Zinc (hidden) | The ladder to the confrontation. As soon as you climb down the ladder, it’s not long before you’re captured by Shadow Grunts and dragged to the ritual site. | Ritual Challenge | Aklove reveals himself. Zeph, the leader of the Shadow, attempts to perform the ritual of unbinding, but he is unsuccessful., The strange grunt with the red hair from before appears and reveals himself as Aklove, a descendant of the king that was at war with Borrius ages ago.

chunks.t: Part 18: Ruins of Void – Ritual Challenge
chunks.x: Hoopa is Unbound. He performs the ritual and causes Hoopa to be Unbound, hoping for the destruction of Borrius., To help bring that about, he orders Hoopa to open two portals and summon the legendary Johto birds to defeat you – one at a time, thankfully. | Trainer Ritual Challenge: Ho-Oh (Fire/Flying) Lvscales, Lugia (Psychic/Flying) Lvscales | You are trapped. When you beat them, Aklove has another trick up his sleeve – he will do to you what he did to Marlon and seal you inside Cube Space!, You’re teleported away, and find yourself in a weird landscape.

chunks.t: Part 18: Ruins of Void – Cube Space
chunks.x: Cube Space | Uploaded to cyberspace. Cube Space is an extremely strange environment, and it’s an absolute maze to try and navigate. | The first platform | Note: The puzzle tutorial below assumes you’re on the default puzzle difficulty. If you’re playing on the harder puzzle difficulty then please visit this other page for a solution to the more difficult puzzle.

chunks.t: Part 18: Ruins of Void – Cube Space
chunks.x: You’ll have to make your way through a bit of a teleporter maze, and it can be confusing, so the following instructions will guide you:, Step 1: Walk east and hop on the next teleport pad., Step 2: From there, walk north to the T-junction, take the west path and hop on the teleport pad., Step 3: Walk north and then east. Do not take the teleport pad, go past it and turn north. | Don’t hop on the pad pictured – go past it. Step 4: You’ll come to three choices of teleport pad – take the right one., Step 5: Go south – you will come to a pad, do not take it. Go past it to the second pad. | Step 6: Step on that second pad, do not go any further. | The second pad – take it to finish the maze. Once you step on that pad, you are whisked away to an area that has two other people in it – one of them is Marlon, and the other is your dad, Aros!

chunks.t: Part 18: Ruins of Void – Cube Space
chunks.x: A tearful reunion. Aros explains he’s been trapped in Cube Space for years, and Marlon only recently joined him., Together, all three of you work out a way for Marlon and you to escape – Aros will need to remain behind as he needs to be freed manually. | After an emotional goodbye, you’re teleported to Cinder Volcano. | Heading to Cinder Volcano | The entrance to the Shadow Base. Cinder Volcano is where the Shadow Base entrance is, accessed through the cave entrance a Shadow Grunt was blocking the last time you were here., Head inside to confront the Shadow.

chunks.t: Part 19: Cinder Volcano Depths & Shadow Base – Cinder Volcano Depths – Overview
chunks.x: Cinder Volcano Depths – Overview | Cinder Volcano Depths map. 1F, Light of Ruin Grunt, B1F, Agent Vega Double Battle, Shadow Remains Cave, Heat Rock Cave, B2F, Primal Groudon Battle. 1F, Route 4 West, Ladder Down to B1F, B1F, Ladder Up to 1F, Ladder Down to B2F, B2F, Ladder Up to B1F

chunks.t: Part 19: Cinder Volcano Depths & Shadow Base – Cinder Volcano Depths – Overview
chunks.x: Items: X Attack (hidden), TM76 Stealth Rock, Zygarde Cell, Red Shard (hidden), Heat Rock, Max Revive (hidden) | Items: Lava Cookie, Occa Berry (hidden), Dire Hit (hidden), Star Piece, Elixir (hidden), Ultra Ball (hidden)

chunks.t: Part 19: Cinder Volcano Depths & Shadow Base – Cinder Volcano Depths – Overview
chunks.x: Wild Pokémon (all floors) [Cave]: Woobat (Psychic/Flying) Lv15–38 20%, Slugma (Fire) Lv15–38 20%, Salandit (Poison/Fire) Lv15–38 10%, Camerupt (Fire/Ground) Lv36–38 15%, Graveler (Rock/Ground) Lv36–38 20%, Excadrill (Ground/Steel) Lv36–38 5%, Heatmor (Fire) Lv36–38 5%, Magmar (Fire) Lv36–38 5% | Wild Pokémon (all floors) [Surfing]: Slugma (Fire) Lv35–40 95%, Magcargo (Fire/Rock) Lv37–40 5% | Wild Pokémon (all floors) [Rock Smash]: Geodude (Rock/Ground) Lv20–35 60%, Graveler (Rock/Ground) Lv25–35 60%, Shuckle (Bug/Rock) Lv25–35 5%

chunks.t: Part 19: Cinder Volcano Depths & Shadow Base – Cinder Volcano Depths – 1F
chunks.x: Cinder Volcano Depths – 1F | Entering the depths of Cinder Volcano. When you enter the cavern, you’ll see someone in a strange uniform passed out on the floor, presumably put there by Marlon. | The Grunt is recovered enough to fight you. However, when you try and walk past him to the ladder, he jumps up and reveals himself as a Grunt of Aklove’s new organization, the Light of Ruin. | Trainer Light of Ruin Grunt: Floette (Fairy) Lv38, Ribombee (Bug/Fairy) Lv38, Sylveon (Fairy) Lv39. Prize ₽2,120 | He’s easily taken care of, but when you do he runs off to tell the rest of the Light of Ruin you’re here. Climb down the ladder after him.

chunks.t: Part 19: Cinder Volcano Depths & Shadow Base – Cinder Volcano Depths – B1F
chunks.x: Cinder Volcano Depths – B1F | The Grunt tries to get ahead of you. When you climb down the ladder, the Grunt is desperate to get to his boss before you do., Follow him, and you’ll see a confrontation already in progress. | Marlon asks you to team up. Vega, Crater Town Gym Leader and spy for the Shadows, is now apparently a leader of the Light of Ruin, and Marlon wants to take him down., Time for a Double Battle. | Like the ones with Jax, you need to select three Pokémon to use alongside Marlon’s three – a Krookodile, a Cacturne, and a Dusclops. | Light of Ruin Double Battle | Trainer Agent Vega and Light of Ruin Grunt: Liepard (Dark) Lv38, Floette (Fairy) Lv38, Ribombee (Bug/Fairy) Lv38, Sylveon (Fairy) Lv39, Honchkrow (Dark/Flying) Lv39, Absol (Mega) (Dark) Lv40. Prize ₽2,120

chunks.t: Part 19: Cinder Volcano Depths & Shadow Base – Cinder Volcano Depths – B1F
chunks.x: This battle is straightforward, because Marlon’s Pokémon are quite formidable and make good partners. | You need to go deeper. After winning the battle Vega tries to escape, and Marlon chases after him, deeper into the depths of the volcano., There are two chambers accessible from this central area – both contain useful items, but it might be worth going into the left chamber first. | Give a Shadow Warrior some peace. You find the body of a Shadow Warrior. Knowing what you do now about how they are made, you’re given the option to lay it to rest., After you do that, go back to the main chamber and go south. | The ladder to the heart of the volcano. Make sure your Pokémon are fully healed before climbing down the ladder, because the fight ahead is extremely tough.

chunks.t: Part 19: Cinder Volcano Depths & Shadow Base – Cinder Volcano Depths – B2F
chunks.x: Cinder Volcano Depths – B2F | Vega summons the guardian of the volcano. Marlon thinks he has Vega cornered, but Vega has one card up his sleeve – an artifact that summons a Primal Groudon from the heart of the volcano! | An unusual format for a battle. Vega flees, and you and Marlon are left to deal with the legendary Pokémon. However, you’re cut off from your Pokeballs by a rockfall., Marlon offers to battle the Groudon commanding your Pokémon, which is highly unusual but your only option. | Legendary Battle. Primal Groudon

chunks.t: Part 19: Cinder Volcano Depths & Shadow Base – Cinder Volcano Depths – B2F
chunks.x: This is one of the toughest battles in the game., The Groudon level scales, so you can’t really be too prepared for it. In addition, you’re only allowed to tell Marlon to switch Pokémon or to use items – you cannot select the move he tells the Pokémon to use., It’s very hit and miss because the move he selects may not be the most effective or the most powerful one. | The way forward is clear. But if you manage to beat Primal Groudon, the rockfall is cleared and you and Marlon are free to chase after Zeph., Marlon explicitly tells you not to follow him to the Shadow Base. But going by the updated mission objective, you plan on ignoring that. | Getting to Shadow Base | Fly to Frozen Heights. The Shadow Base is in the same place as it was in the very beginning of the game – just outside of your hometown, Frozen Heights.

chunks.t: Part 19: Cinder Volcano Depths & Shadow Base – Getting to Shadow Base
chunks.x: The entrance is now open. When you left the last time, it was sealed behind you – but now it appears to have been unsealed, presumably by Marlon., Head on inside.

chunks.t: Part 19: Cinder Volcano Depths & Shadow Base – Shadow Base – 1F
chunks.x: Shadow Base – 1F | Shadow Base 1F map. Marlon’s Uniform, Level 1 Key Card. Frozen Heights, Level 2 Key Card Access, Shadow Base Elevator

chunks.t: Part 19: Cinder Volcano Depths & Shadow Base – Shadow Base – 1F
chunks.x: Items: Hyper Potion, Metagrossite or Tyranitarite or Garchompite | The first level of the base. When you enter, you’ll have the choice of going left or right., Left leads to the area you escaped from previously, and right leads to where you need to go now. | Time to play dress up. Apparently Marlon decided to take off his uniform after breaking through the front door, and left it lying there for you to pick up and put on.

chunks.t: Part 19: Cinder Volcano Depths & Shadow Base – Shadow Base – 1F
chunks.x: Marlon?. As ‘Marlon’, you will be able to move around the Shadow Base pretty freely., Head west and you’ll see a room with a scientist in it. | Prepare before heading up the ladder. Just north of him is an item you will need – the Level 1 Key Card., There are all sorts of locked doors in this base, and this will help you get through some of them. | The base elevator. There’s only one way to get up and down floors in the base, and that’s the elevator.

chunks.t: Part 19: Cinder Volcano Depths & Shadow Base – Shadow Base – 1F
chunks.x: The attendant asks you which floor. It even comes with its own elevator attendant., First, head to B1F.

chunks.t: Part 19: Cinder Volcano Depths & Shadow Base – Shadow Base – B1F
chunks.x: Shadow Base – B1F | Shadow Base B1F map. Level 2 Key Card, Shadow Grunt. Shadow Base Elevator, Level 1 Key Card Access, Level 2 Key Card Access, Level 3 Key Card Access

chunks.t: Part 19: Cinder Volcano Depths & Shadow Base – Shadow Base – B1F
chunks.x: Items: Pearl (hidden), Calcium (hidden), Dusk Ball (hidden), Reaper Cloth, Zygarde Cell, Protein | Items: Dusk Ball | The first door is easy to get through. Luckily you picked up that keycard on the floor above, because the way forward is locked with Level 1 access., Head on through when you open them.

chunks.t: Part 19: Cinder Volcano Depths & Shadow Base – Shadow Base – B1F
chunks.x: The heart of the base. First, go to the northeast room to pick up something useful., It’s the Level 2 Key Card, sitting on a desk a Grunt is working at. | The Level 2 Key Card. With this in hand, you can go back to the area you woke up at in the beginning of the game and open the locked door there to get a Mega Stone for your starter Pokémon – a Metagrossite, Garchompite, or a Tyranitarite. | The Shadow Grunt wants to spar with you. Past another Level 1 door is a Grunt who wants to battle you – as a friendly spar session, of course., You can fight him again and again if you need some training. | Trainer Shadow Grunt: Scrafty (Dark/Fighting) Lv40, Malamar (Dark/Psychic) Lv41. Prize ₽448

chunks.t: Part 19: Cinder Volcano Depths & Shadow Base – Shadow Base – B1F
chunks.x: After you’ve got everything of value from this floor, head back to the elevator and select B2F. | Shadow Base – B2F | Shadow Base B2F map. Shadow Scientist, Level 3 Key Card. Shadow Base Elevator, Shadow Warrior Lab Entry/Exit, Level 3 Key Card Access | Items: Zygarde Cell, Up-Grade, TM41 Torment, Black Glasses

chunks.t: Part 19: Cinder Volcano Depths & Shadow Base – Shadow Base – B2F
chunks.x: Another floor of the base. As soon as you arrive on this floor, you’ll need to open another security door with your keycard. | The rest of the base awaits. Head east and then south until you bump into someone along that corridor. | The Shadow Scientist. Just like the Shadow Grunt upstairs, this Scientist offers herself as a training partner. | Trainer Shadow Scientist: Mawile (Steel/Fairy) Lv40, Vikavolt (Bug/Electric) Lv40, Bronzong (Steel/Psychic) Lv41. Prize ₽1,280

chunks.t: Part 19: Cinder Volcano Depths & Shadow Base – Shadow Base – B2F
chunks.x: The Shadow Warrior lab is open to you. In the south part of this floor is the entrance to the lab where the Shadow Warriors are made., The grunt guarding it thinks you’re Marlon, so he lets you in. | The final keycard. This is the location of the final item you need – the Level 3 Key Card., With this, you can head back to the elevator and go straight to B3F, where Zeph has his office. | Shadow Base – B3F | The final floor. B3F is the final floor of the base, and Marlon is already here ahead of you.

chunks.t: Part 19: Cinder Volcano Depths & Shadow Base – Shadow Base – B3F
chunks.x: Items: Houndoomite | Unlock this door with the Level 3 Key Card. A man with scruffy red hair walks through a security door – this must be Marlon when he’s out of uniform., Now that you have the Level 3 card you can follow him. | Another level up. Zeph is in the middle of explaining himself to Marlon when you barge through the door., He accuses you of being a spy, so it’s time to battle Zeph one more time.

chunks.t: Part 19: Cinder Volcano Depths & Shadow Base – Shadow Base – B3F
chunks.x: Trainer Shadow Base Battle – Boss Zeph: Mightyena (Dark) Lv41, Exploud (Normal) Lv40, Decidueye (Grass/Ghost) Lv42, Gengar (Mega) (Ghost/Poison) Lv41. Prize ₽5,600 | A chat full of revelations. After you beat him, Zeph soon comes to his senses when Marlon tells him your father is Aros., Zeph explains why he developed the method of making Shadow Warriors, and how he was manipulated by Fey, the leader of the Science Society, all along. | The most interesting piece of info you get though is that Marlon and Ivory are none other than your Rival’s parents! | Your next destination. The Light of Ruin has been detected in Vivill Town, which is across the Great Desert east of Dehara City., However you’ll need to beat the Gym first, so that’s where you’re going next.

chunks.t: Part 20: Dehara Gym – Dehara Gym – Battery Badge
chunks.x: Dehara Gym – Battery Badge | This is a double type Gym. The Dehara Gym is unlike any other Gym you’ve challenged so far., Trainers here use two types – Electric and Steel – instead of just one. | Steel moves are strong against Fairy-, Ice-, and Rock-type Pokémon, Steel Pokémon are weak against Fighting-, Fire-, and Ground-type moves, Electric-type moves are strong against Flying- and Water-type Pokémon, Electric Pokémon have only one weakness – Ground-type moves | So, the logical choice would be to bring in a Ground-type, right?, Wrong., The gimmick of this gym is that the magnetism in here causes Pokémon to levitate, so they are immune to Ground-type moves entirely., The best bet is to get something strong against Steel, such as a Fire-type like Camerupt., If you have the Cameruptite, activate it in battle – Mega Camerupt has Fire moves that will devastate most Steel Pokémon, and the boosted damage will help against the Electric-types.

chunks.t: Part 20: Dehara Gym – Dehara Gym – Battery Badge
chunks.x: All Gym Trainers | Gym Trainers | Trainer Super Nerd Ezra: Luxio (Electric) Lv41, Probopass (Rock/Steel) Lv40 | Trainer Worker Humphrey: Magnemite (Electric/Steel) Lv39, Magneton (Electric/Steel) Lv41. Prize ₽1,640 | Trainer Guitarist Luca: Manectric (Electric) Lv40, Electrode (Electric) Lv41. Prize ₽640 | Trainer Scientist Giselle: Charjabug (Electric) Lv40, Dedenne (Electric/Fairy) Lv40. Prize ₽1,920 | Trainer Scientist Jose: Klang (Steel) Lv41, Bronzong (Steel/Psychic) Lv41

chunks.t: Part 20: Dehara Gym – Dehara Gym – Battery Badge
chunks.x: Trainer Scientist Jerry: Bronzor (Steel/Psychic) Lv40, Klink (Steel) Lv40, Voltorb (Electric) Lv39. Prize ₽1,920 | Trainer Super Nerd Zack: Electabuzz (Electric) Lv40, Luxray (Electric) Lv40. Prize ₽1,640 | Trainer Collector Ashton: Emolga (Electric/Flying) Lv40, Pachirisu (Electric) Lv41 | Trainer Worker Bernie: Klink (Steel) Lv40, Magnemite (Electric/Steel) Lv40, Voltorb (Electric) Lv40. Prize ₽1,600

chunks.t: Part 20: Dehara Gym – Dehara Gym – Battery Badge
chunks.x: Gym Puzzle Layout | The optimal Gym route – the color of the line changes when a bulb switch is pressed | Note: The puzzle solution below is only for the game’s regular puzzle difficulty setting. If you are playing on the more difficult puzzle setting then please visit this other page with the solution to Dehara Gym’s higher difficulty puzzle. | This Gym is incredibly complicated to navigate, so you can quickly refer back to this map while reading the rest of the walkthrough., The various directional lines mark the optimum route through the Gym. At certain points, you must turn bulbs on and off again – when that happens, the color of the line changes so backtracking is easier to see., The order of the lines is: | red, blue, green, yellow, magenta, cyan, purple, orange

chunks.t: Part 20: Dehara Gym – Dehara Gym – Battery Badge
chunks.x: There are three floors in the Gym – 1F, B1F and B2F. Elevators on one particular floor can head to any of the other two levels – the map marks which one this is. | Note: We also have a more detailed step-by-step tutorial on our Dehara City Gym page so you can check there if you get lost while working through this. | So, first – head east from the Guide, across a moving platform, and you will see an area with two elevators. | The first elevator. First, step on the leftmost elevator and it will take you down to B1F. | Continuing on. Once you arrive, go northwest until you see the first trainer you’ll need to challenge – Super Nerd Ezra.

chunks.t: Part 20: Dehara Gym – Dehara Gym – Battery Badge
chunks.x: Super Nerd Ezra and the first switch. After beating Ezra, go north and you will see a bulb switch. These switches turn electric gates on and off, so they’re vital to getting to the end of the Gym., Turn the bulb on, and go back to the platform you came from on 1F. | Take the other elevator. This time, take the elevator you didn’t take last time – the northern one – and it will take you to another area of B1F. | Keep going north. Then, take the moving platform north until you see Worker Humphrey waiting for you.

chunks.t: Part 20: Dehara Gym – Dehara Gym – Battery Badge
chunks.x: Worker Humphrey and the next elevator. Once you beat Humphrey, keep going north and take the elevator you see there. It will take you to B2F. | These gates are switched off. You’ll see two Tesla coils that used to generate an electric fence, but they appear to be off., Turning the bulb on directed the flow of energy away from the coils and allows you to go to the next area. | Guitarist Luca. Take the elevator up to 1F and pass Guitarist Luca., Go down the elevator near him and you’ll end up back on B2F.

chunks.t: Part 20: Dehara Gym – Dehara Gym – Battery Badge
chunks.x: An active Tesla coil. You will immediately see that an electric gate to the south has not been turned off yet., Go to the elevator to the right of the one you arrived on. | The second bulb. Back on 1F, there’s a bulb you need to switch on. Remember where this is, because you will have to come back here later., Once you’ve done that, go back to the previous elevator. | Head north. There’s another elevator in the north part of this area – step on to it and it will take you up to B1 and Giselle.

chunks.t: Part 20: Dehara Gym – Dehara Gym – Battery Badge
chunks.x: Giselle and the next elevator. Defeat her and head west to another elevator that takes you up to B1. | Scientist Joe and the third bulb. The third bulb is here – turn it on, and remember where it is, because you’ll need to come back here to turn it off again in due time., Go back to the Tesla coils on B2F that you couldn’t get past earlier. | The Tesla coils are off. They’re now off, so you can head past them and up to battle Scientist Jerry.

chunks.t: Part 20: Dehara Gym – Dehara Gym – Battery Badge
chunks.x: Scientist Jerry. Take the elevator past Jerry and you will go to B1 and another set of deactivated Tesla coils. | Another set disabled. If you are playing on a higher difficulty level then visit our Dehara City Gym page here. | Trainer Gym Leader Galavan Double Battle: Alolan Golem (Rock/Electric) Lv44, Eelektross (Electric) Lv43, Magneton (Electric/Steel) Lv42, Manectric (Mega) (Electric) Lv44. chunks.x: Routes 13 and 14 near the water. There are a few important things to pick up on Routes 13 and 14, where we were supposed to surf to get to the Ruins of Void before Hoopa intervened., Hop on your Pokémon and surf south into Route 13 to get started.

chunks.t: Gym 5: Dehara City Gym (Galavan) – Battery Badge, Electric
chunks.x: The Dehara City Gym is the 5th gym you’ll encounter in Pokemon Unbound. The gym leader, Galavan, specializes in Electric-type Pokemon while also featuring Rock and Steel-types., The Dehara City Gym features an external Levitate/Magnetism effect which causes all Electric and Steel-type Pokemon to be lifted into the air – making them immune to Ground-type moves., Typically, an ideal team against Galavan’s Pokemon would feature Ground-type. But due to the Levitate conditions, it’s best to use a mix of Fighting, Grass, and Fire-type Pokemon. Another strategy is to use Ground-types that have non-Ground moves. Dehara City Gym Puzzle: This gym features several platforms in the ground which need to be traversed to disable specific electric barriers blocking your path. The objective is to disable all barriers between you and Galavan. Here’s a step-by-step tutorial on how to solve the puzzle., Step 1: From the entrance, use the platform on your right. This takes you over near two different platforms., Step 2: Between the two platforms in the ground, fall through the one on the left., Step 3: From here, continue on the path towards the left leading to a Trainer. This is an unskippable battle., After the battle, switch on the bulb located near Super Nerd Ezra. Then make your way back to where you came from near the start of the gym., Step 4: Now fall through the trap at the top of the room to reach the next area., Step 5: Now use the lift in front of you to reach the Trainer across the room. This battle is optional and can be skipped if you time your run correctly, though it may be better to trigger it since you’ll have to come back this way later, so it’ll make the way back easier., After the fight, continue on the same path up and use the platform at the end to reach the next area., Step 6: On this new floor, walk onto the platform just south of you., Step 7: Now make your way down to the trap on the other end of the room. You’ll have to battle the Trainer guarding the path here., Step 8: Once you’re down, use the platform directly to your right to reach the next area., Step 9: Turn the bulb on, then go back to the previous room., Step 10: From here, head up towards the n

chunks.t: Part 21: Routes 13 and 14 – Route 13
chunks.x: Now that you have Surf, head to Route 4 West and surf south into Route 13. | The north end of Route 13 and Swimmer Luis. Routes 13 and 14 are ocean routes, and would have been the only way to get to the Ruins of Void before Hoopa intervened., Not only are there important items to pick up on these two routes, but there is a challenge here – the Ocean Master Challenge – that is a great way to train your Pokémon before setting out in the Great Desert. | To complete the challenge, all trainers in Route 13 and 14 have to be defeated. | Clearing All Trainers | As soon as you enter the route, you’ll see Swimmer Luis. | Fisherman Wade. From him, surf southeast until you see an island with a lone fisherman – this is Fisherman Wade, the second trainer to beat.

chunks.t: Part 21: Routes 13 and 14 – Route 13
chunks.x: Swimmer Tiffany and Fisherman Nolan. Southeast of Wade is a small island with two trainers, a Swimmer and a Fisherman, waiting for a challenge., East of here is Dehara City, so if you need to go back to town to heal Pokémon, you have a quick shortcut. There are no Nurses or Chanseys on Route 13 or 14 so it’s best to keep this in mind. | After they’ve been dealt with, go back to Wade’s island and go west until you hit sand. | Ninja Boy Nate is hidden in the sand pile. This is a big teardrop-shaped sand island, and it’s got a lot of trainers on it., The first one is Ninja Boy Nate, but he’s hidden – you have to interact with the mound of sand to get him to challenge you. | South of him are four more trainers to battle, and they’re no pushovers. You may want to go back to Dehara to heal after you take them on. | Beauty Grace, Bird Keeper Ramiro, and Tubers Amir and Alexis. Once that’s done, surf southeast.

chunks.t: Part 21: Routes 13 and 14 – Route 13
chunks.x: Swimmer Nora and Richard. Two more swimmers will be waiting to ambush you as you continue south – make sure you defeat both of them, because it’s easy to miss one., Swimmer Melissa is south of them, near a Trainer Tips sign. | Swimmer Melissa. Keep going south and you’ll ruin into one final trainer on this route., When Swimmer Anya is defeated, you’ll see a sign marking the cross point between Routes 13 and 14.

chunks.t: Part 21: Routes 13 and 14 – Route 14
chunks.x: Picnicker Heide. And from Heidi you can follow the curve of the island south to another trainer. | Expert Litzy. There are two trainers here, and once they’re defeated, you can move on., From there, surf west until you see a big rock island.

chunks.t: Part 21: Routes 13 and 14 – Route 14
chunks.x: The southeast corner of the rocky island duo. This next section of Route 14 is two rocky islands connected by a bridge., Surf going west along the southern edge of the easternmost island until you come to a channel in the middle. | The channel through the rocky islands. Head up that channel and under the bridge until you come to the sea north of the islands. | Swimmer Tony and the way to the Ruins of Void. North of here is the Ruins of Void., There’s also a sign here that explains that dark patches of water require the Advanced Digging and Diving Machine to explore. | Defeat Swimmer Tony here, and then return to the south side of the islands.

chunks.t: Part 21: Routes 13 and 14 – Route 14
chunks.x: Swimmer Raxle. Follow the edge of the islands west until you run into Swimmer Raxle., Eventually, you’ll come to a spot where you can land on the west island. | The landing point. Head up the stairs and into the long grass., Follow the path east until you reach Aroma Lady Violet. | Picnicker Carol. Past her, there’s a small staircase leading to a lake on the very top of the island. Picnicker Carol is here, half-hidden by the long grass., Once you’re done with the island, go back to the water and surf west.

chunks.t: Part 21: Routes 13 and 14 – Route 14

Walk west up the steps and you’ll find yourself on a massive land bridge, the final section of Route 14. | Worker Lewis. Worker Lewis is to the north, and Collector Diddy is to the south.

chunks.t: Part 22: Auburn Waterway & Lost Tunnel – Auburn Waterway
chunks.x: Trainer Fisherman Kenneth: Wishiwashi (Water) Lv40, Gyarados (Water/Flying) Lv41. Prize ₽1,792 | Trainer Swimmer Mymo: Golduck (Water) Lv41, Lombre (Water/Grass) Lv41. Prize ₽1,320 | Trainer Swimmer Nicole: Masquerain (Bug/Flying) Lv41 | Now that you have Surf, it’s time to explore the Auburn Waterway from the north side. | The north shore of the Auburn Waterway. Jump into the water and head southeast.

chunks.t: Part 22: Auburn Waterway & Lost Tunnel – Auburn Waterway
chunks.x: Swimmer Harold. You will most likely run into Swimmer Harold on the way past – this area has a few trainers in it so keep your eyes peeled if you need the training., Continue to the southeast until you see a large landmass with some trees – then turn south. | The end of the peninsula. Keep going south until you come to a small island with a lone fisherman and a patch of long grass. | The Rain Dance TM | Fisherman Kenneth and the island. From the island, turn west. You may run into Swimmer Nicole on the way.

chunks.t: Part 22: Auburn Waterway & Lost Tunnel – Auburn Waterway
chunks.x: A clown hiding in the trees. As you go west, you may notice a clown lurking in the trees. This is your destination, but you’ll have to take a roundabout way to get there. | Land when you can and head into the grass. Follow the edge of the treeline west until you see a gap in the trees big enough for you to land in., Don’t jump off the cliff to the west – it leads into the area where you found all those Granbull Goons earlier. Instead, head east through the long grass. | The clown is found. You will eventually reach the clown, who is so surprised you found him he gives you TM18 Rain Dance., Make your way back to the lone fisherman’s island and head northeast until you find a slightly bigger island with a Hiker on it.

chunks.t: Part 22: Auburn Waterway & Lost Tunnel – Auburn Waterway
chunks.x: Helping the Hiker | Hiker Finn has a task for you. When you speak to him, he is in a bit of a jam – his Pokémon dug a tunnel up here to the island, but apparently it learned a new move when it leveled up and forgot how to use Dig., He needs you to get a Pokémon who knows Dig to help him find the tunnel again and the way out. | If you don’t have one already, it’s recommended to go to Cinder Volcano Depths – where you fought the Light of Ruin and Groudon – and catch an Excadrill. It should know Dig by default., Then, you can come back here and accept the Hiker’s mission., However, to prove you’re up to it, he challenges you to a battle first. | Trainer Hiker Finn: Graveler (Rock/Ground) Lvscales, Lairon (Steel/Rock) Lvscales. Prize ₽1,696 | Once you’ve beaten him, your Pokémon will automatically use Dig and you’ll find yourself in a dark tunnel.

chunks.t: Part 22: Auburn Waterway & Lost Tunnel – Auburn Waterway
chunks.x: Items: Misty Seed, Big Mushroom, TM18 Rain Dance, TM89 U-Turn, Damp Rock, Max Repel, Yellow Shard, Zygarde Cell #36, Zygarde Cell #37, Vivillon pattern River | Special Encounters (Miraheze wiki): Vivillon (River form) Lv50

chunks.t: Part 22: Auburn Waterway & Lost Tunnel – Lost Tunnel
chunks.x: Lost Tunnel | Lost Tunnel map. Healing Chansey and Entrance, Diglett Attack, Golem Attack, Dugtrio Attack. KBT Expressway

chunks.t: Part 22: Auburn Waterway & Lost Tunnel – Lost Tunnel
chunks.x: Items: Aggronite, Luminous Moss (hidden), Zygarde Cell, Max Repel | Wild Pokémon [Cave]: Graveler (Rock/Ground) Lv38–40, Woobat (Psychic/Flying) Lv30–40, Lairon (Steel/Rock) Lv38–40 10%, Diglett (Ground) Lv38–40, Dugtrio (Ground) Lv38–40 5% | Wild Pokémon [Rock Smash]: Geodude (Rock/Ground) Lv35–40 80%, Graveler (Rock/Ground)

chunks.t: Part 22: Auburn Waterway & Lost Tunnel – Lost Tunnel
chunks.x: Sure is dark in here. When you first arrive here, you won’t be able to see more than a tile around you in all directions. Having a Pokémon with Flash will not help. | There’s a Chansey behind you. There’s no way back up – the only way is forward out of the tunnel’s only other exit., Luckily, you landed in a spot with a healing Chansey, so at least you can make sure your team is healthy. | The first T-junction. From where you landed, proceed south until you see a T-junction. Ignore it and continue on south., The path will then turn to the west.

chunks.t: Part 22: Auburn Waterway & Lost Tunnel – Lost Tunnel
chunks.x: The second T-junction. You will eventually hit another T-junction., Follow the north path this time. | The third T-junction. You’ll come to yet another T-junction, where you’ll need to take the west path., When it leads to a four-way intersection, there’s a sudden earthquake, and you’re attacked by a Diglett! It scales to your level, so it might be a tough fight no matter what – unless you know a Water move or two, of course. | Pokémon Encounter: Diglett (Ground) Lvscales | That was a tough Diglett. After the fight, take the south path from that intersection – it will hook around to the west, and eventually you’ll be attacked again., This time, it’s a Golem.

chunks.t: Part 22: Auburn Waterway & Lost Tunnel – Lost Tunnel
chunks.x: Pokémon Encounter: Golem (Rock/Ground) Lvscales | The cave seems hostile. After you’ve taken care of the Golem, you’ll notice you’re at another T-junction., Head north here, and the path will take a turn west. | Yet another T-junction. From there, walk north, and there’s another choice to make. | Surely you’re near the end now. Take the east path, and when you come to another intersection, ignore it and keep heading east. There will be a slight turn up before you’ll come to the final T-junction.

chunks.t: Part 22: Auburn Waterway & Lost Tunnel – Lost Tunnel
chunks.x: The final T-junction at last. Head east from there, and it won’t be long before you’re ambushed by another Pokémon – this time a Dugtrio. | Pokémon Encounter: Dugtrio (Ground) Lvscales | That battle was the last. After three battles, it seems like the Lost Tunnel is done with us., Keep going east, ignoring a blocked-off passage, and you’ll eventually find what you’ve been looking for all this time. | The way out. That’s right, it’s a ladder, and it’ll lead you and the Hiker out of this dim place.

chunks.t: Part 22: Auburn Waterway & Lost Tunnel – Lost Tunnel
chunks.x: Getting TM28 Dig | Your reward. The Hiker is grateful enough to give you a gift – TM28 Dig. If he had the TM all along, why ask for your help in the first place?, Anyway, head north out of this tunnel and you’ll find yourself in a familiar place. | Leaving the Lost Tunnel | The KBT Expressway. You’ll be in a section of the KBT Expressway, close to Fallshore City and Epidimy Town., This is handy, because your next destination is Epidimy Town and Thundercap Mountain. | Items: Aggronite, Luminous Moss, Max Repel, TM28 Dig, Zygarde Cell #38

chunks.t: Part 23: Return to Thundercap Mountain – Return to Thundercap
chunks.x: Return to Thundercap | The first chamber of Thundercap Mountain. Now that you have Surf, there are a few key things you should do in Thundercap Mountain.

chunks.t: Part 23: Return to Thundercap Mountain – Return to Thundercap
chunks.x: Items: TM24 Thunderbolt (southwest area), Max Ether (southeast area), Electric Seed (east area), Electirizer (southeast area), Protein (Main Cavern, northeast side) | The southeast corner of 2F. Head up to 2F and go to the southeast corner, where you will find a large underground lake., Surf east across it until you come to a ladder leading to 3F. | Another Tablet Cavern section. It will take you up to the part of 3F that has the Ancient Tablet in it, this time on a side you haven’t been able to access yet., Go north, and you’ll find a boulder puzzle.

chunks.t: Part 23: Return to Thundercap Mountain – Return to Thundercap
chunks.x: The boulder puzzle. This puzzle is a little complicated, so there are some step-by-step instructions you should follow., Also, you should have previously pushed the extra boulder down the hole from the Electivire Chamber on 4F if you haven’t already. | Thundercap Boulder Puzzle | Each boulder has a letter – refer to this image. Step 1: The first move you should make is to push boulder A to the west. | After the first move. Step 2: Then, push B boulder to the north.

chunks.t: Part 23: Return to Thundercap Mountain – Return to Thundercap
chunks.x: After the second move. Step 3: Push C boulder to the south. | After the third move (boulder A is now D). Step 4: Then, push boulder D (which is actually boulder A, west of its starting position) to the south. | After the fourth move. Step 5: Push boulder E to the west.

chunks.t: Part 23: Return to Thundercap Mountain – Return to Thundercap
chunks.x: After the fifth move. Step 6: Push boulder F to the south. | After the sixth move. Step 7: Push boulder G to the north. | After the seventh move. Step 8: Push boulder H all the way to the west.

chunks.t: Part 23: Return to Thundercap Mountain – Return to Thundercap
chunks.x: After the eighth move. Step 9: Clear the rocks with Rock Smash and push boulder I to the west. | After the ninth move. Step 10: Push boulder I again to the north, on to the button. | After the final move. This side of the puzzle is now complete. | The 2nd Boulder Puzzle | Go south and then west, jumping off the cliff, until you’re on the left side of the cavern and can see the other boulder puzzle.

chunks.t: Part 23: Return to Thundercap Mountain – Return to Thundercap
chunks.x: This puzzle is straightforward enough. To complete this one, just smash all the rocks here and move the southern boulder up to rest on top of the button. | The electric fence turns off. Now that both boulders are on the buttons, the electric fence in the northwest of the chamber turns off., This reveals your prize, a Manectite. | After the Puzzles | The ladder in the north. Now that that is taken care of, go to the ladder in the north of the chamber., It will take you to a new area of 4F – the Maze Chamber.

chunks.t: Part 23: Return to Thundercap Mountain – Thundercap Mountain – 4F, Maze Chamber
chunks.x: Thundercap Mountain – 4F, Maze Chamber | Maze Chamber map. Yellow Pokémon Witness, Lost Kid, Camper Phillip and Picnicker Tina, Dugtrio Attack, Hikers Dario and Daryl, Kid Drop-off Point, Youngster Benward and Lass Miriam. Ladder Down to 3F Tablet Cave

chunks.t: Part 23: Return to Thundercap Mountain – Thundercap Mountain – 4F, Maze Chamber
chunks.x: Items: Nugget (hidden), Calcium, Timer Ball, TM73 Thunder Wave, Rare Candy, Thick Club | Trainer Camper Phillip and Picnicker Tina: Sandshrew (Ground) Lv41, Audino (Normal) Lv39, Snivy (Grass) Lv39. Prize ₽2,240 | Trainer Hikers Dario and Daryl: Kabuto (Rock/Water) Lv39, Omastar (Rock/Water) Lv41, Aggron (Steel/Rock) Lv42. Prize ₽1,824 | Trainer Camper Dwayne and Picnicker Martha: Dedenne (Electric/Fairy) Lv39, Oshawott (Water) Lv40, Tepig (Fire) Lv40, Wormadam (Bug/Grass) Lv41. Prize ₽2,240

chunks.t: Part 23: Return to Thundercap Mountain – Thundercap Mountain – 4F, Maze Chamber
chunks.x: Trainer Youngster Benward and Lass Miriam: Raticate (Normal) Lv41, Buneary (Normal) Lv39, Linoone (Normal) Lv39, Clefairy (Fairy) Lv40. Prize ₽880 | First steps in the Maze Chamber. When you arrive in the chamber, cross the pond to the east with Surf., Then continue on east until you hit a corner area. | The corner area. From here, head north until you see an intersection. | The intersection. Take note of where this is – you’ll need to come back here a little later., For now, head east.

chunks.t: Part 23: Return to Thundercap Mountain – Thundercap Mountain – 4F, Maze Chamber
chunks.x: The T-junction. South of this T-junction is a man who saw a strange Pokémon around here, but you can’t help him yet if you don’t have the Advanced Digging and Diving Machine., Go north and follow that tunnel around until you see a boy in a Pikachu outfit. | The Pikachu Boy | Milo needs rescuing. It’s Milo, and he’s stuck in this cave waiting for someone to lead him the way out., Agree, and he’ll start following you. You will only be able to use your first three Pokémon in battle, and he will battle alongside you in Double Battles with his two Pikachu. | Note: You can’t Surf while he is following you, so you can’t simply go back across the pond., Here’s the most efficient route to follow:

chunks.t: Part 23: Return to Thundercap Mountain – Thundercap Mountain – 4F, Maze Chamber
chunks.x: The most efficient path to the exit is marked by the red line | Follow the tunnel back to the previous intersection, and get rid of the rock blocking the way with Rock Smash., Head north, and you’ll find an ambush waiting for you. | Camper Phillip and Picnicker Tina. Phillip and Tina will give you a Double Battle. Once they’ve been defeated, head west to another intersection.

chunks.t: Part 23: Return to Thundercap Mountain – Thundercap Mountain – 4F, Maze Chamber
chunks.x: The next intersection. Break the rock and head north along the tunnel there. It will zigzag along north and west until you hit the very northern wall of the chamber., Follow it west until you come to a T-junction. | The northern T-junction. From here, go south until you see an intersection with a smashable rock in the middle of it. | The smashable rock and the intersection. West of here is three more sets of Double Battles for you to fight, should you wish to., However, the best way to get to the exit is to smash the rock and head down the east passage.

chunks.t: Part 23: Return to Thundercap Mountain – Thundercap Mountain – 4F, Maze Chamber
chunks.x: Continue through the passage. The passage will twist slightly, and there will be an intersection you need to pass with some dead ends, but eventually you will find your way to where the exit is., You will see a smashable rock – get rid of it and go through the gap. | Milo’s time with you is at an end. Milo will see the ladder and thank you for your help with TM73 Thunder Wave. | Your reward. After Milo leaves, you’re free to keep exploring the chamber or jump south over the cliff and back to the ladder., Your choice here based on how much you want to explore, but eventually our next step is to leave the mountain.

chunks.t: Part 23: Return to Thundercap Mountain – Thundercap Mountain – 4F, Maze Chamber
chunks.x: After Helping Milo | Dehara City is where we need to go next. After all that, it is finally time to set out into the Great Desert., But before you do, you’ll need to head to Dehara City and go to the intersection of four houses. | A Hiker in the southeast house has a special item you need to brave the desert.

chunks.t: Part 24: The Great Desert & Gurun Town – Preparing for the Desert
chunks.x: Preparing for the Desert | The Go-Goggles are found here. In order to venture into the Great Desert, you’ll need some eye protection. Thankfully you can get some in Dehara City, at the house just west of the desert gate. | Now you’re all set. The Hiker inside will only give these to someone who has completed the Dehara Gym challenge – and since you have, he’ll hand over the Go-Goggles no problem.

chunks.t: Part 24: The Great Desert & Gurun Town – Preparing for the Desert
chunks.x: Your Rival shows up, and so does Arthur. When you go to leave for the desert, your Rival shows up and acts all tough as usual. However, Arthur arrives and wants to talk to you about Jax, who has been missing ever since the Ruins of Void., Your Rival throws a tantrum at being ignored, and rushes off into the desert to get to Vivill Town. | We’ll need to follow him, because Arthur says Jax may be there as well. | Great Desert | The Great Desert map. Nurse Linda, Roughneck Cameron, Youngster Dave, Guitarist Nelson, Kindler Blaze, Camper Drew, Tomb of Borrius, Ruin Maniac Grady, Pokemon Ranger Logan, Hiker Lucas, Psychic Rode, Bird Keepers Roger and Reed, Clown of the Sands, Black Belt Kiyo, Warmonger Mission, Collector Dawson, Ruin Maniac Larry

chunks.x: Trainer Bird Keepers Roger and Reed: Rufflet (Normal/Flying) Lv40, Vullaby (Dark/Flying) Lv39, Doduo (Normal/Flying) Lv39, Archen (Rock/Flying) Lv39. Prize ₽1,920 | Trainer Ruin Maniac Larry: Crustle (Bug/Rock) Lv40, Hippowdon (Ground) Lv41. Prize ₽2,880 | A handy Nurse is at the entrance. There is a constant sandstorm raging here that will damage any battling Pokémon that isn’t Rock-, Steel-, or Ground-type., With this in mind, it’s a good thing that the first trainer on the route is a Nurse, who will heal your team if you defeat her. | You may be coming back here periodically., Head east into the sand when you’re ready.

chunks.t: Part 24: The Great Desert & Gurun Town – Great Desert
chunks.x: Roughneck Cameron. On your way east, you’ll run into Roughneck Cameron, who is at the bottom of a sandpit., Once he’s been taken care of, keep going. | Youngster Dave. Youngster Dave is roaming around near Cameron, and you’ll likely run into him on the way east., When you see him, start turning south. | Guitarist Nelson, and the break in the bluffs south. You will come up against a rocky bluff wall – follow it south, past Guitarist Nelson and his team of Electric Pokémon, and into a pass that leads into a small valley.

chunks.t: Part 24: The Great Desert & Gurun Town – Great Desert
chunks.x: Kindler Blaze and the valley. There are a couple of trainers in this valley, but the most interesting site here is in the southeast corner. | The entrance to the tomb. King Borrius the Third is buried here, and the tomb is currently being occupied by a couple of wannabe tomb-raiders., There’s not much to do inside yet, but there is one item that is pretty important to pick up here. | A hidden treasure. Behind the pillar on the east side of the chamber is a Relic Copper – hold on to it, because you will get a lot of value out of it shortly.

chunks.t: Part 24: The Great Desert & Gurun Town – Great Desert
chunks.x: The north tip of the bluff. Return to where Guitarist Nelson is and follow the rock wall north until you can see the tip of it., Psychic Rode is here, and on the other side of the bluff tip is a passage leading into a thin canyon. | Double Battle in the canyon. Bird Keepers Roger and Reed are waiting to give you a Double Battle as soon as you enter., Once they’re done follow the canyon around and you’ll see a clown. | The clown of the sand. Break the rocks surrounding the clown and he will tell you that if you break all the rocks to the west and south of here, then he will be freed and give you a reward.

chunks.t: Part 24: The Great Desert & Gurun Town – Great Desert
chunks.x: Fossils are a rare drop from smashing rocks. One important thing to note – smashing rocks in the Great Desert is encouraged, because there’s a small chance you’ll get a Fossil from it., There are a lot of Fossils to collect, and all of them can be turned into Pokémon at Gurun Town. | If you manage to smash all the rocks the clown mentioned, the reward is TM37 Sandstorm, which is very appropriate. | The clown’s gratitude. When you leave the other entrance to the canyon, head north until you pass the eastern tip of the bluff. | The east bluff tip and Black Belt Kiyo. Then head straight east until you see the coast.

chunks.t: Part 24: The Great Desert & Gurun Town – Great Desert
chunks.x: The Lucario cult wants us to join. There’s an old man here who is a member of the Undying Lucario cult, and he challenges you to fight 2000 Pokémon Battles to be inducted. That may take some time!, Your reward, if you make it that far, is a Lucarionite. | After speaking to him, head south. | Collector Dawson. You should see Collector Dawson in a large sandpit. Once you make it there, head east until you see a route sign sticking out of the sand. | East of here is Gurun Town. This marks the end of the desert and the beginning of Gurun Town – which is a pit stop on the way to confronting the Light of Ruin at Vivill.

chunks.t: Part 24: The Great Desert & Gurun Town – Great Desert
