chunks.t: Part 24: The Great Desert & Gurun Town – Gurun Town
chunks.x: Gurun Town | Gurun Town map. Pokémon Center, Fossil Revival House, Relic House, Fisherman’s House, Poke Mart. Great Desert, Route 16, (west) KBT Expressway, Route 18, (center) Vivill Woods | Items: Zygarde Cell, Charti Berry (hidden) | Wild Pokémon [Surfing]: Tentacool (Water/Poison) Lv35–40 60%, Tentacruel (Water/Poison) Lv38–40 5%, Pelipper (Water/Flying) Lv35–40 30%, Mantine (Water/Flying) Lv38–40 5%

chunks.t: Part 24: The Great Desert & Gurun Town – Gurun Town
chunks.x: Wild Pokémon [Fishing]: Magikarp (Water (Old Rod)) Lv10–15 100%, Remoraid (Water (Good Rod)) Lv20–25 60%, Corsola (Water/Rock (Good Rod)) Lv20–50, Horsea (Water (Good Rod)) Lv20–25 20%, Octillery (Water (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 40%, Corsola (Water/Rock (Super Rod)) Lv20–50, Seadra (Water (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 40%, Kingdra (Water/Dragon (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 5% | Gurun Town Pokémon Center. Gurun Town has a unique look to it, and apparently a lot of history behind it., After healing your Pokémon at the Center, head north. | Two houses in Gurun Town. There are two houses here in the northwest part of town – head into the left house first.

chunks.t: Part 24: The Great Desert & Gurun Town – Gurun Town
chunks.x: The Fossil Revival scientist. The scientist in this house can revive any Fossils you may have found from the Great Desert, so you may be coming back here quite often., After you’re done here, go next door. | The Relic Copper can be sold here. The Black Belt in this house will buy any Relic items you have, including the Relic Copper you got from the Tomb of Borrius. | This man requests a lot of Hard Stones. The other man in the room wants 20 Hard Stones – if you manage to collect that many, he’ll give you TM111 Smack Down.

chunks.t: Part 24: The Great Desert & Gurun Town – Gurun Town
chunks.x: The Fisherman’s house. The house across the road to the east from the two you’ve already been to contains a Fisherman, and he wants to know if you’ve caught at least 3 Pokémon from fishing. | The Fisherman wants to know. If you have, the Fisherman will hurriedly rush off to East Borrius and leave behind a Pearl., If you visit the Poke Mart, you can speak to a woman inside and she’ll give you a free Lemonade. Lots of goodies to get here! | The Poke Mart. And then northwest of town is the local entrance of the KBT Expressway.

chunks.t: Part 24: The Great Desert & Gurun Town – Gurun Town
chunks.x: Items: Lemonade, Charti Berry, Pearl, TM111 Smack Down, Grass Gem, Fire Gem, Water Gem, Electric Gem, Fighting Gem, Psychic Gem, Steel Gem, Dragon Gem, Ghost Gem, Dark Gem, Ground Gem, Rock Gem, Flying Gem, Bug Gem, Ice Gem, Normal Gem, Poison Gem, Fairy Gem, Zygarde Cell #61 | Special Encounters (Miraheze wiki): Larvesta (Egg) Lv1, Omanyte (Gift) Lv25, Kabuto (Gift) Lv25, Aerodactyl (Gift) Lv25, Lileep (Gift) Lv25, Anorith (Gift) Lv25, Cranidos (Gift) Lv25, Shieldon (Gift) Lv25, Tirtouga (Gift) Lv25, Archen (Gift) Lv25, Tyrunt (Gift) Lv25, Amaura (Gift) Lv25, Spiritomb (Special) Lv35

chunks.t: Part 24: The Great Desert & Gurun Town – KBT Expressway – Gurun Section
chunks.x: KBT Expressway – Gurun Section | The KBT Expressway entrance. The section of the expressway around Gurun Town, Antisis City and Dehara City has its own set of Pokémon to catch, so it might be worth venturing inside to check it out. | Wild Pokémon [Cave]: Golbat (Poison/Flying) Lv38–41 25%, Woobat (Psychic/Flying) Lv18–41 25%, Hariyama (Fighting) Lv38–41 15%, Lairon (Steel/Rock) Lv38–41 10%, Nosepass (Rock) Lv18–41 10%, Graveler (Rock/Ground) Lv38–41 10%, Noibat (Flying/Dragon) Lv18–41 5% | The Gurun Town exit. There are a few Gem Family members in this section of the tunnel.

chunks.t: Part 24: The Great Desert & Gurun Town – KBT Expressway – Gurun Section
chunks.x: Gem Family Move Shops | If you’re done with exploring the Expressway, head back out. | Moving Forward | The entrance to Vivill Woods. Your next destination is Vivill Town, which is on the other side of Vivill Woods., The entrance to the woods is on the north side of Gurun Town, up a set of stairs. So that’s where we’ll be heading next.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Woods
chunks.x: Vivill Woods | Vivill Woods map. Bug Catcher Kent, Medium Hope, Bug Catcher Robby, Fungus Pokemon, Bug Maniac Keigo, Bug Catcher Elijah. Gurun Town, Vivill Town

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Woods
chunks.x: Items: Zygarde Cell, Big Root, Big Mushroom (hidden), Sun Stone, TM81 X-Scissor, Tiny Mushroom (hidden) | Items: Big Mushroom (hidden), PP Up

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Woods
chunks.x: Wild Pokémon [Long Grass]: Wurmple (Bug Day and Night) Lv30–35 20%, Silcoon (Bug Day and Night) Lv39–41 5%, Cascoon (Bug Day and Night) Lv39–41 5%, Scatterbug (Bug Day and Night) Lv30–35 10%, Spewpa (Bug Day and Night) Lv39–41 5%, Cottonee (Grass/Fairy Day and Night) Lv39–41 10%, Swadloon (Bug/Grass Day and Night) Lv39–41 5%, Petilil (Grass Day and Night) Lv39–41 10%, Caterpie (Bug Day) Lv30–35 Day 20% / Night 0%, Metapod (Bug Day) Lv39–41 Day 5% / Night 0%, Weedle (Bug Night) Lv30–35 Day 0% / Night 20%, Kakuna (Bug Night) Lv39–41 Day 0% / Night 5% | Wild Pokémon [Surfing]: Golduck (Water) Lv38–41 30%, Masquerain (Bug/Flying) Lv38–41 5%

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Woods
chunks.x: Wild Pokémon [Fishing]: Magikarp (Water (Old Rod)) Lv10–15 100%, Psyduck (Water (Good Rod)) Lv20–25 80%, Barboach (Water/Ground (Good Rod)) Lv20–25 20%, Golduck (Water (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 70%, Whiscash (Water/Ground (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 30% | Trainer Bug Catcher Kent: Scatterbug (Bug) Lv41, Wurmple (Bug) Lv41. Prize ₽492 | Trainer Medium Hope: Dusclops (Ghost) Lv42, Palossand (Ghost/Ground) Lv42. Prize ₽2,016 | Trainer Bug Catcher Robby: Silcoon (Bug) Lv42, Cascoon (Bug) Lv42, Spewpa (Bug) Lv42. Prize ₽504

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Woods
chunks.x: Trainer Bug Maniac Keigo: Beautifly (Bug/Flying) Lv42, Dustox (Bug/Poison) Lv42, Vivillon (Bug/Flying) Lv43. Prize ₽1,376 | Trainer Bug Catcher Elijah: Butterfree (Bug/Flying) Lv43. Prize ₽516 | The first part of Vivill Woods. Vivill Woods is full of Bug Pokémon and trainers who use them, and you’ll need to go through it to get to Vivill Town to stop the Light of Ruin., When you enter the woods, head east through the long grass. | Bug Catcher Kent. You will probably run into Bug Catcher Kent on your way through. Eventually, you will come to a clearing.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Woods
chunks.x: Medium Hope. Walk west and you’ll have to get past Medium Hope. Keep heading west until you see an opportunity to go north through another patch of long grass. | Bug Catcher Robby. There’s a Bug Catcher walking around here. | Getting a New Pokemon | The way forward is actually east, but there’s an important thing to pick up here on the other side of the pond. | A Poke Ball with a Pokemon in it. There’s a Poke Ball here, and it’s not empty or an item – it’s an actual Pokémon., Depending on your Trainer ID, which is random, you’ll receive either a Foongus or a Morelull. If you evolve the Pokémon you receive, you’ll be able to trade it for the other one in Vivill Town.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Woods
chunks.x: Fungus Pokémon: Foongus (Grass/Poison) Lv35, Morelull (Grass/Fairy) Lv35 | Bug Maniac Kelgo | Leaving towards Vivill Town | After you get the Pokémon, go back to where you came from and head east into the final clearing of Vivill Woods., Bug Maniac Kelgo is waiting to challenge you, but after him, the exit is in sight. | The exit to Vivill Town. Head on through the exit to the north and you’ll find yourself at your destination at last.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Woods
chunks.x: Items: Big Root, TM81 X-Scissor, PP Up, Tiny Mushroom, Big Mushroom, Dusk Stone, Trainer Tips sign #30, Zygarde Cell #62, Vivillon pattern Elegant, Portal #21, Kartana | Special Encounters (Miraheze wiki): Paras (Static) Lv35, Vivillon (Elegant form) Lv50 | Vivill Town – Abandoned | Your Rival is waiting for you. As soon as you emerge into Vivill Town though, it’s rainy and gloomy, and nobody seems to be around., Except your Rival, who is impatient to get things moving.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Town – Abandoned
chunks.x: Only the Pokémon Center and Poke Mart are open. All of the townsfolk are hiding in their houses or fled, but you still can heal your Pokémon at the Pokémon Center or buy things at the Mart., When you’re ready to take on the Light of Ruin, walk north to the warehouse. | Famous last words. Together with your Rival, you confront the Light of Ruin guard on the door, and he boasts that the Light of Ruin are too strong to be taken down by just two people – you’re gonna need backup. | The Shadows arrive for revenge. Well, backup arrives, in spectacular fashion., The Shadows arrive on a boat and blow a hole in the side of the facility, taking the Light of Ruin by surprise.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Town – Abandoned
chunks.x: Time to join battle. Your Rival takes that opportunity to knock the guard out, so you’re free to follow him into the warehouse. | Items: Pure Incense, Green Shard x2, Link Stone x10 | Special Encounters (Miraheze wiki): Amoongus (Among Us) (Trade) Lv46, Shiinotic (Shin) (Trade) Lv46

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Warehouse
chunks.x: Vivill Warehouse | Vivill Warehouse map – each letter is a teleporter, linked to the same letter in a different room. Teleporter to Command Center, Shadow Warrior B First Password Letter, Light of Ruin Grunt B, Light of Ruin Grunt C Second Password Letter, Shadow Warrior C Light of Ruin Grunt D Third Password Letter, Shadow Warrior D Fourth Password Letter, Shadow Warrior E Light of Ruin Grunt E Fifth Password Letter, Light of Ruin Grunt F

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Warehouse
chunks.x: Exit to Vivill Warehouse 1F, B1F Lobby to B2F Flooded Lab, B1F Lobby to B2F Rest Room, B2F Rest Room to B2F Storage Access, B2F Storage Access to B3F Main Storage, B3F Main Storage to B2F Isolation Chamber, B1F Lobby to B1F Cafeteria, B1F Cafeteria to B2F Kitchen, B2F Kitchen to B1F Break Room, B1F Break Room to B1F Lobby, B2F Kitchen to B1F Small Storage, B1F Small Storage to B3F Vault, B1F Lobby to B2F Power Grid, B2F Power Grid to B2F Private Dining, B2F Private Dining to B1F Rear Hallway, B1F Rear Hallway to B1F Hidden Storage

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Warehouse
chunks.x: Items: Fairy Gem (hidden), Zygarde Cell, Hyper Potion, Whip Dream, PP Up (hidden), Sachet | Items: Zygarde Cell, Max Revive, Gardevoirite | Wild Pokémon [Surfing]: Tentacool (Water/Poison) Lv35–40 60%, Tentacruel (Water/Poison) Lv38–40 5%, Seadra (Water) Lv35–40 5%

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Warehouse
chunks.x: Wild Pokémon [Fishing]: Magikarp (Water (Old Rod)) Lv10–15 100%, Horsea (Water (Good Rod)) Lv20–25 60%, Shellder (Water/Rock (Good Rod)) Lv20–50 40%, Seadra (Water (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 40%, Shellder (Water (Super Rod)) Lv20–50 40%, Gyarados (Water/Flying (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 15%, Dhelmise (Ghost/Grass (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 5% | Trainers and Enemies | Trainer Shadow Warriors A-E: Shadow Warrior (Ghost/Dark (level scales)) Lv? | Trainer Light of Ruin Grunt A: Granbull (Fairy) Lv45 | Trainer Light of Ruin Grunt B: Mawile (Steel/Fairy) Lv44, Gardevoir (Psychic/Fairy) Lv45

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Warehouse
chunks.x: Trainer Light of Ruin Grunt C: Whimsicott (Grass/Fairy) Lv45 | Trainer Light of Ruin Grunt D: Floette (Fairy) Lv44, Shiinotic (Grass/Fairy) Lv45 | Trainer Light of Ruin Grunt E: Floette (Fairy) Lv45, Togetic (Fairy/Flying) Lv45, Dedenne (Electric/Fairy) Lv45 | Trainer Light of Ruin Grunt F: Azumarill (Water/Fairy) Lv45, Floette (Fairy) Lv46, Klefki (Steel/Fairy) Lv45, Comfey (Fairy) Lv44 | The Shadow Warriors are here as well. The first thing you see while inside is a Shadow Warrior dealing with a whole group of Light of Ruin Grunts., When it’s done with them, it comes for you.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Warehouse
chunks.x: Avoid the fire – it applies Burn. When you’ve defeated it, the way is clear to head downstairs. There are patches of fire still left from its battle with the Grunts – do not touch them or you’ll burn your Pokémon. | The guard makes one last effort to stop you. When you make it to the staircase, the guard from outside wants to fight., He’s easily taken care of, though, and you’re free to head down into the lobby. | Arriving on B1F. Your Rival has rushed ahead of you (as usual) so you’ll need to find a way to get to the leaders of the Light of Ruin yourself., From the staircase, head west.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Warehouse
chunks.x: The teleporter junction. There are four teleporter pads here in a junction of sorts. Your Rival went through one of them, and they lead to different areas in the base., For now though, ignore these teleport pads and just keep going west. | The stairs to B2F. Walk down the stairs you find to the west and you’ll end up in a flooded chamber. | The Shadows’ ship broke through here. Apparently this used to be the Research Lab, before the Shadows arrived of course. Now you’ll have to surf across it.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Warehouse
chunks.x: A special teleporter revealed. In the southwest corner of the flooded lab, there’s a Strength boulder lying on a special green teleport pad., Step on it, and you’ll find yourself in the Command Centre. | The Shadows can’t get inside. However, there’s a door they can’t get past. And you’ll need to find the password to open it for them., The password is six letters long, and the Shadows already have one letter, so that’s five letters you need to find. | Finding the Password | Head back up to the lobby on B1F to start the scavenger hunt. | Use the southwest pad first. Start your search by stepping on the southwest teleport pad – it will take you to another area of B2F, the Rest Room.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Warehouse
chunks.x: Time to anger a Shadow Warrior. Here, a Light of Ruin Grunt is being attacked by a Shadow Warrior., In order to resolve things, you’ll have to go up to the Shadow Warrior and remove its cloak, which makes it mad enough to attack you. | O is the first letter acquired. The Grunt is grateful to you for saving him and gives you a letter of the password, as well as telling you that you can rest here at any time to heal your Pokémon. | Take the top teleport pad to proceed. There are two teleport pads in this room – you arrived on the bottom one, so step on the one on top to go to a new area.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Warehouse
chunks.x: Another area of B2F. It takes you to a hallway of sorts elsewhere on B2F., Head northwest, and you’ll see another Light of Ruin Grunt. However, this one isn’t friendly and will challenge you. | The stairs down. Once they’re defeated, head down the staircase and you’ll be on B3F, the storage level. | The storage level. After you make it down the stairs, go east and you’ll see a whole pile of boxes.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Warehouse
chunks.x: The teleport pad is in the southeast corner. Move through them and you’ll see another teleport pad – step on it and it will take you to a small room back on B2F. | The tiny room and the second letter. There’s a Grunt here that will fight you – and afterwards he will give you the second letter you need for the password., With that done, go all the way back to the teleporter lobby area. | The next stop is the northwest teleport pad. This time, step on the northwest pad and it will whisk you away to the Cafeteria.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Warehouse
chunks.x: The Cafeteria. The Light of Ruin and Shadow Grunts are too busy fighting each other to take much notice of you, so walk north and the next telepad you need is in the northwest corner. | The Kitchen. It takes you to the southwest pad in the Kitchen, and there’s another Shadow Warrior to defeat., Instead of being grateful, the Light of Ruin Grunt it was menacing has the cheek to challenge you right after. | The third letter. They’ll give you the third letter if you defeat them, though. Progress is being made., The northwest teleport pad leads to the Break Room, and from there it connects back to the lobby’s northeast pad, if you need a quick link back to heal.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Warehouse
chunks.x: The next pad is the southeast one. Take the southeast teleport pad in the Kitchen and it leads to another small storage room. | The small storage room. Take the other teleport pad here and you’ll be back down on the storage level – this time in an area you couldn’t access. | Another Shadow Warrior. Defeat the Shadow Warrior that immediately leaps to attack you when you arrive.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Warehouse
chunks.x: The fourth letter. The Light of Ruin Grunt here thanks you with the fourth letter of the password. Just one more letter to go., Go back to the teleporter lobby – there’s only one more pad to take. | The remaining unaccounted-for pad. The southeast pad is the one you need – step on it, and you will be in the Power Grid room. | The Power Grid. There’s another Shadow Warrior-Light of Ruin Grunt pairing to defeat here.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Warehouse
chunks.x: The final letter. However, it is the last fight – this Grunt gives you the final letter you need for the password., Once you win just go back to the flooded lab and then to the control center, and talk to the scientist. | Unlocking the Door | The letters you get add up to AKLOV – and the letter the Shadows have is an E, so that’s “AKLOVE”. | The password is obvious in retrospect. The way forward is open | Now the Shadows can storm into the control room and confront the leader of the Light of Ruin.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Warehouse
chunks.x: Ivory is the one in charge of the base. It’s Marlon’s wife, Ivory, who has betrayed the Shadows and is Aklove’s second in command., There isn’t much time for reunion speeches though – soon after, Aklove and Hoopa emerge from a portal. | Aklove gets the bad news. The Shadows ship crashing into the base has destroyed Aklove’s research, and he feels pretty angry about it., Your Rival shows up, and gets the painful revelation that Marlon and Ivory are his parents. Aklove teleports Marlon, Zeph and your Rival away to parts unknown, before confronting you. | Aklove challenges you. Time to fight Aklove himself. | Trainer Light of Ruin Leader Battle (Aklove): Roserade (Grass/Poison) Lv47, Primarina (Water/Fairy) Lv47, Hoopa Unbound (Psychic/Dark) Lv50. Prize ₽10,200

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – Vivill Warehouse
chunks.x: Hoopa obeys its current master. Angry at being beaten, Aklove asks if you are wondering where Jax is – and orders Hoopa to send you there. | Items: Hyper Potion, Whipped Dream, PP Up, Fairy Gem, Sachet, Max Revive, Gardevoirite, Zygarde Cell #64, Zygarde Cell #65, Max Raid Den #32, Portal #08, Floette | The Distortion World | The Distortion World. You’re taken to the Distortion World, where Jax has been all this time. He’s pleased to see you, but he’s been having trouble finding a way out.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – The Distortion World
chunks.x: You must escape this dimension. In order to get out of here, you’ll have to follow some paths through a weird and changing landscape., Please note that the following section assumes you’re on the simple puzzle difficulty setting, so if you are playing on the harder puzzle difficulty then please visit this page for a step-by-step solution. | Jax awaits on another platform. Follow the path along to find Jax. | Follow the platforms. Step on the middle of the platform Jax is on to be teleported to an identical platform with a series of small islands leading east.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – The Distortion World
chunks.x: Go south and then west. From there, when you reach another big island, go south and then west onto another series of small islands. | Upside down. You’ll need to jump on an upside-down platform to proceed., Follow the path west and then go south, and you’ll see Jax again. | Jax warns you. Jax will leave you to explore after this point, but you will meet up with him later., From Jax, go east, following the platform as it turns north.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – The Distortion World
chunks.x: Step on the north button. Keep going north until you step on a button, which causes more platforms to appear to the east. | Continue east. Jump to the small east island and cross over to the upside-down platform. | Jump to the east finger. Go to the east side of the upside down platform and then jump off it onto the easternmost of the two identical finger-shaped platforms to the south – the one without a button.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – The Distortion World
chunks.x: Keep going east. From there, go east until you step on a button that causes another small three-button platform to appear. Cross it to the east side. | Keep heading ever eastward. Follow the winding platforms east until you come to a choice between two buttons., Take the southernmost one. | Keep going until you see a boulder. It will reveal a platform to the east, and you will see a Strength boulder on the far side of it. Don’t go towards it because the way is blocked by a rock., Head south across a series of small islands.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – The Distortion World
chunks.x: Another platform. It leads to another large platform with even more boulders on it, and a boulder puzzle. | Distortion World – Boulder Puzzle | The boulder puzzle starting position. The two boulders here are paired and will move in the same direction – unless they’re moved towards each other., Step 1: Push the boulder west until there is one space between it and the other boulder. | After the first move. Step 2: Go around to the other side and start pushing the left boulder east.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – The Distortion World
chunks.x: After the second move. Step 3: Keep pushing the boulders east until the right one lines up below the button. | After the third move. Step 4: Go around to the bottom side of the left boulder. | After the fourth move. Step 5: Push this boulder north, and the right boulder will move with it onto the button.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – The Distortion World
chunks.x: The completed puzzle | Continuing the Path | With the boulders in the right position, go to the northwest end of this island. | Head west. Step on the button there and a path will be revealed west. | From here, go south. When you get to a long line of an island, follow it south and step on the button on its southern tip.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – The Distortion World
chunks.x: Follow the path west and north. Keep going along here until you see a platform on the left with five rocks on it. | The platform with the rocks. Get to the button on the north edge and make the jump west to the rock platform. | Step on the button in the middle of the rocks. The button in the middle of the rocks will teleport you to an identical platform in a different area.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – The Distortion World
chunks.x: The pond island. Jump across to the east and you’ll see a pond you can surf on. | The first pond. Surf across the pond and it will lead along a path to a set of small islands. | The small islands. Cross the small islands and you’ll see a second pond to surf on.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – The Distortion World
chunks.x: The waterfall pond. Surf south and you’ll be sailing over a waterfall into the void! | The waterfall. Keep following the waterfall until you get to a third and final pond. | The last pond. From here, continue south until you see the boulder from before – and this time you can push it south.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – The Distortion World
chunks.x: The boulder from before. Keep pushing it until it passes another path and Jax will pop out. | Jax lets us know we’re on the right track. Jax tells us we’re in the right area, so after he finishes talking with us, head east and south. | The last platform. There’s one last platform to step on, so do it and hit the button in the middle.

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – The Distortion World
chunks.x: You’re not alone here. When you do, the platform will move and you’ll hear the sound of a Legendary Pokémon. | Giratina Battle | Giratina approaches. The Distortion World is home to Giratina, and it’s here to test your worth. | Trainer Giratina: Giratina (Ghost/Dragon) Lvscales

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – The Distortion World
chunks.x: Giratina opens a portal. Once it’s been defeated, it opens up a portal for you to return to your dimension. Jump through, and you’ll find yourself in the Rift Cave. | Rift Cave | Rift Cave. Rift Cave is in Dehara City, so it’s easy for you to fly from there back to Vivill Town. | Vivill Town is the next stop. Jax rushes off, leaving you to exit the cave and make your own way there. | Items: Griseous Orb

chunks.t: Part 25: Vivill Woods & Distortion World – The Distortion World
chunks.x: Special Encounters (Miraheze wiki): Giratina (Origin form) Lv70

chunks.t: Part 26: Vivill Town – Vivill Town
chunks.x: Vivill Town map. Pure Incense Lass, Pokemon Center, Poke Mart and Stat Keeper, Trade House, Seed Bomb Teacher, Vivill Warehouse, Jax and Arthur. Vivill Woods, Route 15 | Items: Zygarde Cell, Shiny Stone (inside Vivill Warehouse B5F), Power Lens (inside Vivill Warehouse B5F)

chunks.t: Part 26: Vivill Town – Vivill Town
chunks.x: Wild Pokémon [Surfing]: Tentacool (Water/Poison) Lv35–40 60%, Tentacruel (Water/Poison) Lv38–40 5%, Pelipper (Water/Flying) Lv35–40 30%, Basculin (Water) Lv35–40 5% | Wild Pokémon [Fishing]: Magikarp (Water (Old Rod)) Lv10–15 100%, Horsea (Water (Good Rod)) Lv20–25 20%, Shellder (Water (Good Rod)) Lv45–50 40%, Seadra (Water (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 40%, Shellder (Water (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 40%, Cloyster (Water/Ice (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 1%, Gyarados (Water/Flying (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 19% | Vivill Town is ready to be explored. Now that the Light of Ruin are gone, Vivill Town is filled with its townsfolk again, and you can explore to your heart’s content.

chunks.t: Part 26: Vivill Town – Vivill Town
chunks.x: This lady has Incense for us. Speaking to the woman inside a fenced-off area with flowers in it, just east of the town entrance, will get you a Pure Incense., After that, head to the Pokémon Center next – there’s a person inside that has a mission for you. | The Pokemon Center and Poke Mart are just north of her

chunks.t: Part 26: Vivill Town – Vivill Town
chunks.x: Next In-Game Trade | The trader mission. This man wants you to trade Pokémon at every opportunity, and if you have been following this walkthrough then there are only two trades left for you to make – one in an area you can’t get to yet, and the other right here in Vivill Town., If you trade with all trade NPCs and come back, the mission giver will reward you with 10 Link Stones – appropriate, considering Link Stones evolve Pokémon that would traditionally need to have been traded to evolve. | The trader in Vivill Town. The trade you need to make here in Vivill is in a small house right near the town entrance., If you picked up the Pokémon in the Pokeball in Vivill Woods (which could have been a Foongus or a Morelull) and then evolved it, Shroomu will offer you the evolved form of the other for it. | Note: Foonguss or Morelull can be found in a Pokeball in Vivill Woods; it is random which one you receive, and this trader will ask for the evolved form of it in exchange for the evolved form of the other.

chunks.t: Part 26: Vivill Town – Vivill Town
chunks.x: Pokémon Trade | The Move Trainer | The southeast corner of town. Walk to the northeast and you’ll see two houses with their backs to the sea. Enter the one that is on the northeast corner.

chunks.t: Part 26: Vivill Town – Vivill Town
chunks.x: The Nerd will teach your Pokemon a move for Shards. The man in here is a Move Trainer, and will teach one of your Pokémon Seed Bomb for 2 Green Shards. | Continuing the Story | Head back to the Vivill Warehouse and you’ll see Jax and Arthur waiting for you. | Jax and Arthur talk about next steps. Speaking to Jax and Arthur, it turns out that the ultimate weapon Aklove wants to destroy Borrius with was moved to Crystal Peak., Crystal Peak is on East Borrius, which can only be reached by ship from Seaport City. | Your next objective. Jax thinks it’s a good idea for you to go to Antisis City to defeat the Gym there first, so that’s your next destination.

chunks.x: Route 15 is to the west. Before you do that, however, there’s a sea route to explore just to the west of Vivill Town – Route 15., It can be worth exploring this now. | Route 15 | Route 15 map. Swimmer Sandra, Fisherman Dirk. Vivill Town, Route 2

chunks.t: Part 26: Vivill Town – Route 16
chunks.x: An unusual roadblock. At the north end of Route 16, you will find it difficult to proceed., Something is blocking your progress, wedged right between a rock and a hard place. | The Devon Scope | A stranger offers to help. You can’t see what it is – it’s invisible., Luckily, a strange man coming up behind you appears to know what it might be, and offers you an item to help. | The Devon Scope. The Devon Scope can detect invisible Pokémon, and it does just that here.

chunks.t: Part 26: Vivill Town – Route 16
chunks.x: It’s a Kecleon. The roadblock turns out to be a camouflaged Kecleon, who promptly runs away as soon as it is revealed., The strange man that helped you moves on, but you will see him again a bit later. | Aroma Lady Miah. Continue walking south until you see Aroma Lady Miah, the first trainer on this route. | The staircases. Keep heading south and you’ll go down a couple of staircases. You’ll pass Bird Keeper Jacob.

chunks.t: Part 26: Vivill Town – Route 16
chunks.x: The path leads east up more staircases. Continue on until you come to the end of the little gully, some long grass, and a staircase leading west back on top of the ridges. Follow that to a bridge, and cross it. | East leads to Route 17 and Seaport City, and southwest leads to Antisis City. There’s a plateau that has some wild grass on it, and a southwest staircase that leads to river level., Seaport City is east, so check out the route while you’re here. | The route has a lot of Workers on it

chunks.t: Part 26: Vivill Town – Route 16
chunks.x: Rock Climb HM | Unfortunately, it looks like the bridge is out., You’ll need to speak to one of the Workers here and he can offer something that might help. | Rock Climb, but not quite yet. The only way to get through Route 17 to Seaport City is by using Rock Climb, but you can’t use it just yet – you’ll need the Ring Badge from Antisis City., Luckily, that’s where you were going anyway. | After getting the HM head back to the crossroads. | Heading To Antisis City | Head down to the water. Walk down the staircase until you get to a spot where you can start Surfing in the river inlet.

chunks.t: Part 26: Vivill Town – Route 16
chunks.x: The island and Fisherman Andrew. You’ll see a sand island and a Fisherman on it – head there to battle him or move on, up to you. Keep on surfing south. | Swimmer Shirly and a huge Dive patch. You’ll pass a swimmer, but also see a huge patch of dark water in the middle of the route. This is a Dive spot, and you’ll need the Advanced Diving and Digging Machine to explore it. | Swimmer Dean. Swimmer Dean is in the waters to the southeast, and further south is a bigger sand island.

chunks.t: Part 26: Vivill Town – Route 16
chunks.x: Sailor Trevor. Pass Sailor Trevor and you’ll see the beginning of some grassy cliffs. | The east cliff landing and Picnicker Sofia. There are two ways you can go right now – up the west cliffs or up the east., Head east first, and you’ll see Picnicker Sofia. | Time to catch that Kecleon. Just east of her, wedged between some trees and the cliff edge, is a spot you can’t get past – just like at the beginning of the route. You’ll use the Devon Scope, and the Kecleon will appear!, You can catch it if you wish. | Pokémon Encounter: Kecleon (Normal catchable) Lv45

chunks.t: Part 26: Vivill Town – Route 16
chunks.x: After the battle, go west and walk south along that path. | The west cliff. Roughneck Silvester and the one-way jump | It’s a one-way jump from here, so make sure you’ve done everything you want on this route before moving any further. | Antisis hospitality. Roughneck Silvester gives you a taste of what to expect in Antisis City., Once you beat him, the only thing left to do is head south into the city gate. | The guard warns you. You’ll get one final warning from the gate guard – everything you’ve heard about Antisis City so far has not been good, so be prepared for a bit of an interesting experience!

Prize ₽5,120

chunks.t: Part 27: Antisis City & Antisis Port – Antisis City
chunks.x: A grandmother and granddaughter observe Antisis from a safe distance. In order to get the Antisis Gym badge, you’ll have to enter Antisis City first, and it’s pretty rough and dangerous by all accounts., From the gate, walk south. | Your first step on the mean streets. Keep heading down the street until you see the Pokémon Center on your right – then head towards it (it should be the second street you pass)., There are two types of goons out and about in Antisis City. | Those that wear green are members of the Black Ferrorthorn, which is the gang you saw harassing Mirskle back in the Dresco Gym., The ones in red should look familiar too – they’re James’ gang, formerly known as the Black Emboar, before you beat them in Crater Town. They’re now named the “Black [YOUR NAME]”, but for clarity’s sake they’ll continue to be referred to as the Black Emboar here. | The Pokemon Center, a scientist’s house, and a challenger. Right in front of the Pokémon Center is a Black Emboar goon on a bike. Apparently he doesn’t recognize you, and is itching for a fight!, After you beat him, he’ll be sufficiently humbled.

chunks.t: Part 27: Antisis City & Antisis Port – Antisis City
chunks.x: The Pokemon Center is under new management. There’s no Nurse at the Pokémon Center, and hence no free healing service., You’ll have to fork over P500 every time you want to have your Pokémon healed up in Antisis. | The suspicious scientist. Right next to the Center is the house of a member of the Science Society, and she appears to be up to no good., She’s selling ‘enhancers’ to gang thugs, but won’t give any to us. We’ll be seeing her a bit later. | The KBT Expressway entrance. The northwest corner of town, at the water level, has an entrance to the Expressway – but it’s been cut off from the rest of the system because of how dangerous Antisis is., There is one Gem Family member here that might be useful though. | Gem Family Move Shops

chunks.t: Part 27: Antisis City & Antisis Port – Antisis City
chunks.x: The bridge thug. On the bridge is a Black Ferrothorn goon who will challenge you to a fight if you speak to him. Continue past him going south and you’ll see a house on the western side of the city island. | The house on the western edge. Inside this house is a very odd person with a very odd request. | An eerie pulse?. If you show him a Pokémon that knows the move Eerie Impulse, he’ll give you TM107 Acrobatics., The Electrode you traded for in Blizzard City can learn Eerie Impulse by leveling up, as well as Pokémon such as Voltorb and Lanturn.

chunks.t: Part 27: Antisis City & Antisis Port – Antisis City
chunks.x: The Black Ferrorthorn HQ, near the Gym. There’s a building just east of here with a Black Ferrothorn goon guarding the entrance – this is their headquarters, and you can’t go in just yet., The Gym is also near here, but you aren’t quite ready to take it on. | The southeast house. The southeast section of town has two things – a small house, and the entrance to Antisis Port. You’ll be going to the Port later, but for now head inside the house. | A retired goon. One of the Terror Granbull is here, but he’s retired and living with his mother. He gives you a Max Potion as a gift to leave him alone.

chunks.t: Part 27: Antisis City & Antisis Port – Antisis City
chunks.x: The Black Emboar HQ. Next to the Poke Mart is a large building with a note on the front of it – it’s the Antisis headquarters of the Black Emboar., James said you should come and see him if you’re ever in Antisis, so head on inside. | Items: PP Up, Fresh Water, Fighting Gem, TM60 Drain Punch, TM107 Acrobatics, Max Potion, Black Sludge, Power Bracer, Dream Mist, Heracronite, Rare Candy, Poké Doll, Full Restore, Zygarde Cell #69 | Special Encounters (Miraheze wiki): Grimer (Egg) Lv1, Trubbish (Special) Lv45

chunks.t: Part 27: Antisis City & Antisis Port – Black Emboar HQ
chunks.x: Black Emboar HQ | James is happy to see you. As soon as you go in, James welcomes you into the group and tells you that they’re having trouble fitting in with the city. Their ultimate goal is to take down the Black Ferrothorns, but they’re not quite there yet., Talk to various members of the gang and do their missions, and the standing of the Emboar will improve. | A gross request. The first mission you can get is a pretty disgusting one – the gang member in front of the television on the ground floor has lost his socks in the sewers., You’ll be going to the sewers later, so this one can be put on pause for now. | A sneaky request. The other gang member with a mission for us on this floor is looking for a person to help smuggle goods through Antisis Port, which is pretty much the only place in town with any law and order., You’ll have to go there after 8PM, but you don’t have to wait for the real world time to match up. | Just change your system clock accordingly – an old trick, but a good one.

chunks.t: Part 27: Antisis City & Antisis Port – Antisis Port
chunks.x: Antisis Port | Antisis Port map. Officer McGuinty, Officer Holt, Officer Peralta, Black Emboar Goon Location. Antisis City

chunks.x: Items: Throat Spray (gate opens 6pm), Max Potion (gate opens 9am), Galladite (hidden) (gate opens 12pm), Assault Vest (gate opens 12pm) | Trainers (only at night) | Trainer Officer McGuinty: Noctowl (Water) Lv49, Stoutland (Normal) Lv50, Machoke (Fighting) Lv49. Prize ₽980 | On your way through the gatehouse, you’ll be asked to show some ID, which you’ve got. The port is crawling with guards waiting for the excuse to catch criminals. | The port is well-guarded. During the day, the three guards will ignore you., But at night they’ll challenge you to a battle. | The items found in the crate area are also time-sensitive, because the different boom gates and barriers open at different times., Head to the northeast pier and you’ll find your contact waiting for you. | The contact at the docks. Apparently you’re waiting for some ‘Rose Incense’, but that doesn’t sound illegal., After a little bit of waiting, a ship arrives, along with a familiar face.

chunks.t: Part 27: Antisis City & Antisis Port – Antisis Port
chunks.x: Mirskle hands over the goods. The Dresco Gym leader and mysterious Fog lover Mirskle gives you the shipment, then quickly sails off. | The Ferrothorn Goons want to turn us in. Unfortunately, you’re caught by some members of the Black Ferrothorn who want to turn us in to curry favor with the guards. | Port Battle | Trainer Black Ferrothorn Goon A: Ferroseed (Grass/Steel) Lv41 | Trainer Black Ferrothorn Goon B: Escavalier (Bug/Steel) Lv49

chunks.t: Part 27: Antisis City & Antisis Port – Antisis Port
chunks.x: The tables get turned. While you were busy battling the goons, your contact went to alert the guard and get them arrested, which caps things off nicely., He hid the package – revealed to be illegal Oddish Leaves – on the western side of the crate area, opposite the lighthouse. | The hidden leaves. Pick up the package and attempt to go through the gatehouse., The guard is suspicious, because he can smell something, but he lets you pass eventually. | Your reward for the smuggling. When you get back to the gang HQ, your contact rewards you with Dream Mist and tells you that Mirskle in Dresco Town will make you more if you give him any Oddish you’ve caught.

chunks.t: Part 27: Antisis City & Antisis Port – Antisis Port
chunks.x: Items: Premier Ball x3, Assault Vest, Max Potion, Throat Spray, Galladite, Lava Cookie, Old Gateau, Casteliacone, Lumiose Galette, Shalour Sable, Big Malasada, Zygarde Cell #70 | Further Missions | A Minor Scrap | A punchy request. Head upstairs and the first goon that you’ll see has a mission for you. He will ask you to take care of a couple of Ferrothorn on the eastern bridge., No need to go there yourself, he’ll take you there. | The rematch begins. The first stage of this battle begins with one goon at first, and then when you beat him it turns into a Double Battle with the other goon as well., They also use the mysterious enhancers the scientist makes on their Pokémon.

chunks.t: Part 27: Antisis City & Antisis Port – Further Missions
chunks.x: Turf War Battle | Trainer Black Ferrothorn Rory: Weezing (Poison) Lv48, Muk (Poison) Lv49, Ferroseed (Grass/Steel) Lv47, Krokorok (Ground/Dark) Lv49 | Trainer Black Ferrothorn Rory and Black Ferrorthorn Chad: Weezing (Poison) Lv48, Muk (Poison) Lv49, Ferrothorn (Grass/Steel) Lv47, Krookodile (Ground/Dark) Lv49 | A grateful goon. The Power Bracer is your gift for getting rid of those thugs., Head over to the room with all the beds in it to get the next mission. | Supply and Demand | A tricky mission. This goon wants you to stop the supply of the enhancers the Ferrothorn are getting, and that means dealing with the scientist who lives next to the Pokémon Center.

chunks.t: Part 27: Antisis City & Antisis Port – Further Missions
chunks.x: The Scientist’s House | The scientist’s house. Head over there and go on inside. | The scientist is prepared. Unfortunately for you and the goon, the scientist is protected by a top-of-the-line exploding Electrode security system., One wrong step and you’ll be knocked unconscious and have to try again. | Here’s the exact puzzle solution: | The path to the scientist. Step on the floor in this exact sequence:

chunks.t: Part 27: Antisis City & Antisis Port – Further Missions
chunks.x: Two steps west, One step north, One step west, Two steps north, One step east, One step north, Five steps east, Three steps south, One step west | The scientist is surprised. Speak to the scientist, and she’ll be confused as to how you even got to her., However, she has more exploding Electrode to throw at you, this time in a battle. | Trainer Science Society Scientist: Electrode (Fighting) Lv49, Electrode (Fighting) Lv49, Electrode (Fighting) Lv49 | Finally, justice is served. Eventually, she falls victim to one of her own traps and is knocked out., Take the enhancers from the windowsill and hand them to the goon – he’ll go with you back to HQ.

chunks.t: Part 27: Antisis City & Antisis Port – Further Missions
chunks.x: The Egg is the reward. Make sure you have an empty space in your party, then talk to him., Apparently the scientist made the enhancers from Pokémon, and one of their Eggs was left behind. | You’ll get the egg and you’ll now be the owner of your very own baby Alolan Grimer. | Egg Pokémon: Alolan Grimer (Poison/Dark) Lv1 | The Next Mission | The entrance to the sewers. There’s only one mission to complete for the Black Emboar left, and that’s the socks mission., Luckily, there’s an entrance to the sewers right in the back of their HQ, so head there next.

chunks.t: Part 28: Antisis Sewers & Ferrothorn Turf – Antisis Sewers
chunks.x: The first area of the sewers. It’s time to complete the third and final mission that the Black Emboar wants you to do for them., To do that, you’ll have to venture into the depths of the Antisis Sewers. | The Final Mission | Head down the stairs in the Black Emboar HQ and you’ll find yourself in them. | Head west across the bridge. The tunnels and walkways can be confusing to navigate., First, go west from the staircase until you see a bridge across a sewer canal. Cross it, then walk southwest until you see an opening in a wall. | Scientist Rodney. You’ll get challenged by Scientist Rodney., After you’ve dealt with him, go north and then turn back down heading southwest until you’re on the very southwest corner of the platform you’re on.

chunks.t: Part 28: Antisis Sewers & Ferrothorn Turf – Antisis Sewers
chunks.x: The thin grey lines are staircases; the thicker beige ones are sewer grates. Note: Navigating in the sewers is made even more difficult by the fact that the staircases down to the sewer water level can be easy to miss at first glance. In addition, when sewer grates are perpendicular to you it’s not clear whether they are open or closed, or whether you can walk across them (you can’t)., Head down the staircase to the water level – on the southwest corner of the platform – and walk through the small opening to the south. | Crawling through a sewer pipe. You will need a Pokémon that can use Flash – like HMs, you don’t need to actually teach it to a Pokémon, they just need the ability to use it. You should have gotten Flash from the Battle Girl in the Crater Town Poke Mart., Crawl through the pipe and you’ll end up in the south section of the sewers. | The other end of the pipe. Walk up the staircase and go to the northeast portion of the walkway., There’s a spot for you to drop into the water and surf east.

chunks.t: Part 28: Antisis Sewers & Ferrothorn Turf – Antisis Sewers
chunks.x: Surfing through sewage. Surf east along the sewer channel until you can go south. | Another turning. Then you’ll see further passage blocked off in every other direction except one., Surf west until you see a brick sewer platform. | The sewer platform. chunks.t: Part 28: Antisis Sewers & Ferrothorn Turf – Antisis Sewers

You may need the Dowsing Machine to find them, but the Grimy Socks are in the very corner of the hallway on the platform., With that done, go all the way back through the sewer channels and the pipe to get to the north sewers again. | Go east from the sewer pipe along the southern edge. When you’re in the north section, immediately after leaving the sewer path, go east along the bottom of the empty sewer channel., Ignore the stairs to the southeast and keep following the channel along. | Keep going north. Continue walking north along the bottom level of the sewer channel until you see a staircase leading to a sewer platform. There will be a Scientist roaming around on it as well.

chunks.t: Part 28: Antisis Sewers & Ferrothorn Turf – Antisis Sewers
chunks.x: Scientist Carolina and the entrance to the Science Lab. You’ll get a battle from Scientist Carolina, and once you’re done you can head into the doorway to find another Scientist. | The Scientist in here will give you items every day. Every day, the Scientist inside will give you a random item, depending on how successful her experiment was. | Returning the Grimy Socks | Your stinky reward. Once you’re finished exploring the sewers, head back upstairs to the HQ and give the Grimy Socks back to their owner. They’ll give you a Black Sludge in thanks.

With those three missions complete, James sees the opportunity to get rid of the Black Ferrothorn once and for all., He has a plan to strike them at their headquarters, and he will do it by breaking through to it from the sewers.

chunks.t: Part 28: Antisis Sewers & Ferrothorn Turf – The Battle of Antisis
chunks.x: Head southwest from the sewer pipe. James and his whole crew leave for the sewers, and it’s time for you to follow them., Crawl through the sewer pipe to the south section, this time going southwest along the walkway until you reach the platform from this angle. | Follow the platform along the edge. Continue along the edge of the platform until you see James and his crew to the southeast of it. | James makes his move. James will bust a hole in the bottom of the Ferrothorn headquarters, and after he does so, the invasion begins.

chunks.t: Part 28: Antisis Sewers & Ferrothorn Turf – The Battle of Antisis
chunks.x: Jump through the hole. When James and his goons are through, follow them and you’ll find yourself in Ferrothorn Turf. | Items: Heracronite

chunks.x: 2F Electrode Floor Puzzle | Watch your step. One wrong step on this floor and you’ll be thrown back to the beginning., Step 1: From the staircase landing, walk west two steps to the crate. | Step 2: Walk south two steps to the wall., Step 3: Walk east three steps to the crate. | The biker will go up and down the hallway – do not get caught. Step 4: Wait at the crate for the biker to turn his back on you. Then walk north one step, west four steps, south six steps and west one step until you are in a little alcove next to the potted plants on the left-hand side of the hallway., You must do this quickly before the biker turns around.

chunks.t: Part 28: Antisis Sewers & Ferrothorn Turf – Ferrothorn Turf

Step 5: Wait until the biker turns north, then leave the alcove and walk south one step and east four steps to the crate., This should take you out of sight. | Free and clear from the biker. Step 6: Walk south one step., Step 7: Walk east two steps. | Step 8: Walk north one step., Step 9: Go east three steps to the staircase. | The floor has been safely crossed. chunks.t: Gym 6: Antisis City Gym (Big Mo) – Ring Badge, Fighting
chunks.x: The Antisis City Gym is the 6th gym you encounter in Pokémon Unbound. The Gym Leader Big Mo primarily utilizes Fighting-type Pokémon., For this gym the most ideal typings for your party would be Flying, Fairy, and Psychic-type Pokemon. But the class of Pokemon you can use is somewhat restricted due to the Gym’s conditions of disabling certain move types., Here’s an example of how this gym condition works: in the battle with Big Mo, the game calculates the total number of Flying, Fairy, or Psychic-type moves featured within your Pokemon team’s moveset. It then disables the type of moves that are most commonly occurring. So, if your Pokemon mainly have Psychic-type moves, all of these will be disabled., In case of a tie between the number of Flying, Psychic, or Fairy-type moves – the game disables them based on the following priority: Flying > Psychic > Fairy., Additionally, all Psychic, Flying, and Fairy-types moves are disabled in the Trainer battles leading up to Big Mo. Antisis City Gym Puzzle: The Antisis Gym doesn’t have a dedicated puzzle like most of the other Gyms. Instead, you’ll have to enter a ‘Ring Challenge’ where you have to fight a series of 3 Trainers consecutively while using the same Pokemon from your squad., Although your Pokemon will be healed after each battle, you won’t have the option to swap it out for another one from your squad. Additionally, using Flying, Psychic, and Fairy-type Pokemon is allowed, but all moves of these types will be disabled. The details for each of these Trainer battles are shown below:, After defeating all of these Trainers, you’ll be given access to the final battle room where Big Mo can be challenged. Tips for Defeating Big Mo: Disable Unrequired Moves: Since the game disables the most commonly occurring moves between Flying, Psychic, and Fairy – you can use this to your advantage by purposely disabling one of the types you don’t plan on using. For example, if you have a strong Flying-type Pokemon, you can include any Pokemon with more Psychic or Fairy-type moves relative to your Flying-type., This will force the game to disable Psychic or Fairy-type moves, letting you use your Flying-type Pokemon without an

chunks.x: Thundercap Mountain – Antisis Side | Thundercap Antisis side map. Skier Charlie, Skiers Club Battles. Antisis City, KBT Expressway, Thundercap Mountain 2F

chunks.x: Items: Heart Scale (hidden), Float Stone, Rare Candy | Wild Pokémon [Surfing]: Tentacool (Water/Poison), Tentacruel (Water/Poison), Pelipper (Water/Flying), Mantyke (Water/Flying) | Wild Pokémon [Fishing]: Magikarp (Water (Old Rod)) Lv10–15 100%, Horsea (Water (Good Rod)), Remoraid (Water (Good Rod)), Seadra (Water (Super Rod)), Octillery (Water (Super Rod)), Gyarados (Water/Flying (Super Rod))

chunks.t: Part 30: Antisis Side of Thundercap Mountain – Thundercap Mountain – Antisis Side
chunks.x: Wild Pokémon [Rock Smash]: Binacle (Rock/Water), Alolan Geodude (Rock/Electrode) Lv20–25 60%, Corsola (Water/Rock), Krabby (Water), Kingler (Water) | Trainer Roughneck Corey: Darmanitan (Fire) Lv50, Tentacruel (Water/Poison) Lv50. Prize ₽1,680 | Trainer Black Belt Kentaro: Timburr (Fighting) Lv49, Crabominable (Fighting/Ice) Lv50. Prize ₽1,952 | The other side of the bridge. Just across from Antisis City is the eastern side of Thundercap Mountain., Now that you have Rock Climb, it’s time to head back in the mountain maze.

chunks.t: Part 30: Antisis Side of Thundercap Mountain – Thundercap Mountain – Antisis Side
chunks.x: Roughneck Corey and Black Belt Kentaro. There are two trainers ready to challenge you outside – once they’re taken care of, you’re free to head into the entrance. | Return to Thundercap Mountain – 2F | The Antisis entrance to Thundercap. You emerge in 2F, on the eastern side that was previously inaccessible., Now that you have Rock Climb, there are a few items in other areas already explored that can be picked up.

chunks.t: Part 30: Antisis Side of Thundercap Mountain – Return to Thundercap Mountain – 2F
chunks.x: Items: Iron Ball, Blue Shard, Utility Parasol, TM25 Thunder | The wall leading to the Northwest Chamber section of 2F. However, there’s one entirely new area, spanning two floors, that is now open to you – the Northwest Chamber., To get there, head west from the Antisis entrance to the northwest part of 2F. You’ll see a rock wall – climb it.

chunks.t: Part 30: Antisis Side of Thundercap Mountain – Northwest Chamber
chunks.x: Northwest Chamber | The north shore of the Auburn Waterway. Worker Lawton, Evolution Stone Elder, Psychic Marius, Kindler Boyce, Expert Saunders. 2F Main Cavern, KBT Expressway, Ladders – 2F Northwest Cavern and 3F Northwest Cavern

chunks.t: Part 30: Antisis Side of Thundercap Mountain – Northwest Chamber
chunks.x: Wild Pokémon [Surfing]: Stunfisk (Ground/Electric), Chinchou (Water/Electric), Lanturn (Water/Electric), Tynamo (Electric), Eelektross (Electric) | Wild Pokémon [Fishing]: Magikarp (Water (Old Rod)), Chinchou (Water/Electric (Good Rod)), Lanturn (Water/Electric (Super Rod)) | Wild Pokémon [Rock Smash]: Alolan Geodude (Rock/Electrode), Alolan Graveler (Rock/Electrode), Nosepass (Rock), Shuckle (Bug/Rock) | Trainer Worker Lawton: Klinklang (Steel) Lv52, Marowak (Ground) Lv50, Bastiodon (Rock/Steel) Lv51

chunks.t: Part 30: Antisis Side of Thundercap Mountain – Northwest Chamber
chunks.x: Trainer Psychic Marius: Beheeyem (Psychic) Lv52, Mr. Mime (Psychic/Fairy) Lv51, Hypno (Psychic) Lv51 | Trainer Kindler Boyce: Oricorio (Baile) (Fire/Flying) Lv50, Heatmor (Fire) Lv52 | Trainer Expert Saundra: Vanilluxe (Ice) Lv52, Gothitelle (Psychic) Lv52, Donphan (Ground) Lv51, Kecleon (Normal) Lv52 | This section has a lot of back-and-forth between two levels., Head north from where you climbed and you’ll see a series of bridges. | Worker Lawton. Waiting on the other side of one of them is Worker Lawton., Once you beat him, go north across the bridge, down the stairs to the west, and then down to where you have the choice of two cliffs to jump over.

chunks.t: Part 30: Antisis Side of Thundercap Mountain – Northwest Chamber
chunks.x: Jump off this cliff to proceed. Choose the east cliff and jump towards the east to proceed. | The first ladder to 3F. This leads to a small stairway, another bridge, some more one-way cliff jumps to the north, and a ladder to the east., Take the ladder first. | Exploring 3F | A completely new section. You will arrive in another part of 3F, with a large lake in it., Surf south and you’ll find an island with an old man on it.

chunks.t: Part 30: Antisis Side of Thundercap Mountain – Northwest Chamber
chunks.x: The Evolution Stone Man. This man will give you a random Evolution Stone every day, so it’s useful to come back to him every so often if you’ve run out of a Stone type you need., Once you’re finished in this part of the chamber, go back to the ladder and climb down to 2F. | Back to 2F | The way to the next ladder. This time, go north to the two jump cliffs and take the west cliff. Follow the path northwest until you see another ladder. | Pushing boulders to the next ladder. This time, you’re on the northern side of the 3F chamber., You’ll need to push boulders out of the way to get to the next ladder, and there are two trainers for you to fight as well.

chunks.t: Part 30: Antisis Side of Thundercap Mountain – Northwest Chamber
chunks.x: Continuing on. Once you get to the next ladder, it’s just a short walk across yet another bridge to find another ladder., Take that to head up it. | More boulders. You’ll end up in the northeast corner on 3F, and find yourself with another boulder puzzle. | 3F Boulder Puzzle | The boulder puzzle. This one is simple enough, but requires some smashed rocks., Step 1: From the starting position, push the top boulder to the left. | Step 2: Then, push the left-most boulder down south 1 tile, revealing a smashable rock on your right.

chunks.t: Part 30: Antisis Side of Thundercap Mountain – Northwest Chamber
chunks.x: After the first and second moves. Step 3: Turn to the east and smash the rock. | After the third move. Step 4: Go to the boulder north of where the smashed rock was and push that boulder south. | After the fourth move. Step 5: Push the same boulder east onto the button.

chunks.t: Part 30: Antisis Side of Thundercap Mountain – Northwest Chamber
chunks.x: After the final move. This accomplishes two things: | Clears a path to the final ladder, And solves the Tablet puzzle in the Tablet Chamber | The final ladder. With all of that done, go down the ladder. | The Final Ladder | Expert Saundra. Expert Saundra is the final trainer in this section, and she guards the Flash Cannon TM.

chunks.t: Part 30: Antisis Side of Thundercap Mountain – Northwest Chamber
chunks.x: The way out. Now that all trainers in Thundercap Mountain have been defeated, it’s time for one final challenge to finish off this bunch of caves for good., Take the series of one-way cliffs back to the main section of 2F, and go to the center of the cavern. | Mountain Master Challenge | The Mountain Master. You’ll see the Mountain Master up on a cliff by himself., He’s only available to battle if you’ve defeated every other trainer in Thundercap Mountain. | Considering there’s a lot of them, you may have missed one or two – check the Trainer Catalog you got from Fallshore City if you’re stuck. | Mountain Master Battle | Trainer Mega Trainer Aloysius: Politoed (Water) Lv51, Blissey (Normal) Lv50, Braviary (Normal/Flying) Lv54, Reuniclus (Psychic) Lv51, Ampharos (Mega) (Rock/Ice) Lv52

chunks.t: Part 30: Antisis Side of Thundercap Mountain – Mountain Master Challenge
chunks.x: The Ampharosite prize. If you manage to beat him, the Ampharosite mega stone is your prize., Now it’s time to check out what solving the Tablet puzzle accomplished – go to the Tablet Cavern on 3F. | The Tablet Puzzle | The remains of the Tablet. The Tablet is gone, and a cave entrance is in its place. | A Z-Crystal. Inside is a Raid Den and a Z-Crystal, Pikanium Z – useful if you’ve got a Pikachu., There is one final place you need to go now that you’ve got Rock Climb, and that’s Seaport City to continue your journey. | The Next Destination | Head to Route 17 where you were given the Rock Climb HM in the first place.

chunks.t: Part 30: Antisis Side of Thundercap Mountain – The Next Destination
chunks.x: The beginning of Route 17. Now you can proceed through the route and continue on to stop the Light of Ruin – and hopefully become Pokémon Champion.

chunks.t: Part 31: Route 17 & Seaport City – Route 17
chunks.x: The Great Desert map. Fisherman Gator, Fisherman Boot, Jogger Landon, Hiker Pistachio, Raid Den, Psychic Jaren, Healer Chansey, Berry Picker, Pokemon Ranger Madeline, Bug Catcher Conner, Pokemon Breeder Amelia, Fisherman Magnus, Sky Master Almuth. Route 16, Requires Advanced Digging and Diving Machine, Seaport City

chunks.t: Part 31: Route 17 & Seaport City – Route 17
chunks.x: Trainer Fisherman Magnus: Malamar (Dark/Psychic) Lv52, Samurott (Water) Lv51, Dragalge (Poison/Dragon) Lv52. Prize ₽1,952 | The bridge is still out. When you return to Route 17, the bridge is still broken and out of commission., Luckily, thanks to the Ring Badge, you can use Rock Climb to get across the gap yourself. | The cliff access to the beach. Walk south of the workers until you see a rock wall leading down to the beach. This is the path you’ll need to take going forward., In this route there’s a Route Master – the Sky Master – so defeating every Trainer here should also be your goal. | FIshermen Gator and Boot. There are a couple of Fishermen on this first beach – defeat them and then start surfing to the northeast.

chunks.t: Part 31: Route 17 & Seaport City – Route 17
chunks.x: Follow the channel all the way along. This is a water channel between the mainland and one of the route islands. Follow it north, east, and then south again. | Between two islands. You’ll now be under a bridge between the first and second route islands., There’s a Rock Climb wall leading off a small beach on the second island that you can ascend. | Jogger Landon and the bridge. Jogger Landon is there to greet you at the top – challenge him, then cross the bridge over to the first island.

chunks.t: Part 31: Route 17 & Seaport City – Route 17
chunks.x: Hiker Pistachio and Psychic Jaren. Two Trainers hang out on this island – Hiker Pistachio and Psychic Jaren. There’s also a Raid Den here, just west of the Psychic., After you’ve taken care of both of them, go back across the bridge. | North of the Jogger is a set of stairs. Go past Jogger Landon again and start walking north. You’ll see a set of stairs set into the rock cliff., There’s a Chansey up here, which may be welcome news after fighting all those Trainers. | The Chansey is pretty much the halfway mark of the route. Once you’ve healed up, head east through the long grass.

chunks.t: Part 31: Route 17 & Seaport City – Route 17
chunks.x: This man was trapped by boulders. If you come by during the daytime, you’ll see someone trapped by a very simple boulder puzzle. He’s a Berry salesman, and if you save him then he’ll give you two random healing Berries. This is repeatable every day., Once you get your reward, continue east. | Pokémon Ranger Madeline, and the currently inaccessible Sky Master. On your way past you’ll see someone standing on a cliff that you can’t get to – this is Almuth, the Sky Master. You’ll be able to challenge him soon enough., For now, beat Pokémon Ranger Madeline and take the stairs that are just past her. They lead to the final bridge of the route. | Seaport City’s island at last. You’re now on the same island as Seaport City, but there’s still a bit of trekking you need to do to get there., Bug Catcher Conner is in the long grass, waiting to ambush you.

chunks.t: Part 31: Route 17 & Seaport City – Route 17
chunks.x: Breeder Amelia and the path north. Take care of him, and then keep going east until you run into Pokémon Breeder Amelia., Once you’ve defeated her quite sizeable team, go north into a section of long grass. | Fisherman Magnus. Following the long grass east will take you to Seaport City, but you’ve still got a couple of trainers to defeat., Instead, go northwest, descend the stairs to the beach, and take on Fisherman Magnus. | Surf southwest, back to the Sky Master. He was the last regular trainer in the route, so now it’s time to challenge Almuth., Surf southwest, cross under the bridge, and you’ll see a small patch of sand under a cliff.

chunks.t: Part 31: Route 17 & Seaport City – Route 17
chunks.x: The challenge spot. Once you land on it, the battle with the Sky Master will begin. | Sky Master Challenge | The first T-junction. An important thing to note – you’ll have to defeat him in a Sky Battle, which means that any Pokémon that cannot Fly – usually just non-Flying-types – cannot participate., It’s recommended to bring at least three flying Pokémon in case of accidents. | Sky Master Battle | Trainer Master Trainer Almuth: Noctowl (Normal/Flying) Lv51, Tropius (Grass/Flying) Lv51, Rotom (Wash) (Electric/Water) Lv52, Hawlucha (Fighting/Flying) Lv52, Pidgeot (Mega) (Normal/Flying) Lv52. Prize ₽7,100

chunks.t: Part 31: Route 17 & Seaport City – Route 17
chunks.x: Your Mega Stone prize. Your prize is the Pidgeotite mega stone, and with that, Route 17 is complete., Head back the way you came until you get to the patch of long grass, and go east from there. | Seaport City entrance. At the end of the long grass lies Seaport City – and the only way to get to East Borrius. | Items: Prism Scale, Max Potion, Max Repel, Green Shard, Dawn Stone, Max Revive, TM104 Psyshock, Metronome, Shiny Stone, Lum Berry, Full Heal, Quick Ball, Rare Candy, Trainer Tips sign #34, Zygarde Cell #74, Zygarde Cell #75, Max Raid Den #16, Portal #12, Tapu Lele
