chunks.x: Special Encounters (Miraheze wiki): Galarian Farfetch'd (Special), Sirfetch'd (Special), Shellder (Special), Keldeo (Ordinary form) Lv80 | Seaport City | Seaport City map. Pokemon Center, Poke Mart, Big and Small House, West Seaport Warehouse, Camomons Battle House, Breeder School, Battleground House, Hip Waders Fishing Club, East Seaport Warehouse, Ferry Terminal and Super Rod Fisherman, Shipyard, Seaport Marketplace, Alolan Starter and Landlord Mission House. Route 17, (west) KBT Expressway, (east) East Borrius, requires S.S. Ticket

chunks.t: Part 31: Route 17 & Seaport City – Seaport City
chunks.x: Items: Zygarde Cell, TM12 Taunt (hidden), Sticky Barb, Slowbronite (hidden), Max Revive (hidden), Dive Ball (hidden) | Items: Zygarde Cell (inside Shipyard), Full Heal (hidden) | Wild Pokémon [Surfing]: Tentacool (Water/Poison) Lv35–40 60%, Tentacruel (Water/Poison) Lv38–40 5%, Pelipper (Water/Flying) Lv35–40 30%, Mantine (Water/Flying)

chunks.t: Part 31: Route 17 & Seaport City – Seaport City
chunks.x: Wild Pokémon [Fishing]: Magikarp (Water (Old Rod)) Lv10–15 100%, Remoraid (Water (Good Rod)) Lv20–25 60%, Corsola (Water/Rock (Good Rod)) Lv20–50, Horsea (Water (Good Rod)) Lv20–25 20%, Octillery (Water (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 40%, Seadra (Water (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 40%, Corsola (Water/Rock (Super Rod)) Lv20–50, Lapras (Water/Ice (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 1% | The Pokemon Center, the Battle Frontier gate, and the Poke Mart. Seaport City at last., The Pokémon Center and Poke Mart are right at the entrance, and in between them is a gate that leads to the Battle Frontier. However, it’s closed, and will remain closed until you become Pokémon Champion. | Start your exploration of the town by walking east.

chunks.t: Part 31: Route 17 & Seaport City – Seaport City
chunks.x: Various NPC Gifts | The people in this house are obsessed with size. The house next to the Poke Mart has some interesting people inside – head on in. | This kid needs to see a tiny Pokémon. If you’ve got a Pokémon that has a length of 20 centimeters or shorter, show it to the Youngster inside the ground floor apartment and he’ll give you a prize, usually something like a Poke Doll. | This lady wants to look at a sea cucumber Pokemon. Then speak to the lady in the kitchen and she’ll ask to see a Pokémon that looks like a sea cucumber – the only thing that really fits the bill is a Pyukumuku, found by surfing in Dehara City., After that, she’ll want to see a Probopass. You can catch a Nosepass in Thundercap Mountain and then level it up there – it will evolve into a Probopass. | Your reward is 3 Balm Mushrooms.

chunks.t: Part 31: Route 17 & Seaport City – Seaport City
chunks.x: Upstairs, the show and tell continues. The woman in the hallway upstairs says she wants to see a Pumpkaboo, but only a large one. These can be found in Grim Woods., She’ll give you 5 Dusk Balls as a reward. | Upstairs, Big Pokemon are sought after. The woman inside the upstairs apartment wants to see a Pokémon longer than 7 meters, like a Steelix. You can find them on Route 11. She’ll give you a Fluffy Tail in return., Also in this apartment, speak to the man nearby who will give you a Bottle Cap. | Once you’re done with this house, return to the intersection with the Pokémon Center and take the road south. | Camomons Battle House. To the left is a Warehouse – ignore that, you’ll go there later – and to the east is a row of houses., There’s a man banging on the door of the left one, begging to be let back in. That’s the Camomons Battle House, and you also can’t get in because he’s blocking the door.

chunks.t: Part 31: Route 17 & Seaport City – Seaport City
chunks.x: The Breeder’s School | The Breeder’s School. The house to the east of here is the Breeder’s School – go on in. | This Breeder wants to see a Pichu. You’ll find yourself in a classroom where Breeders are getting a lecture. Speak to the man in the back row and he’ll want to see a Pichu., To get one you’ll need to breed a Pikachu. These are found in Vivill Woods in a swarm, which is rare. | If you manage to pull this off, he’ll give you a special Spiky-Eared Pichu in return. This particular Pichu will also be useful in the endgame. | Reward Pokémon: Spiky-Eared Pichu (Electric)

chunks.t: Part 31: Route 17 & Seaport City – Seaport City
chunks.x: The Destiny Knot is a hot topic. If you have a female Pokémon that knows the move Attract, show it to the Breeder on the right side of the top row and they’ll give you a Destiny Knot. | This Breeder acts like another Pokemon Day Care. The room on the right is a mini-Pokémon Day Care – the breeder in the north of the room is able to take care of one Pokémon for you. | The Breeder’s challenge. Talk to the Breeder in the southeast corner and he’ll give you a Baby Monitor if you have hatched 10 Eggs., Then if you hatch 50 Eggs, he’ll give you a Ditto, as well as Metal Powder. | Reward Pokémon: Ditto (Normal)

chunks.t: Part 31: Route 17 & Seaport City – Seaport City
chunks.x: He’s not done yet though – if you then go on to hatch 100 Eggs, he’ll give you a Magma Stone, which not only halves Egg hatching time (and quarters it if you’ve got a Pokémon with Flame Body or Magma Armor), but is essential to summoning a Legendary Pokémon in the endgame. | Visiting Other Houses | The Battleground is closed. The southwest house is the Battleground, but it’s not open until the post-game. | The Hip Waders HQ. The southeast house is more interesting at the moment, so head on inside. | The Hip Waders are recruiting. The Fisherman in here is a member of a club called the Hip Waders, and he invites you to join., Every day, if you show him a Pokémon he asks you to catch, he’ll give you a prize – usually something like 5 Dive Balls.

chunks.t: Part 31: Route 17 & Seaport City – Seaport City
chunks.x: The Docks | The seaport part of Seaport City. Heading east down the stairs next to that house will get you to the docks that give Seaport City its name., There’s another warehouse here, but don’t go in it just yet. | For now, walk to the end of the southern pier. | The final Rod. Speaking to the Fisherman here will give you the Super Rod, and you’ll finally be able to catch every fishable Pokémon., The building near him is the ferry station, but you’ll be heading there a bit later. | The KBT Expressway entrance. In the northwest corner of the dock area is Seaport’s entrance to the KBT Expressway.

chunks.t: Part 31: Route 17 & Seaport City – Seaport City
chunks.x: The Seaport City exit. There’s a couple of Gem Family members in this section of the tunnel. | Gem Family Move Shops | If you’re done with exploring the Expressway, head back out. | The Shipyard. There’s also a large building just to the east of the Expressway entrance – this is the Seaport.

chunks.t: Part 31: Route 17 & Seaport City – Seaport City
chunks.x: The ADM is still out of our reach. The Advanced Digging and Diving Machine can be obtained here, but not just yet (only in the post-game). You’ll need a hefty reputation before Captain Davy will even consider selling it to you for a high price., Head west from the Shipyard, up the stairs and you’ll see the Seaport Marketplace. | Seaport Marketplace | Seaport Marketplace. There’s a Berry stall, a Ball stall, and a TM stall here – but speak to the girl in the middle and she’ll give you TM114 Natural Gift., She’ll also tell you more information about rare Berries if you show them to her. | The house yet to be explored. There’s one house you haven’t been in yet, and that’s north of the Marketplace. Head on inside, but make sure you have one space in your team free.

chunks.t: Part 31: Route 17 & Seaport City – Seaport City
chunks.x: Another starter Pokemon giveaway. The woman with an umbrella on her head is from Alola, and she’ll give you one of the Alolan Starter Pokémon for free. She’ll give you the others when you get 7 and 8 Badges respectively. | Alola Starters: Rowlet (Grass) Lv45, Litten (Fire) Lv30, Popplio (Water) Lv30

chunks.t: Part 31: Route 17 & Seaport City – Seaport City
chunks.x: Items: Poké Doll, Fluffy Tail, Nugget, ADM, HM05 Dive, TM114 Natural Gift, TM99 Wild Charge, Dubious Disc, Max Revive, Balm Mushroom x3, Lum Berry, Slowbronite, Sharpedonite, Icium Z, Sticky Barb, Dive Ball, Super Rod, Lure Ball x5, Full Heal, Destiny Knot, Baby Monitor, Magma Stone, Audinite, SS. Ticket, Zygarde Cell #77, Vivillon pattern Modern | Special Encounters (Miraheze wiki): Pichu (Gift) Lv50, Castform (Gift) Lv30, Vivillon (Modern form) Lv50

chunks.t: Part 31: Route 17 & Seaport City – Finding the Skitty
chunks.x: Finding the Skitty | The landlord of the building. The man on the couch in the hallway of this building is the landlord, and he’s the one to talk to regarding the old man in Epidimy Town that needs somewhere to live., However, first you’ll need to do something for him, and it turns out to be more complicated than it seems. | A couple of thugs have taken the landlord’s prized Skitty, and you’ll need to track them down. | The thugs are near the southwest beach entrance. You can find Swizer and Bullo near the steps that lead to the beach on the southwest side of town., They’ll give you a Double Battle, and when you beat them they’ll run off. | Trainer Burglar Swizer and Black Ferrothorn Bullo: Combusken (Fire/Fighting) Lv54, Shieldon (Rock/Steel) Lv52, Garbodor (Poison) Lv53

chunks.t: Part 31: Route 17 & Seaport City – Finding the Skitty
chunks.x: Time to head back to the house. The landlord is grateful, but you’ll need to walk him back home for your reward. | The KBT Expressway entrance. However, when you get there, he mysteriously disappears., Swizer shows up to gloat and says that if you want to get him back, you’ll need to go to the western Seaport warehouse – the one just near the beach entrance – to take on him and his gang. | So our next stop in this walkthrough is to visit the Seaport Warehouse. | The KBT Expressway entrance. There’s weird restrictions though – you need to bring only Ice and Fairy-type Pokémon (double types are fine, so long as at least one of them is Ice or Fairy)., Prepare your team – this may be difficult if you haven’t trained that typing.

chunks.t: Part 32: Seaport City Warehouses & Boat to East Borrius – Seaport West Warehouse
chunks.x: Seaport West Warehouse

chunks.t: Part 32: Seaport City Warehouses & Boat to East Borrius – Seaport West Warehouse
chunks.x: Seaport West Warehouse map. Black Ferrothorn Goon and Burglar Milan, Kidnapped Man, Black Ferrothorn Goon and Burglar Colin, Mimikyu, Black Ferrothorn Goon and Burglar Hernando, Black Ferrothorn Goon and Burglar Toby. Warehouse Entrance | Items: Rare Candy, Max Elixir, Max Potion

chunks.t: Part 32: Seaport City Warehouses & Boat to East Borrius – Seaport West Warehouse
chunks.x: Trainer Black Ferrothorn Goon and Burglar Milan: Tentacruel (Water/Poison) Lv53, Ferroseed (Grass/Steel) Lv51, Alolan Sandshrew (Ice/Steel) Lv51, Torkoal (Fire) Lv53, Escavalier (Bug/Steel) Lv53. Prize ₽8,480 | Trainer Black Ferrothorn Goon and Burglar Colin: Wormadam (Bug/Steel) Lv52, Seviper (Poison) Lv52, Pawniard (Dark/Steel) Lv51, Heatmor (Fire) Lv53, Ferrothorn (Grass/Steel) Lv53. Prize ₽8,640 | Trainer Black Ferrothorn Goon and Burglar Hernando: Aggron (Steel/Rock) Lv53, Charmander (Fire) Lv51, Ferroseed (Grass/Steel) Lv51, Litten (Fire) Lv51 | Trainer Black Ferrothorn Goon and Burglar Toby: Steelix (Steel/Ground) Lv53, Nidorino (Poison) Lv52, Garbodor (Poison) Lv53, Torracat (Fire) Lv52. Prize ₽8,640 | Picking up where we left off, you’re in the western warehouse in Seaport City on a rescue mission.

chunks.t: Part 32: Seaport City Warehouses & Boat to East Borrius – Seaport West Warehouse
chunks.x: Swizer checks you’re following the rules. The thugs who took him invite you to try and take him back from them, but they’ve got some rules for you to follow – you must enter with a team composed only of Fairy-type and Ice-type Pokémon (double types are allowed)., Why? | Well, it just so happens that the majority of the Pokémon these thugs have are super effective against Ice- or Fairy-types, which means that you’ll be at a severe type disadvantage the whole time., It’s recommended that you use Alolan Ninetales – hopefully you’ve been training it – as well as double Ice-types from Icy Hole such as Sealeo, Piloswine and Jynx, which might only need a bit of leveling beforehand. | Entering the warehouse. Once Swizer is satisfied you’re following the rules, he allows you to go downstairs to face the goon gauntlet. | The first intersection. Keep going south, passing an intersection along the way – there’s just a Worker there who hears the cry of a Mimikyu.

chunks.t: Part 32: Seaport City Warehouses & Boat to East Borrius – Seaport West Warehouse
chunks.x: Continue west through the thin passage. At the south end of the hallway is a Strength boulder and a narrow passage leading west into the mass of storage containers. Take the passage. | The first Double Battle pair. Every fight in here is a Double Battle, and this one is just the first, so make sure you’re prepared., Once they’ve been defeated, go to the end of the passage and push the boulder out of the way so you can head north. | Note: Be warned that this represents a path of no return, since the boulder resets behind you. You may want to use items to heal up after every single fight, because they’re pretty tough. | The landlord is rescued – now you just need to get out of here. You’ll see the landlord to the north – talk to him and he’ll start following behind., Take the west passage through the containers and you’ll get another Double Battle.

chunks.t: Part 32: Seaport City Warehouses & Boat to East Borrius – Seaport West Warehouse
chunks.x: The second confrontation. Once these goons are finished with, continue along the passage until you reach the western side of the warehouse., Follow the path down, and you’ll notice three passages leading east. | The first passage. Follow the first passage and you’ll find a dead end – and a Pokémon. | Time to catch a Mimikyu. You’ll be drawn into a battle with a Mimikyu, and you’ll be able to catch it as well. | Pokémon Encounter: Mimikyu (Ghost/Fairy catchable) Lv50

chunks.t: Part 32: Seaport City Warehouses & Boat to East Borrius – Seaport West Warehouse
chunks.x: The three passages – the correct one to take to go forward is the middle one. If you go along the bottom passage, you’ll be hit with an optional Double Battle. Take the middle passage first if you want to avoid it. | Narrowly avoiding a battle. You’ll pass the ambush and head east, straight into a Double Battle you can’t avoid. | The penultimate Double Battle. Once you defeat that pair of goons, you’re free to make your escape from this floor of this warehouse.

chunks.t: Part 32: Seaport City Warehouses & Boat to East Borrius – Seaport West Warehouse
chunks.x: The boulder is the way out. Walk east and you’ll see that you can now push the boulder from the other side, freeing up the way to the entrance. | Kidnapper Showdown | The final battle. As soon as you go upstairs, Swizer and Bullo are waiting for you., They’re not happy you managed to get this far, and want to take care of you personally. | Kidnapper Double Battle | Trainer Burglar Swizer and Black Ferrothorn Bullo: Garbodor (Poison) Lv54, Bastiodon (Rock/Steel) Lv54, Bisharp (Dark/Steel) Lv53, Hawlucha (Fighting/Flying) Lv52, Blaziken (Fire/Fighting) Lv54

chunks.t: Part 32: Seaport City Warehouses & Boat to East Borrius – Kidnapper Showdown
chunks.x: Freedom at last. Should you be able to defeat them, they leave with their tails between their legs, and allow you to take the landlord home. | The landlord is grateful. As payment for rescuing him and his Skitty, he tells you that he’ll allow the old man in Epidimy Town to move into the upstairs apartment free of charge. | The old man can’t believe his luck. Fly back to Epidimy Town to give the old man the good news. He heads to his new apartment immediately.

chunks.t: Part 32: Seaport City Warehouses & Boat to East Borrius – Kidnapper Showdown
chunks.x: Your very valuable reward. Speak to him in Seaport City and he’ll give you the Icium Z, which upgrades Ice moves to Z-Moves. | The mighty Subzero Slammer. If you’ve got that Alolan Ninetales, give it the Icium Z to hold and it will turn into an absolute weapon against Dragon-, Flying-, Grass- and Ground-type Pokémon – and also a lot of other types, considering the power of Subzero Slammer. | The East Warehouse. There’s one more warehouse you need to investigate, on the docks this time., Townsfolk have mentioned that they’ve seen a Science Society Scientist go in, and it might be the same one that stole the Electivire.

chunks.t: Part 32: Seaport City Warehouses & Boat to East Borrius – Seaport East Warehouse
chunks.x: Seaport East Warehouse | Seaport East Warehouse map. Scientist and Electivire. Warehouse Entrance | Items: Zygarde Cell (upstairs), Dubious Disc (hidden), TM99 Wild Charge, Max Revive

chunks.t: Part 32: Seaport City Warehouses & Boat to East Borrius – Seaport East Warehouse
chunks.x: The location of the password. You’ll need a password to get in. And by following a tip you can get from a Scientist in town, it’s scrawled on the back of some crates here (screenshotted above)., Enter the password and the door will open. | (I got a password of 5711 but it may be different for each playthrough). | The password entered. Make your way downstairs to the storage floor, where the Scientist and the Electivire await. | The way downstairs. Walk south until you see a turning to the west – this is the way you need to go.

chunks.t: Part 32: Seaport City Warehouses & Boat to East Borrius – Seaport East Warehouse
chunks.x: Keep going south. You’ll see a ladder on the side of a container – take that and it will lead you straight to the Scientist and her mad experiments. | Climb the container | Rescuing the Electivire | The lair of the Scientist. The Scientist is apparently pleased you found her, and sets the Electivire on you.

chunks.t: Part 32: Seaport City Warehouses & Boat to East Borrius – Rescuing the Electivire
chunks.x: Electivire Gauntlet | Trainer Pokemon Fight: Electivire (Electric (level scales)) Lv? | Trainer Dynamax Pokemon Fight (Double Battle): Dynamax Electivire (Electric (level scales)) Lv? | Trainer Science Society Scientist: Rotom (Electric/Grass) Lv52, Magnezone (Electric/Steel) Lv53, Manectric (Electric) Lv54, Vikavolt (Bug/Electric) Lv54 | The Dynamax is successful. Once you beat it, it’s not over – she’s figured out a way to Dynamax it, and you’ll have to fight a Max Battle with the Electivire., It’ll be a Double Battle, and the three-part shield it throws up at different points is a little frustrating.

chunks.t: Part 32: Seaport City Warehouses & Boat to East Borrius – Rescuing the Electivire
chunks.x: The Scientist wants to handle you herself. If you manage to beat it, the Scientist will square up to you herself and battle you with her team of Pokémon., Compared to the Dynamax Electivire though, she’s a bit of a pushover. | Finally, the Electivire can go home. With its captor finally defeated for good, the Electivire wants to return to its Trainer in Epidimy Town. | Your reward. Make space in your party when you get there – the Electivire’s happy owner will give you a Pokémon Egg containing a lv. 1 Elekid., You’ll also get an Electirizer, a Power Weight, and a Gold Bottle Cap.

chunks.t: Part 32: Seaport City Warehouses & Boat to East Borrius – Sailing to East Borrius
chunks.x: Sailing to East Borrius | The Ferry. With all the business in Seaport City taken care of, it’s finally time to take that boat ride., Go to the ferry terminal on the southern pier, near where you picked up the Super Rod. | Bad news. Jax and Arthur are already here, and apparently there’s engine trouble., They’re not happy at the inconvenience. | An alternative form of transport. Luckily, the S.S. Marine is also going to East Borrius, and the helpful Sailor at the desk gives the three of you tickets.

chunks.t: Part 32: Seaport City Warehouses & Boat to East Borrius – Sailing to East Borrius
chunks.x: Ticket to ride. Jax hands you one of the tickets and tells you to meet them on the north pier. | Taking the boat east. Make sure you’ve done everything you can in Seaport City for now, and head to the S.S. Marine – it’s time to go to East Borrius. | Crossing the sea. It doesn’t take long for the S.S. Marine to reach its destination – the dock at Polder Town., You arrive at the dock, and Jax and Arthur discuss next steps. You’re interrupted though by an ominous thundering in the distance – Crystal Peak, where Aklove is trying to fire the Ultimate Weapon.

chunks.t: Part 32: Seaport City Warehouses & Boat to East Borrius – Sailing to East Borrius
chunks.x: Crystal Peak. Your next objective at the docks | You’ll need Waterfall to even get to Crystal Peak, and that means you’ll need to beat the Polder Gym first.

chunks.t: Part 33: Polder Town, Safari Zone & Polder Gym – Polder Town
chunks.x: Polder Town | Polder Town map. Pokémon Center, Poke Mart, Croagunk Show, Fishing Mission House, Move and TM Mission House, TV Mission House, Polder Gym. West Borrius, Cootes Bog, Safari Zone

chunks.t: Part 33: Polder Town, Safari Zone & Polder Gym – Polder Town
chunks.x: Items: Zygarde Cell, Tiny Mushroom (hidden) | Wild Pokémon [Surfing]: Palpitoad (Water/Ground) Lv35–40 60%, Stunfisk (Ground/Electric) Lv35–40 30%, Gastrodon (Water/Ground) Lv38–40 5%, Sliggoo (Dragon) | Wild Pokémon [Fishing]: Magikarp (Water (Old Rod)) Lv10–15 70%, Poliwag (Water (Old Rod)) Lv10–15 30%, Poliwhirl (Water (Good Rod)) Lv20–50, Barboach (Water/Ground (Good Rod)) Lv20–25 60%, Poliwhirl (Water (Super Rod)) Lv20–50, Politoed (Water (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 5%, Whiscash (Water/Ground (Super Rod)) Lv45–50 40%

chunks.t: Part 33: Polder Town, Safari Zone & Polder Gym – Polder Town
chunks.x: Polder Pokemon Center. You’ve just arrived in West Borrius, and the first place open to you is Polder Town., You’ve got a Gym to beat and HM Waterfall to obtain, but exploring Polder first will be very rewarding. | Exploring the Town | The north end of town. North of the Pokémon Center and the ferry dock is: | The Poke Mart, A blonde woman with a row of Croagunk next to her, And a house | The Croagunk show is worth a visit. Talking to the woman with the Croagunk is interesting – her Pokémon will put on a show for you, and it’s kind of like a shell game. One of the Croagunk will hold an item, and you need to pay attention to which one is holding it as they dance around each other., If you guess correctly, you win a prize.

chunks.t: Part 33: Polder Town, Safari Zone & Polder Gym – Polder Town
chunks.x: One possible prize is a Big Mushroom, but there may be others – you can try once per day., Once you’re finished, go into the house just east of here. | The Fisherman has a series of tasks for you. The Fisherman who lives here gives you a series of missions that ask you to fish for more and more Pokémon., If you catch 10 Pokémon while fishing, he’ll give you 10 Dive Balls. | Fish for 50, and he’ll give you 10 Heart Scales., His final mission is for you to fish for 100 Pokémon, and your reward is the Pokémon Feebas. | This house’s occupants are obsessed with moves. From the Fisherman’s house, go south through the crowd of dancing people and you’ll see another house. Head on inside. | This woman wants to see a particular move. Each day, the woman in the hat would like to see a Pokémon that can perform a particular move. If you manage to do so, she’ll give you a Heart Scale.

chunks.t: Part 33: Polder Town, Safari Zone & Polder Gym – Polder Town
chunks.x: Collect all the TMs you can. The other person in the house has a mission for you – there are 120 TMs in the world, and she wants you to find all of them., If you do so, the reward is a Gold Bottle Cap. | After you’re done with this house, go to the southwest corner of town. | Items: Tiny Mushroom, Fresh Water, Water Gem, HM07 Waterfall, Heart Scale, Dive Ball x10, Big Mushroom | Special Encounters (Miraheze wiki): Rotom (Special) Lv50, Feebas (Special) Lv10, Meloetta (Special) Lv80

chunks.t: Part 33: Polder Town, Safari Zone & Polder Gym – Too Much TV
chunks.x: Too Much TV | The child inside here has a problem. There’s a family here in a house that needs your help. | Help save this little girl. A little girl has lost her mind to watching TV, and her worried father wants you to help., He sends you to find a scientist that knows all about brain waves, and there’s one particular place you’ve been that has a whole institute devoted to it – Tarmigan Town. | The Dream Research Lab in Tarmigan Town. Fly to Tarmigan Town and head to the Dream Research Lab, which is in the northwest of town.

chunks.t: Part 33: Polder Town, Safari Zone & Polder Gym – Too Much TV
chunks.x: The clown of the sand. The scientist you need is in the northwest corner of the building., According to him, there are five children around Borrius that have this condition, and you need to scan the brains of the remaining four. | You may have seen them in your prior explorations, but here they are as a reminder: | Items: Bellin Town Southwest house, Blizzard City 2F, house next to KBT Expressway entrance, Crater Town Central south house, same kid that gives you Swarm info, Seaport City 1F, Alolan Starter Pokémon and landlord rescue mission building | When you’ve finished the brain scans, return to the Lab and the Scientist will go off and cure the children. Apparently it was all because of a strange Pokémon.

chunks.t: Part 33: Polder Town, Safari Zone & Polder Gym – Too Much TV
chunks.x: After the scans, the Scientist does the legwork. Return to the house in Polder Town after that. | The father is grateful. The man who gave you the mission is grateful that his daughter is now cured, and says he caught a Pokémon leaving her body when the Scientist was curing her., If you have an empty spot in your party, he’ll give you a Rotom. | Using the Rotom | The Antisis Warehouse. Now that you have a Rotom, head to the Antisis Warehouse, which is in the northwest corner of Antisis City.

chunks.t: Part 33: Polder Town, Safari Zone & Polder Gym – Too Much TV
chunks.x: The Warehouse is where you can change Rotom forms. There are a bunch of broken-down appliances here that Rotom can possess – and when it does so, it can change its typing and receive a powerful move of a particular type. You can change types at will with no limit or cooldown, though you’ll have to return to the warehouse each time you do. | Rotom Appliances: Heat Rotom (Electric/Fire Microwave Oven), Wash Rotom (Electric/Water Washing Machine), Frost Rotom (Electric/Ice Refrigerator), Fan Rotom (Electric/Flying Electric Fan), Mow Rotom (Electric/Grass Lawnmower) | Items: TV collectible #1, TV collectible #2, TV collectible #3, TV collectible #4 | Special Encounters (Miraheze wiki): Rotom (Gift) Lv50

chunks.t: Part 33: Polder Town, Safari Zone & Polder Gym – The Safari Zone
chunks.x: The Safari Zone | The gate to the Safari Zone. Polder Town is home to the Safari Zone, which is a fantastic place to catch weird and wonderful Pokémon. The gate to the Safari Zone is in the east part of town. | The Safari Zone has difficulty settings. Unlike most other versions of the Safari Zone, in Unbound there’s no map to explore – it’s essentially just a catching minigame., Each play costs you P500, and you get 30 Safari Balls. | There’s no limit on time, and the session ends when you run out of Balls. | You move the target in order to catch moving Pokemon. The four difficulty settings change how fast the Pokémon move, and also determine which Pokémon are available to catch., If you want to skip a Pokémon, you’ll need to forfeit 5 Balls. | It’s a great opportunity to fill up your Pokedex, but may take some time.

chunks.t: Part 33: Polder Town, Safari Zone & Polder Gym – The Safari Zone
chunks.x: Safari Zone Pokémon: Skitty (Normal), Rhyhorn (Ground/Rock), Natu (Psychic/Flying), Alolan Meowth (Dark), Plusle (Electric), Minun (Electric), Bounsweet (Grass), Blitzle (Electric), Helioptile (Electric/Normal), Cubone (Ground), Treecko (Grass), Torchic (Fire) | Safari Zone Pokémon (cont.): Mudkip (Water), Steenee (Grass), Zebstrika (Electric), Xatu (Psychic/Flying), Alolan Diglett (Ground/Steel), Spinda (Normal), Wobbuffet (Psychic), Tauros (Normal), Rhyhorn (Ground/Rock), Helioptile (Electric/Normal), Treecko (Grass), Torchic (Fire)

chunks.t: Part 33: Polder Town, Safari Zone & Polder Gym – The Safari Zone
chunks.x: Safari Zone Pokémon (cont.): Mudkip (Water), Rhydon (Ground/Rock), Wobbuffet (Psychic), Kangaskhan (Normal), Zebstrika (Electric), Spinda (Normal), Tauros (Normal), Helioptile (Electric/Normal), Alolan Exeggcute (Grass/Psychic), Alolan Diglett (Ground/Steel), Golisopod (Bug/Water), Grovyle (Grass) | Safari Zone Pokémon (cont.): Combusken (Fire/Fighting), Marshtomp (Water/Ground), Rhydon (Ground/Rock), Tauros (Normal), Doublade (Steel/Ghost), Kangaskhan (Normal), Wobbuffet (Psychic), Alolan Exeggcute (Grass/Psychic), Golisopod (Bug/Water), Heliolisk (Electric/Normal), Alolan Dugtrio (Ground/Steel), Grovyle (Grass) | Safari Zone Pokémon (cont.): Combusken (Fire/Fighting), Marshtomp (Water/Ground) | After you’ve had enough of the Safari Zone, there’s not much left to do here in Polder – only challenging the Gym remains.

chunks.t: Part 33: Polder Town, Safari Zone & Polder Gym – The Safari Zone
chunks.x: Polder Gym | Polder Town Gym – Swamp Badge | This is a Water Gym, with a peculiar mechanic. The Polder Gym is, on paper, a Water-type Gym., But as you’ve seen before, Unbound is not afraid of throwing curveballs when it comes to Gym challenges.

chunks.t: Part 33: Polder Town, Safari Zone & Polder Gym – Polder Town Gym – Swamp Badge
chunks.x: Gym Typing Rules | In this Gym, the typing of each Pokémon in battle is changed to reflect the typing of the Pokémon’s first and second moves., Here’s an example:, Say you’ve got a Metagross, normally a Steel/Psychic-type. However its first move happens to be the Dark-type Brutal Swing, and its second move is the Fighting-type Hammer Arm., In this Gym, your Metagross will be a Dark/Fighting type!, That goes for every Pokémon in your team, and every Pokémon you will battle in this Gym., Make sure you’re familiar with what moves your Pokémon have in what order, and be prepared to do some shuffling around with TMs if necessary. | Gym Trainers italics = typing in the Gym | Trainer Fisherman Nicholas: Stunfisk (Ground/Electric) Lv52, Bruxish (Water/Normal) Lv53, Alomomola (Water/Psychic) Lv53. Prize ₽1,728 | Trainer Tuber Savannah: Popplio (Water/Fairy) Lv54, Mudkip (Water/Normal) Lv54. Prize ₽216 | Trainer Ace Trainer Darwin: Tirtouga (Water/Dark) Lv53, Marshtomp (Normal/Ground) Lv54, Heliolisk (Water/Dragon) Lv53. Prize ₽4,080

chunks.t: Part 33: Polder Town, Safari Zone & Polder Gym – Polder Town Gym – Swamp Badge
chunks.x: Trainer Ace Trainer Anita: Simipour (Flying/Dark) Lv53, Brionne (Normal/Fairy) Lv54, Goodra (Dragon/Water) Lv53. Prize ₽4,080

chunks.t: Part 33: Polder Town, Safari Zone & Polder Gym – Polder Town Gym – Swamp Badge
chunks.x: Gym Puzzle Layout | The optimal Gym route to avoid the waves

chunks.t: Part 33: Polder Town, Safari Zone & Polder Gym – Polder Town Gym – Swamp Badge
chunks.x: There is also a second thing to consider in this Gym – the waves., Every six or seven steps or so, the water rises up in a big wave that will wash you all the way back to the entrance if you’re still Surfing in it., This means that you’ll need to choose your destination carefully, and time when you leave each particular island to reach the next one., Here’s the solution to the gym puzzle to reach the gym leader: | Note: The following puzzle solution is for vanilla difficulty/easy puzzle mode. If you are playing on a harder difficulty then the puzzle solution may differ. | Surf north to the first island, where you’ll get challenged by Fisherman Nicholas. | The first island. Then surf to the island northeast of there. | The second island. You’ll need to defeat Tuber Savannah., Once that’s done, head west, but only if there’s no haze on the screen indicating a wave is about to break.

chunks.t: Part 33: Polder Town, Safari Zone & Polder Gym – Polder Town Gym – Swamp Badge
chunks.x: The third island. From the third island, surf northwest., Be doubly sure that the previous wave cycle has just finished before trying to reach the next island. | The fourth island. Ace Trainer Darwin will challenge you, and then you can make the leap to the island northeast of here. | The fifth island. Ace Trainer Anita is your opponent next, and once you’ve defeated her, surf northwest to a small nub of an island.

chunks.t: Part 33: Polder Town, Safari Zone & Polder Gym – Polder Town Gym – Swamp Badge
chunks.x: The penultimate island. From there, it’s just a short surf north to where the Gym Leader is., Just make sure you go between the lily pads and the reeds, because they will block your progress. Refer back to the map at the top of this section if you need an exact step-by-step path to follow. | Tessy, the Gym Leader. Hopefully you make it to the final island, where Tessy is keen to battle you. | Polder Gym Leader Tessy | Tessy will give you one heck of a battle. If you have a balanced team – accounting for the type changes with moves – then Tessy will be straightforward, though she still has a couple tricks up her sleeve.

chunks.t: Part 33: Polder Town, Safari Zone & Polder Gym – Polder Town Gym – Swamp Badge
chunks.x: Tip: The table below is only for Tessy on Vanilla mode. If you are playing on a higher difficulty level then visit our Polder Town Gym page here to see her team comps at other difficulties. | Trainer Gym Leader Tessy italics = typing in the gym: Toxapex (Poison/Dark) Lv54, Seismitoad (Water/Poison) Lv55, Armaldo (Water/Bug) Lv55, Gyarados ((Mega) Water/Ground) Lv56. Prize ₽9,120 | HM07 Waterfall at last. The Swamp Badge is your prize after you win the battle, and Tessy sweetens the pot by also giving you HM07 Waterfall., Your path to Crystal Peak is now open.

chunks.t: Part 33: Polder Town, Safari Zone & Polder Gym – Optional: Waterfall Backtracking
chunks.x: Optional: Waterfall Backtracking | You can now climb up waterfalls. There are a few important items you can reach with Waterfall now. So if you wanted to backtrack a bit then here are some relevant areas worth re-visiting to use Waterfall at:

chunks.t: Part 33: Polder Town, Safari Zone & Polder Gym – Optional: Waterfall Backtracking
chunks.x: Waterfall Backtracking Locations. Route 4 West

chunks.t: Part 33: Polder Town, Safari Zone & Polder Gym – Optional: Waterfall Backtracking
chunks.x: Waterfall Backtracking Locations. Valley Cave B1F, Fallshore City, Antisis Sewers | Waterfall Backtracking Locations

chunks.t: Part 33: Polder Town, Safari Zone & Polder Gym – Moving Forward
chunks.x: Moving Forward | The entrance to Cootes Bog. Once you’ve finished tying up loose ends with Waterfall, it’s time to head into Cootes Bog., This is north of Polder Town, and we’re going here to get onto the path to Crystal Peak to stop Aklove and the Light of Ruin.

chunks.t: Gym 7: Polder Town Gym (Tessy) – Swamp Badge, Water
chunks.x: The Polder Town Gym is the 7th Gym you’ll encounter in Pokémon Unbound. The Gym Leader, Tessy, specializes in Water-type Pokémon., The Polder Town Gym has an effect that can potentially cause your Pokemon to change their types. Here’s how this works: each Pokemon sent into battle will adapt and change their type corresponding to the first 2 moves in their moveset., For example, if your Pokemon has a Fire and Dark-type move as the first 2 moves in their moveset, that Pokemon will become a Fire / Dark-type. This condition affects both you and opponents., Additionally, Rainy conditions occur during the battle with Tessy which strengthens all Water-type attacks. Polder Town Gym Puzzle (Step-by-Step): The Polder Town Gym features small pieces of land spread across a swamp/pond. The water here is murky and filled with steam that progressively makes your vision hazy after every few steps, fully blinding you at its peak. If your vision is blinded while you’re surfing inside the pond, you’ll be swept back to the gym’s entrance by water waves., The goal here is to navigate through the swamp, finding the correct path to Tessy, while also ensuring you don’t become blinded by the steam while you’re surfing., For every step in the tutorial below, make sure that your vision is completely clear before entering the water. You can force this by walking on land to make the steam trigger and clear out, all while remaining completely safe from the waves by staying on land., Here’s a step-by-step guide on quickly solving the gym’s puzzle and reaching Tessy:, Step 1: From the entrance, use surf and head straight up to the small piece of land with the Trainer on it. This is an optional battle and can be skipped if you stay near the edge of the area., Step 2: From here, head towards the small piece of land coming up on your right. This area hosts another Trainer battle which is skippable if you position yourself at the far edge of the land., Step 3: Surf to the piece of land towards the north, next to the big tree., Step 4: From here, make your way further north where you’ll find another small piece of land with a tree., Step 5: Now Surf towards the top-left of your screen to find the n

chunks.t: Part 34: Cootes Bog & Magnolia Town – Cootes Bog
chunks.x: The entrance to Cootes Bog, and two missions. Your next destination is Crystal Peak, and to get there you’ll have to traverse through Cootes Bog., It’s a massive swamp, and it can be reached by going north of Polder Town. | You’ll see two people with missions available, including one from Tessy, the Polder Gym leader. Ignore hers for now because it will make exploration a little difficult., It’s helpful to first clear out the trainers that are in the areas where we’d go for the mission, so that’d be another benefit to wait. | Use the DexNav to catch all Pokemon in Cootes Bog. Instead, take the mission from the scientist here. It’s pretty straightforward – catch all of the different Pokémon that are present in Cootes Bog., Using the DexNav to track them is useful. Pokémon acquired through fishing count too. | There are two paths you can take from the entrance – left and right. Head left first. | Another choice. You’ll have to pick between two more paths to take – the left will take you to a pond to cross, and the right leads through long grass., Take the right path for now – they both end up essentially in the same place.

chunks.t: Part 34: Cootes Bog & Magnolia Town – Cootes Bog
chunks.x: Pokemon Ranger Betty. You’ll pass under a wooden bridge, and Pokémon Ranger Betty is here to challenge you., After you beat her, keep heading east through the long grass and you’ll see a hook-shaped pond. | The south part of the hook-shaped pond. East of this pond is the path to Crystal Peak – remember its location for later., Surf north to the upper part of the hook. | The north part of the hook-shaped pond. Jump out of the pond onto the west bank and head west through the long grass to challenge Pokémon Ranger Mason.

chunks.t: Part 34: Cootes Bog & Magnolia Town – Cootes Bog
chunks.x: Pokémon Ranger Mason. There are dead ends and duplicate trails to his north and west, so the only thing to do after defeating him is head back where you came from. | Cross this pond north. There’s another pond here – Surf along it and you’ll pass under yet another wooden bridge. | Further into the bog. At the other end of the pond, take the west path through the long grass and you’ll see someone trying to hide in it.

chunks.t: Part 34: Cootes Bog & Magnolia Town – Cootes Bog
chunks.x: Ninja Boy Yokohama. This is Ninja Boy Yokohama, and he isn’t as hidden as he thinks he is., Go past him to the north and you’ll come to another important intersection. | West is Magnolia Town, east winds around the bog further. The gate to Magnolia Town is to the west of this junction. It’s recommended to go there briefly to acquire the Fly fast travel point, just so you can come back to it when it’s time to explore the town., After doing that, walk east and you’ll see a ladder leading up to a wooden platform. | Aroma Lady Denise. Challenge Aroma Lady Denise here and move past her to the east, where you’ll finally be on one of those wooden bridges you’ve been seeing everywhere.

chunks.t: Part 34: Cootes Bog & Magnolia Town – Cootes Bog
chunks.x: A small clearing. You’ll get to a wooden platform with a ladder down into a small clearing. Go south and you’ll see a Picnicker. | Picnicker Jocelyn. Once you’ve defeated her, climb up the other ladder and cross the long bridge across the treetops to another clearing. | The path continues. Climb down the ladders and go through the wild grass east to another platform.

chunks.t: Part 34: Cootes Bog & Magnolia Town – Cootes Bog
chunks.x: Scientist Marvin. There’s a trainer here – Scientist Marvin., Once you’ve defeated him just cross the bridge, which is the longest in the bog and takes you all the way over to the west part of the bog. | The end of the bridge. Once you’re at the platform at the end, go south and you’ll encounter Psychic Hector. | Psychic Hector. There’s one final bridge for you to cross, and it’s just south of him.

chunks.t: Part 34: Cootes Bog & Magnolia Town – Cootes Bog
chunks.x: One final bridge. Cross it, and you’ll pass over where you fought the first Pokémon Ranger. | Passing over where Pokemon Ranger Betty was. There’s a Trainer Tips sign on the other side, and just south of there is the entrance to the bog. | Back at the beginning. You’ve come full circle, and with all trainers in your way cleared, it’s time to take Tessy’s mission on.

chunks.t: Part 34: Cootes Bog & Magnolia Town – Cootes Bog
chunks.x: Protector of the Swamp Mission | Tessy needs to find her Swampert. It turns out that the Terror Granbull moved on to Cootes Bog and want to take over Polder Town as their little kingdom. You’ll be teaming up with Tessy in a series of Double Battles to get rid of them. | Protector of the Swamp Battles | Trainer Terror Granbull Goon Pair A: Granbull (Fairy) Lv55, Skitty (Normal) Lv53, Granbull (Fairy) Lv55 | Trainer Terror Granbull Goon Pair B: Cottonee (Grass/Fairy) Lv55, Roserade (Grass/Poison) Lv54, Jumpluff (Grass/Flying) Lv53, Granbull (Fairy) Lv55, Granbull (Fairy) Lv55 | Trainer Terror Granbull Goon Pair C: Cherrim (Grass) Lv54, Togekiss (Fairy/Flying) Lv54, Pachirisu (Electric) Lv53, Dedenne (Electric/Fairy) Lv53, Granbull (Fairy) Lv55, Granbull (Fairy) Lv55

chunks.t: Part 34: Cootes Bog & Magnolia Town – Cootes Bog
chunks.x: The first pair of goons. The way forward is to either take the bridge path back to where Scientist Hector was, or go north along the pond way and jump the cliff west., You’ll eventually run into two Granbull goons itching for a fight. | The second pair. Continue to follow the bridge path, past where Scientist Marvin was, and you’ll run into another pair of Granbull goons. | The third pair. Eventually, you’ll be led all the way back through the entire length of the bridge route to the north end of the bog and near the Magnolia Town entrance., There’s a third pair of Goons here, and once you pass them, head southeast.

chunks.t: Part 34: Cootes Bog & Magnolia Town – Cootes Bog
chunks.x: The final confrontation. The Goons who stole Tessy’s Swampert are in a clearing here, watching a Feraligatr and a Drapion fight., Confronting them will set off a chain of boss battles, so be prepared. | Protector of the Swamp Boss Battles | Trainer Terror Granbull Goon Pair D: Granbull (Fairy) Lv55, Granbull (Fairy) Lv55, Breloom (Grass/Fighting) Lv53, Whimsicott (Grass/Fairy) Lv54, Glalie (Ice) Lv53, Mawile ((Mega) Steel/Fairy) Lv55 | Trainer Pokémon Double Battle: Feraligatr (Water (level scaled)) Lv?, Drapion (Poison/Dark (level scaled)) Lv? | Trainer Dynamax Pokémon Fight: Dynamax Feraligatr (Water (level scaled)) Lv?

chunks.t: Part 34: Cootes Bog & Magnolia Town – Cootes Bog
chunks.x: The trap is sprung. When you finish battling the goons, the Feraligatr and the Drapion will team up to beat you., After that, things take a turn for the unexpected. | Dynamax Feraligatr. Using a trap provided to them by the Science Society, the Feraligatr suddenly Dynamaxes, and you’ll have to beat it in a Dynamax battle! | Swampert is free. It’s a tough battle, but at the end of it the Granbull Goons are driven out of the swamp and Tessy has her Swampert back., In gratitude, she gives you TM120 Nature Power.

chunks.t: Part 34: Cootes Bog & Magnolia Town – Magnolia Town
chunks.x: Items: Moomoo Milk, Rare Bone (hidden), Zygarde Cell | Magnolia Town. It’s a pretty small town, but there are a couple places worth going to. | Moomoo Farm. You’ll see that the west side of town has a field of Miltank and Tauros in it – this is the famous Moomoo Farm, home of Moomoo Milk., Head inside the house to the north of the field and you can meet the farmer himself.

chunks.t: Part 34: Cootes Bog & Magnolia Town – Magnolia Town
chunks.x: Moomoo Milk by the dozen. Like the market stall in Fallshore City, you can buy Moomoo Milk here by the bottle or the dozen, and for a healing item that restores 100HP, the dozen option is still a pretty good deal. | The butterfly enthusiast. Speaking to the man to the right of the farmhouse will give you a bit of a scavenger hunt mission. You’ll have to hunt down 19 variants in West and East Borrius. A few are in areas you haven’t been to yet, but most have now appeared where you’ve explored before., You don’t need to capture them, just defeat them and they’ll return to the trainer. | You can try and catch them if you wish, though be aware their catching difficulty is extremely high., If you manage to see all 19, the collector will give you the 20th variant, which is the Poke Ball pattern. It’s Shiny as well. | Magnolia Cafe, and the Furfrou hairdresser. The large building east of there is the Magnolia Cafe, which acts as a sort of specialty Poke Mart for the town.

chunks.t: Part 34: Cootes Bog & Magnolia Town – Magnolia Town
chunks.x: Tip: The woman out front in the screenshot above is a Furfrou hairdresser – bring her any Furfrou you catch in Magnolia Fields and she’ll style it for you. | Free Max Ethers at the counter. There are a number of daily events that can go on in the Magnolia Cafe, and they vary depending on whether you’re in the main story or in the post-game., But for now just collect 4 Max Ethers from the man at the counter. Then head to the house to the east of the Pokémon Center and go inside – there’s another thing happening daily here that might be interesting. | The Pep Quiz House. Answer the questions in the ‘Pep Quiz’ every day, and every day you’ll get a reward. | The Pep Quiz. And after this, it’s time to head to Crystal Peak.

chunks.t: Part 34: Cootes Bog & Magnolia Town – Leaving Town
chunks.x: Leaving Town | Go back to the southern entrance to Cootes Bog to head to Crystal Peak. We’re now ready to head to Crystal Peak., To make things easier, fly back to Polder Town and head to the southern part of the Bog and we’ll continue from there.

chunks.t: Part 35: Crystal Peak – Getting to Crystal Peak
chunks.x: Getting to Crystal Peak | Take the left path from the entrance of Cootes Bog. Now that you have explored Cootes Bog and Magnolia Town, it’s time to finally go to Crystal Peak and stop the Light of Ruin., To get there, leave Polder Town by the north exit and take the left path at the fork.

chunks.t: Part 35: Crystal Peak – Getting to Crystal Peak
chunks.x: Take the right path at the next fork. When you get to the next fork, go through the long grass path under the bridge, passing Pokémon Ranger Betty. | Get to the hook-shaped pond. The long grass path will curve around to the right – follow it and you’ll end up at the hook-shaped pond. | Cross the pond east. Surf across the pond to the eastern bank, and you’ll see a clean water source to your northeast. That’s your ultimate destination – but head south for now.

chunks.t: Part 35: Crystal Peak – Getting to Crystal Peak
chunks.x: Keep heading southeast. With the clean water on your right-hand side, head south until you reach a fork, then go southeast. | Camper Bradley and the access to the clean water. Camper Bradley is itching for a fight if you haven’t taken care of him already., Once he’s defeated, it’s just a matter of walking east until you reach the water. | Surf along the clean water source. Hop on your Surfing Pokémon and head up the water source as it winds through the trees to its origin point – a waterfall.

chunks.t: Part 35: Crystal Peak – Getting to Crystal Peak
chunks.x: Your HM will now come in handy. You’ve got the badge and HM Waterfall from Polder Gym, so it’s time to use them., Climb up the waterfall, and you’ll find yourself at the entrance to Crystal Peak. | Rival Battle | Final round with your Rival. However, your Rival is waiting for you., You’ll be taking on Crystal Peak together, but he wants to see if you’re ready first. | Trainer Rival Battle (Final Round): Toucannon (Normal/Flying) Lv54, Vaporeon (Water) Lv55, Mamoswine (Ice/Ground) Lv56, Aggron (Ice/Ground) Lv56, Metagross (Mega) Steel/Psychic Garchomp (Mega) Ground/Dragon Tyranitar (Mega) Rock/Dark Lv58

chunks.t: Part 35: Crystal Peak – Rival Battle
chunks.x: Your Rival is ready. You’ll need to pick three Pokémon that will be used alongside your Rival’s Toucannon, Mamoswine and Vaporeon in the Double Battles ahead., Once you’re all set, the only thing to do is to head inside and face your destiny. | Crystal Peak – Lower Floors | Crystal Peak B1F and 1F maps. Healing Chansey, Medium Laurel, Scientist Rosalind, Cyclist Lucina, Light of Ruin Grunt Pair A. Cootes Bog, 1F Entry Chamber to B1F Rune Chamber, B1F Rune Chamber to 1F Main Chamber, 1F Main Chamber to B1F Solitary Chamber, 1F Main Chamber to Crystal Peak Exterior Slopes
